title: 头像表情表：主要角色 8 表情与有名 NPC 4 表情

subject.zh: 光之女神的模样：高挑的女子，白金长发一丝不乱垂到腰，白金色眼睛，目光像在测量尺寸。白与金的长袍左右绝对对称，领口与袖口镶几何纹金边，白 #f4f2ea、金 #d8b860，背后悬着精密的几何纹光环，像缓慢转动的齿轮。神情端正而冷淡。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of light as a tall woman: immaculate platinum hair falling straight to the waist, platinum eyes with a measuring gaze. Perfectly symmetrical white and gold robes with geometric gold trim at collar and cuffs, white #f4f2ea, gold #d8b860, a precise geometric halo floating behind her like slowly turning gears. Composed, cool expression. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：光环停转：背后齿轮状的光环停住不转，眼神失焦一瞬，嘴唇微启。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: the halo stops: the gear-like halo behind her freezes mid-turn, her gaze loses focus for an instant, lips slightly parted.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 光环是几何纹的齿轮状，不是圆形光圈；衣饰必须左右对称。

subject.zh: 争斗女神的模样：高大健硕的女战士，古铜肤色上满是旧伤疤，暗红蓬乱长发，金红色眼睛，笑起来露出尖牙。头上一对弯角，右角断了半截。红黑战甲 #8a1c1c、#1e1a1a，肩甲满是刀痕，肩上扛着一把断剑。豪爽好斗。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of strife as a towering, muscular woman warrior: bronze skin covered in old scars, wild dark red long hair, red-gold eyes, a fanged grin. A pair of curved horns, the right one broken halfway. Red and black battle armor #8a1c1c, #1e1a1a, pauldrons covered in blade nicks, a broken sword resting on her shoulder. Boisterous and eager for a fight. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：望向空处：笑意收住，视线越过观者，看向画面外的一处空位。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: looking at the empty place: the grin fades and her gaze goes past the viewer to an empty spot off-frame.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 断的是右角；断剑的剑身只剩一半。

subject.zh: 交易女神的模样：半身人般的小个子女人，只到常人胸口，圆脸，脸颊几点雀斑，蜂蜜金卷发扎两个小发髻，金色眼睛笑得弯弯。多口袋的朱红商人外套镶金边 #b8402a、#e0b040，腋下夹一本厚账本，手里捏着一块点心，身边浮着几枚旋转的金币。Q 版约 1.6 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of trade as a halfling-sized woman who reaches an adult's chest: round face with a few freckles, honey-gold curls in two small buns, golden eyes curved in a smile. A vermilion merchant coat full of pockets with gold trim #b8402a, #e0b040, a thick ledger under one arm, a pastry in her hand, a few gold coins spinning in the air around her. Chibi about 1.6 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：估价眼：金色的眼睛眯起，瞳孔里映着旋转的硬币。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: the appraising eye: her golden eyes narrow, a spinning coin reflected in each pupil.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 金币是浮在她身边的几枚小圆片，属于角色本身，不是背景粒子；个子明显比常人矮。

subject.zh: 生命女神的模样：纤瘦轻盈的女子，苍白肤色，苍绿长发长及膝盖，发间同时插着枯花与新开的花，常闭着眼，神情安静。苔绿与枯叶褐的层叠薄衣像落叶 #6a8a5a、#8a6a42，赤足。动作又轻又慢。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of life as a slender, weightless woman: pale skin, knee-length pale green hair woven with both withered and freshly opened flowers, eyes usually closed, a quiet expression. Layered thin garments in moss green and dead-leaf brown like fallen leaves #6a8a5a, #8a6a42, barefoot. Moves lightly and slowly. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：睁眼：第一次睁开眼睛，平静地直视观者。其余各格都闭着眼。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: opening her eyes: her eyes open for the first time, looking calmly at the viewer. Every other panel keeps her eyes closed.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 身边的半鹿半狼兽是另一个素材，不画进来；脚上不穿鞋。

subject.zh: 记录女神的模样：身形修长的兜帽书记官，墨蓝兜帽长袍 #2a3450，兜帽下露出栗色短发与常带笑的嘴角，左眼前悬一片刻着细纹的圆镜片，指尖沾着墨。腰后拖着一条羊皮纸色长卷轴 #e8dcc0 一直垂到地上，身边浮着一本翻开的书。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of record as a tall hooded scribe: ink-blue hooded robe #2a3450, chestnut short hair and a ready smile under the hood, a round lens etched with fine lines hovering before her left eye, ink-stained fingertips. A parchment-colored scroll #e8dcc0 trails from her waist down to the ground, an open book floats beside her. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：镜片反光：一根手指推着左眼前的镜片，镜片上一闪白光，看不见那只眼睛，嘴角带笑。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: the lens glints: one finger pushing up the lens before her left eye, a flash of white light on the lens hiding that eye, a smile at the corner of her mouth.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 镜片在左眼前；书页与卷轴上一个字也没有，只有空白与淡淡的格线。

subject.zh: 梦里站在门口的女人：高挑的成年女子，深褐长发松松垂到腰，脸的右半边总隐在阴影里，露出的左半边带着温柔的笑，眼睛是暖琥珀色。深夜蓝的及地长袍 #262c48，衣缘一道暖金细边 #f0d890，腰间一圈挂满大小不一的旧钥匙。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The woman who stands in a doorway in dreams: a tall grown woman, dark brown hair loose to the waist, the right half of her face always lost in shadow, the visible left half wearing a gentle smile, warm amber eyes. Floor-length midnight blue robe #262c48 edged with a thin warm gold line #f0d890, a ring of old keys of every size hanging at her waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：带笑的停顿：嘴角含笑，目光低垂。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a smiling pause: lips curved, eyes lowered.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 画面里不出现任何名字与文字；阴影始终在她右半张脸；钥匙是黄铜、铁与骨的旧钥匙。

subject.zh: 外表十五六岁的娇小少女，黑发及肩，发梢化成细羽，左鬓一缕白发，左眼琥珀色，右眼黑色。破旧深灰信使斗篷 #3a3a42 收拢时像一对合起的翅膀，胸前别钥孔形铜别针，腰挂封着暗红火漆 #8a2a2a 的皮信囊，长靴尖包爪形铁片。神情刻薄倔强。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A petite girl who looks fifteen or sixteen: shoulder-length black hair whose tips turn into fine feathers, one white lock at her left temple, left eye amber and right eye black. A worn dark grey messenger cloak #3a3a42 that looks like folded wings when closed, a keyhole-shaped copper pin on the chest, a leather letter pouch sealed with dark red wax #8a2a2a at her waist, long boots with claw-shaped iron toecaps. Sharp-tongued and stubborn. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：嘴硬：撇嘴别过脸，眼睛斜着看回来，耳尖发红。右眼的瞳孔是细长的钥孔形。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a stubborn front: lips twisted as she turns her face away, eyes sliding back toward the viewer, the tips of her ears flushed. The pupil of her right eye is a slender keyhole shape.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 左鬓白发与琥珀色左眼都在角色自己的左侧；左向镜像后若换边，由导入工具出头部修正件；信囊的暗红火漆是全身唯一的暖色。

subject.zh: 十七岁的狼族兽人少女，浅相：人脸，银灰狼耳与狼尾。精瘦，中等偏高。银灰短发略乱，一侧编细辫挂狼牙与小铜铃，浅金色眼睛。森绿皮质猎装 #3f5a3a 配短披风与皮护臂 #8a6a4a，裸露的小臂有部族纹身，背长弓，腰挂猎刀与狼尾毛饰。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A seventeen-year-old wolf beastfolk girl in light aspect: human face with silver-grey wolf ears and tail. Lean, a little taller than average. Messy short silver-grey hair with one thin braid hung with a wolf fang and a small copper bell, pale gold eyes. Forest green leather hunting gear #3f5a3a with a short cape and leather bracers #8a6a4a, tribal tattoos on her bare forearms, a longbow on her back, a hunting knife and a wolf-tail charm at her belt. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：憋笑：抿着嘴，耳朵竖起，尾巴在身后慢摆。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: holding back a laugh: lips pressed, ears up, tail swaying slowly behind.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 狼耳与狼尾是剪影特征，在 28 像素高时也要认得出；狼牙与铜铃在细辫那一侧。

subject.zh: 二十四岁的人族青年，中等身材偏瘦长，习惯缩着肩。棕色乱发，满脸雀斑，褐色眼睛，神情紧张又可靠。不太合身的二手皮甲 #6a5a44，脖子上一条褪色的蓝毛线围巾 #5a7a9a，左臂缠满五色护符，左手一面坑坑洼洼的旧铁圆盾，腰挂铜牌与短剑。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A twenty-four-year-old human young man, medium build on the lanky side, shoulders habitually hunched. Messy brown hair, a face full of freckles, brown eyes, nervous yet dependable. Ill-fitting second-hand leather armor #6a5a44, a faded blue knitted scarf #5a7a9a around his neck, his left arm wrapped in charms of five colors, a dented old iron round shield on his left arm, a copper tag and a short sword at his belt. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：苦着脸嘴硬：眉毛下垂，嘴角硬撑着。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a pained but stubborn face: drooping brows, mouth forcing a brave line.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 围巾是褪色的蓝，不要画成鲜蓝；盾与护符都在左臂。

subject.zh: 二十七岁、看着更年轻的狐族兽人女子，浅相：赤狐耳，蓬松大尾，尾尖白。身形纤细。橙红长发松松挽起，琥珀色狐狸眼笑眯眯。墨绿商人外套配金扣 #2e4a3a、#c8a24a，腰间一串算珠形计数珠，指间翻转着一枚旧金币，算账时戴半月形眼镜。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A fox beastfolk woman of twenty-seven who looks younger, light aspect: red fox ears and a big fluffy tail with a white tip. Slender. Orange-red long hair loosely pinned up, smiling amber fox eyes. Dark green merchant coat with gold buttons #2e4a3a, #c8a24a, a string of abacus-bead counters at her waist, a worn gold coin flipping between her fingers, half-moon spectacles for bookkeeping. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：眯眼算计的笑，半月形眼镜滑到鼻尖。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a narrow-eyed calculating smile, the half-moon spectacles slid down to her nose tip.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 狐耳尖、白色尾尖要清楚，别画成猫耳；金币小而亮。

subject.zh: 七十一岁的人族老婆婆，瘦小，背微驼，满脸皱纹，灰绿眼睛眼神锐利。乱蓬蓬的白发用草绳束起。粗布裙 #5a4a3a 配打满补丁的苔绿围裙 #3a5a3a，口袋里塞满草药，脚踩木屐。拄一根藤杖，杖头住着一窝麻雀。慈和而固执。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A seventy-one-year-old human granny, small and thin, slightly stooped, deeply wrinkled, sharp grey-green eyes. Unruly white hair tied with straw cord. Coarse cloth skirt #5a4a3a with a heavily patched moss green apron #3a5a3a, pockets stuffed with herbs, wooden clogs. She leans on a vine staff with a nest of sparrows living at its head. Kind but obstinate. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：眯着眼看穿人的锐利目光，嘴角似笑非笑。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a sharp squint that sees right through you, a half smile.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 不给她花冠、赤足或任何鹿与狼的元素；麻雀只是杖头的小点。

subject.zh: 二十六岁的人族年轻神父，高瘦，站姿笔直。金发剪得一丝不苟，浅蓝眼睛，神情真诚而紧绷。熨得笔挺的白色神父袍 #e8e2d0，袖口打着补丁，胸前挂光环几何纹的圣徽，浅金与灰蓝点缀 #c8a84a、#7a8aa0，手里一本翻烂、夹满书签的圣典。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A twenty-six-year-old human young priest, tall and thin with a straight back. Neatly trimmed blond hair, pale blue eyes, sincere but tense. A crisply pressed white priest's robe #e8e2d0 with patched cuffs, a holy symbol of geometric halo design on his chest, pale gold and grey-blue accents #c8a84a, #7a8aa0, a battered scripture stuffed with bookmarks in his hand. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：等待回应的祈求：仰头，眼神渴望又不安。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a plea awaiting an answer: face upturned, eyes longing and uneasy.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 袍子白而旧，袖口的补丁一定要在；圣典上没有字。

subject.zh: 四十九岁的人族女人，高大结实，小臂粗壮带烫伤疤。深红短发夹着白丝，左颊一道旧刀疤，笑起来很爽朗，深褐眼睛。袖子挽起，酒红衬衫 #8a3a2a 外是旧皮甲改的束腰与深棕围裙 #5a3a2a，手里拿着酒杯与擦布，围裙下藏一把宽刃长刀。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A forty-nine-year-old human woman, tall and sturdy with thick, burn-scarred forearms. Short dark red hair streaked with white, an old blade scar on her left cheek, a hearty laugh, dark brown eyes. Sleeves rolled up, wine red shirt #8a3a2a under a bodice cut from old leather armor and a dark brown apron #5a3a2a, a tankard and polishing cloth in hand, a broad-bladed long sword hidden under the apron. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：仰头张口的爽朗大笑。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a hearty head-thrown-back laugh.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 刀疤在左颊；刀平时藏在围裙下，只在攻击、战斗待机与受击里出鞘。

subject.zh: 四十六岁却像六十岁的人族老汉，粗壮，秃顶，灰色络腮胡，酒糟鼻，眯缝的灰眼睛。褪色的公会蓝旧制服 #4a5a7a，纽扣扣错一颗，右臂只剩空袖子别在肩上。左臂夹一本厚得夸张的登记簿，腰挂酒壶 #7a5a3a。粗声粗气。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A human man of forty-six who looks sixty: burly, bald, a grey full beard, a drinker's red nose, squinting grey eyes. A faded guild-blue old uniform #4a5a7a buttoned one hole off, the empty right sleeve pinned to his shoulder. An absurdly thick register clamped under his left arm, a flask #7a5a3a at his belt. Gruff and loud. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：醉醺醺地眯眼打嗝。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a tipsy squinting hiccup.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 空袖在右侧，所有动作都用左手；左向镜像后若换边，由导入工具出修正件。

subject.zh: 骸骨守门人：人形骨架，眼眶里两点灰蓝冷火。披一件褪成灰白的古朴亚麻长袍 #c8c4b8，额骨上嵌一枚铜绿色的门形铜饰 #5a8a7a，指骨间夹一支芦苇笔，身上落着灰。炭黑、冷蓝、铜绿。安静而压迫。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A skeletal gatekeeper: a human skeleton with two points of cold grey-blue fire in its eye sockets. An antique linen robe faded to ash white #c8c4b8, a verdigris door-shaped copper ornament #5a8a7a set into the brow bone, a reed pen held between finger bones, ash settled on him. Charcoal, cold blue, verdigris. Quiet and oppressive. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：眼眶里的冷火骤然变亮。骸骨没有脸部肌肉，表情靠冷火的大小与亮度、下颌开合和头的角度区分。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: the cold fire in his eye sockets flaring bright. A skeleton has no facial muscles: express emotions through the size and brightness of the eye fires, the jaw and the head angle.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 是骸骨，不是活人；身边与袍子上不出现任何字。

subject.zh: 三十九岁的人族匪首，粗壮精悍，晒黑的方脸，右眼戴黑皮眼罩，左眼是凶狠的灰褐色，下巴满是胡茬，深棕短发剃得很短。锈褐色钉甲 #6a4a32 外披破旧灰斗篷 #5a5a52，腰缠粗皮带，右手一把单手劈斧，斧背沾着灰。狠，但讲规矩。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thirty-nine-year-old human bandit chief, thickset and hard: a sunburnt square face, a black leather patch over his right eye, a fierce grey-brown left eye, heavy stubble, dark brown hair cropped short. Rust-brown studded brigandine #6a4a32 under a ragged grey cloak #5a5a52, a thick leather belt, a one-handed cleaver axe in his right hand, ash on its back edge. Ruthless but bound by his own rules. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：独眼眯起的狞笑。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a menacing grin with his one eye narrowed.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 眼罩在右眼；左向镜像后若换边，由导入工具出修正件。

subject.zh: 四十四岁的人族代官，中年发福，圆脸油亮，两撇修过的小胡子，黑发抹油梳得服帖，小而精的黑眼睛。紫红丝绒外套 #5a2a4a 镶金边 #c8a84a，胸前一条粗金链，手指戴印戒，捏着一块手帕。圆滑胆小又要体面。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A forty-four-year-old human magistrate, gone soft in middle age: a round shiny face, a neatly trimmed little moustache, oiled black hair combed flat, small sharp black eyes. A plum velvet coat #5a2a4a with gold trim #c8a84a, a heavy gold chain on his chest, signet rings, a handkerchief pinched in his fingers. Slippery and timid but keen on appearances. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：假笑：嘴角咧开，眼睛却在打量对方的钱袋。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a fake smile: mouth stretched wide while his eyes size up your purse.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 他不打架，受击与倒地的动作要显得狼狈；金链与印戒是他的辨识点。

subject.zh: 二十七岁的人族女审判官，修长挺拔。银白短发齐耳切平，灰色瞳孔，神情冷静。白银甲胄外罩纯白长披风 #eceef2，披风内衬绣细密的光环几何纹，左手戴刻满细纹的黑铁手套，腰佩细长刺剑，胸前天平徽章，挂一点朱红封蜡 #b8302a。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A twenty-seven-year-old human inquisitor, tall and poised. Silver-white hair cut straight at the ears, grey eyes, a calm expression. Silver plate under a long pure white cloak #eceef2 whose lining is embroidered with fine geometric halo patterns, a black iron gauntlet covered in fine engraving on her left hand, a slender rapier at her hip, a scales badge on her chest with a dab of vermilion sealing wax #b8302a. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：冷峻的审视：灰眼睛微微眯起。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a stern appraisal: grey eyes slightly narrowed.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 铁手套在左手，刺剑在右手；手套上的纹路只是花纹，不是文字。

subject.zh: 十九岁的少年勇者，精瘦，肩膀正在长宽。黑色短发利落，额前一缕翘发，黑眼睛明亮。白金色勇者铠 #e8e8f0，胸甲有光环纹，正红披风 #c8282a，深蓝内衬 #2a3a6a，手持剑身带光纹的圣剑，左手腕戴一只没电的黑色运动手环。热血真诚。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A nineteen-year-old young hero, lean with shoulders still filling out. Neat short black hair with one cowlick at the front, bright black eyes. White-gold hero armor #e8e8f0 with a halo pattern on the breastplate, a true red cape #c8282a, deep blue lining #2a3a6a, a holy sword with glowing lines along the blade, a dead black fitness band on his left wrist. Hot-blooded and sincere. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：握拳的热血自信笑。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a fired-up confident grin with a raised fist.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 运动手环在左手腕，纯黑，没有任何字母与标志。

subject.zh: 十七岁的少女圣女，娇小。黑色长直发，齐刘海，系一条白缎带，黑眼睛温柔。纯白圣女长袍 #f4f4f8 镶天蓝边 #7ab0e0，淡金点缀，胸前挂一只小巧的护士表，手持顶端为光环的短杖，腰间别一本手写笔记。温柔认真。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A seventeen-year-old girl saint, petite. Long straight black hair with blunt bangs tied with a white satin ribbon, gentle black eyes. A pure white saint's robe #f4f4f8 with sky blue edging #7ab0e0 and pale gold accents, a small nurse's watch pinned to her chest, a short staff topped with a halo, a handwritten notebook at her waist. Gentle and earnest. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：强忍泪水的微笑。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a smile holding back tears.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 护士表与笔记本上没有字；治疗的光晕由特效层画，不画进素材。

subject.zh: 二十四岁的人族青年学者，高瘦，背微驼。浅棕卷发乱糟糟，下巴有胡茬，细框眼镜的一片镜片有裂纹，灰蓝眼睛总在盯着人看。深蓝贤者长袍 #2a3a6a 里穿灰色高领毛衣 #8a8a90，铜扣点缀，手里一本皮面笔记本与一支圆珠笔。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A twenty-four-year-old human scholar, tall, thin and slightly stooped. Messy light brown curls, stubble on his chin, thin-rimmed glasses with one cracked lens, grey-blue eyes that always study people. A deep blue sage's robe #2a3a6a over a grey turtleneck sweater #8a8a90, copper buttons, a leather-bound notebook and a ballpoint pen in hand. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：想到答案时眼睛一亮。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: eyes lighting up as the answer clicks.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 裂纹在左边镜片；笔记本上不写字；圆珠笔是这个世界没有的东西，画成一支细长的笔即可。

subject.zh: 三十一岁的人族壮汉，高大魁梧，深棕皮肤，剃短的黑发，修剪整齐的胡子，笑起来一口白牙，深褐眼睛，左前臂有烧伤疤。白银重甲 #c8ccd4，腰间系一条褪色的亮橙反光带 #e8782a，左手持正面浮雕光环的塔盾，背包上挂一顶旧消防头盔。Q 版约 1.8 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thirty-one-year-old human giant of a man, tall and broad: deep brown skin, buzzed black hair, a neatly trimmed beard, a bright white smile, dark brown eyes, a burn scar on his left forearm. Silver-white heavy plate #c8ccd4, a faded bright orange reflective band #e8782a tied at his waist, a tower shield embossed with a halo on his left arm, an old firefighter's helmet hanging from his pack. Chibi about 1.8 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：露出一口白牙的爽朗大哥笑。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a big-brother laugh showing white teeth.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 橙色反光带是他唯一的亮橙色；盾面光环熄灭的那一帧由渲染层压暗光环色样实现，不另出图。

subject.zh: 外表七十来岁的人族老船夫，瘦而精悍，晒成皮革色的皮肤，白发扎成短马尾，浅灰绿眼睛，眼角纹路深。褪色的蓝布衣 #4a6a8a，宽檐草帽 #c8b070，腰挂酒葫芦，腰后用油布裹着一把普通铁剑，手持一根长篙。神情懒散。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A human ferryman who looks about seventy, lean and wiry: skin tanned like leather, white hair in a short ponytail, pale grey-green eyes with deep crow's feet. Faded blue cloth clothes #4a6a8a, a wide-brimmed straw hat #c8b070, a gourd flask at his belt, a plain iron sword wrapped in oilcloth at the small of his back, a long punting pole in hand. Easygoing and lazy-looking. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：眯眼哼歌的悠然神情。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a relaxed squint while humming a tune.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 草帽的宽檐要压得住剪影；铁剑平时裹在油布里挂在腰后，只在近战时露出。

subject.zh: 三十岁的人族贵族长子，身形端正，一丝不苟的金棕短发，浅褐眼睛，神情严肃。白底金纹的贵族礼服 #f0f0e8、#c8a040，外披短斗篷，胸前的圣徽比别人大一号，腰佩长剑，戴洁白手套。站姿笔挺，守礼而刻板。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thirty-year-old human noble heir with an upright bearing, meticulously combed golden-brown short hair, light brown eyes, a stern face. A white noble's coat with gold patterns #f0f0e8, #c8a040, a short cape, a holy symbol on his chest one size larger than anyone else's, a longsword at his hip, spotless white gloves. Rigidly proper. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：皱眉训诫的神情。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a frowning, admonishing look.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 圣徽要比常人的大一号；礼服与手套始终干净。

subject.zh: 二十六岁的人族贵族次女，利落干练。栗色长发编成实用的发髻，深绿眼睛透着急性子。学院式的深色长裙 #2a5a4a 配墨蓝短外套 #2a3a6a，胸前一枚算盘形胸针，袖口沾着墨迹，手里卷着一沓账单。精明急躁。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A twenty-six-year-old human noble daughter, brisk and capable. Chestnut hair braided into a practical bun, dark green eyes full of impatience. An academy-style dark green long dress #2a5a4a with an ink-blue short jacket #2a3a6a, an abacus-shaped brooch on her chest, ink stains on her cuffs, a roll of invoices in her hand. Sharp and hot-tempered. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：打断别人时的急躁：挑眉，抬手。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: impatient interruption: eyebrows up, a raised hand.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 账单与胸针上没有字与数字。

subject.zh: 二十三岁的人族青年军官，结实，晒黑的脸上有晒伤与笑纹，黑色短发，深褐眼睛。军灰色军装 #5a5a5a 常年敞着领口，皮革棕的腰带与护腕 #7a5a3a，腰佩一把制式长剑，靴子沾泥。豪爽大嗓门。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A twenty-three-year-old human young officer, solidly built: a tanned face with sunburn and laugh lines, short black hair, dark brown eyes. A military grey uniform #5a5a5a always open at the collar, leather brown belt and bracers #7a5a3a, a standard-issue longsword at his hip, muddy boots. Boisterous and loud. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：提到出身时的自嘲苦笑。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a self-mocking wry smile when his birth comes up.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 不画任何兽人特征。

subject.zh: 四十出头的人族男子，瘦削，颧骨突出，下巴尖，深陷的灰眼睛里有求知的狂热。黑发夹白，向后束成短辫。灰黑学者长外套 #2e2e36，领口别一枚磨损的旧徽章，指尖有灼伤的暗痕，手里把玩一枚淡青色的录晶 #8ac8c8。冷淡而专注。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A human man in his early forties, gaunt, with sharp cheekbones and a pointed chin, deep-set grey eyes burning with hunger for knowledge. Black hair streaked with white, tied back in a short tail. A charcoal scholar's long coat #2e2e36, a worn old badge at the collar, dark burn marks on his fingertips, turning a pale cyan recording crystal #8ac8c8 in his fingers. Cool and focused. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：求知的狂热，眼睛发亮。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a scholar's fervor, eyes gleaming.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 录晶是淡青色，不用澱紫；徽章上没有字。

subject.zh: 七十四岁的人族老王，枯瘦，久病，长长的白须，深陷的眼窝里是清醒的灰蓝眼睛。褪色的王室蓝睡袍外披象牙白毛皮边斗篷 #3a4a7a、#e8e0cc，头上一圈素金细冠。气若游丝，却仍有骑士的气度。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A seventy-four-year-old human king, emaciated and long ill: a long white beard, clear grey-blue eyes in sunken sockets. A faded royal blue nightrobe under an ivory fur-trimmed mantle #3a4a7a, #e8e0cc, a thin plain gold circlet. Barely breathing, yet still carrying himself like a knight. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：疲惫而清醒的愧色：眼神低垂，眉间紧锁。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: weary, lucid remorse: eyes lowered, brows knitted.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 床头的骑士剑是场景道具，不画在人物身上；他多数时候在床上，动作要显得虚弱。

subject.zh: 二十八岁的人族王太子，清秀单薄，浅亚麻色软发，浅灰蓝眼睛，神情犹豫，总在咬指甲。衣着整洁却不合身，像借来的：浅蓝外套 #8aa8c8 袖子太长，银色纽扣与肩饰 #c0c4cc，胸前一枚小小的王室纹章。软弱而善良。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A twenty-eight-year-old human crown prince, delicate and slight: soft flaxen hair, pale grey-blue eyes, a hesitant expression, always biting his nails. Neat clothes that do not fit, as if borrowed: a pale blue coat #8aa8c8 with sleeves too long, silver buttons and epaulettes #c0c4cc, a small royal crest on his chest. Weak-willed but kind. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：不敢做决定的慌乱：眉毛上扬，嘴唇紧抿。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: panic at having to decide: eyebrows raised, lips pressed tight.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 衣服要看得出不合身：袖子长，肩线垮。

subject.zh: 五十八岁的人族宰相，圆润体面，银灰头发向后梳得油亮，右眼戴单片眼镜，浅褐眼睛，嘴角挂着圆滑的笑。深紫丝绒长外套 #4a2a5a 配金扣 #c8a040，领巾雪白，指间一枚刻着秤纹的印戒。精明而怯懦。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A fifty-eight-year-old human chancellor, portly and well-groomed: silver-grey hair slicked back, a monocle in his right eye, light brown eyes, a smooth smile. A deep purple velvet long coat #4a2a5a with gold buttons #c8a040, a snow-white cravat, a signet ring engraved with a scales emblem. Shrewd and cowardly. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：圆滑的假笑，单片眼镜反光。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a smooth fake smile with a glint on the monocle.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 单片眼镜在右眼；印戒上是秤的图形，不是字。

subject.zh: 三十二岁的人族女拳手将军，高挑精壮，深红短发向后梳，左眉一道疤把眉毛断开，深褐眼睛带着战意，下颌左侧挂一枚染红的魔物獠牙耳坠。黑红轻甲 #1e1a1a、#8a1c22，不戴头盔，双手缠拳击绷带，戴一对铁拳套 #6a6a70。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thirty-two-year-old human woman boxer general, tall and hard-muscled: dark red short hair swept back, a scar that splits her left eyebrow, dark brown eyes full of fight, a blood-red monster fang earring hanging at the left of her jaw. Black and red light armor #1e1a1a, #8a1c22, no helmet, boxing wraps on both hands under a pair of iron fist gauntlets #6a6a70. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：挑战者的冷笑：一边嘴角上扬，眼神锁定对方。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a challenger's smirk: one corner of the mouth up, eyes locked on the opponent.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 眉疤在左眉，獠牙耳坠在左侧；她不用兵器，只用拳。

subject.zh: 年过半百的人族大审判长，高大清瘦，脸颊凹陷，铁灰头发剪得极短，浅灰眼睛冷而平静。灰色审判长外袍 #6a6a6e 罩在白银板甲上，肩披灰色短披肩，胸前天平徽章，腰挂一柄带翼缘的钉头锤 #8a8a90。冷酷而高效。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A human grand inquisitor past fifty, tall and gaunt with hollow cheeks, iron-grey hair cropped very short, cold and calm pale grey eyes. A grey inquisitor's surcoat #6a6a6e over silver plate, a short grey capelet, a scales badge on the chest, a flanged mace #8a8a90 at his belt. Cold and efficient. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：毫无动摇的冷漠。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: utterly unmoved coldness.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 他的外袍是灰色，不是审判官的纯白；徽章上是天平图形。

subject.zh: 四十五岁的人族富商，中等身高，微胖，深色头发梳得一丝不苟，鬓角灰白，金丝眼镜后是深褐眼睛，嘴角带着精明的笑。炭灰三件套西装 #3a3a3e 配酒红领带 #7a1e2a，背心口袋垂着怀表金链，头上歪戴一顶小小的金冠 #d8b040，手里转着一支钢笔。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A forty-five-year-old human magnate, medium height and a little plump: dark hair combed immaculately with grey temples, dark brown eyes behind gold-rimmed glasses, a shrewd smile. A charcoal three-piece suit #3a3a3e with a wine red tie #7a1e2a, a pocket watch chain at the vest, a tiny gold crown #d8b040 perched askew on his head, twirling a fountain pen. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：签约成功的满意微笑，笔尖亮起一点金光。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a satisfied deal-closed smile, a gold glint at the pen nib.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 西装剪裁像地球的三件套，在这个世界里很显眼；金冠很小，歪戴；怀表表盘没有数字。

subject.zh: 五十八岁的人族皇帝，高大魁伟，铁灰短发与短须，灰色眼睛沉稳，左手小指缺了半截。朴素的黑铁战甲 #2e2e30，披帝国紫披风 #5a2a6a，银色铆钉，腰佩一把毫无装饰的长剑，剑柄上随手挂着帝冠。Q 版约 1.8 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A fifty-eight-year-old human emperor, tall and massive: iron-grey short hair and short beard, steady grey eyes, the left little finger missing its upper half. Plain black iron battle armor #2e2e30 with silver rivets under an imperial purple cape #5a2a6a, a completely unadorned longsword at his hip with the imperial crown hung carelessly on its hilt. Chibi about 1.8 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：认可强者时的短促一笑。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a brief smile of respect for a worthy opponent.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 缺的是左手小指的上半截；帝冠挂在剑柄上，不戴在头上。

subject.zh: 外表三十来岁的夜魔女子，修长，灰蓝苍白肤色，黑色眼白配新月形银色瞳孔，额上一对后弯细角，长及脚踝的黑发像夜色般微微漂浮。深紫与黑的宫廷长裙 #3a2048、#141218，肩披星点刺绣薄纱，手持银色摄政权杖，腰挂皮绳缠住的旧手记。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A night demon woman who looks about thirty, tall and slender: pale grey-blue skin, black sclera with crescent-shaped silver pupils, a pair of thin horns curving back from her forehead, ankle-length black hair drifting like flowing night. A deep purple and black court gown #3a2048, #141218, a sheer star-embroidered veil over her shoulders, a silver regent's scepter in hand, an old journal bound with leather cord at her waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：若有所思的冷淡微笑，银瞳半垂。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a pensive, cool smile, silver eyes half lowered.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 黑发长及脚踝，动作帧里也不要剪短；角是后掠的细角。

subject.zh: 千岁的精灵长老，极高极瘦，长耳向后上方斜伸，银白长发几乎拖地、发梢仍带苔绿，皮肤上有树皮般的细纹，太阳穴有多圈浅色年轮纹，浅绿眼睛。灰绿长老袍 #7a8a72，左耳挂一枚暗铜色的古旧门形耳坠，手持一根抽着新芽的白木杖。Q 版约 1.8 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thousand-year-old elf elder, extremely tall and thin: long ears sweeping up and back, silver-white hair nearly trailing the ground with moss green still at the tips, skin finely lined like bark, many pale growth-ring marks at the temples, pale green eyes. A grey-green elder's robe #7a8a72, an ancient dark bronze door-shaped earring in his left ear, a white wooden staff sprouting new shoots. Chibi about 1.8 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：沉入久远回忆的哀伤。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: sorrow sinking into long-ago memories.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 门形耳坠在左耳，暗铜色，不发光；精灵长耳是剪影特征。

subject.zh: 三十来岁的长角部兽人女萨满，浅相：人脸，一对弯如新月的乳白长角缠着彩绳，垂着的短毛兽耳，健美。深褐长发编成多股细辫，琥珀色眼睛沉静。赭红毡袍 #8a3a2a 配天蓝饰带 #5a8ac8，左肩披满骨饰与彩绘，胸前挂骨串，手持一根挂铃的骨杖。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A horned-tribe beastfolk shaman woman around thirty, light aspect: human face, a pair of milk-white horns curved like crescent moons and wound with colored cords, short furred drooping beast ears, athletic. Dark brown hair in many thin braids, calm amber eyes. A rust-red felt robe #8a3a2a with sky blue sashes #5a8ac8, her left shoulder covered in bone ornaments and painted patterns, a bone necklace, a bone staff hung with bells. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：听见祖灵时出神的神情。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a faraway look as if hearing the ancestors.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 左肩始终被骨饰与彩绘覆盖；角是新月形，彩绳不同色。

subject.zh: 八十多岁的人族教皇，瘦削而挺直，满头雪白短发，白眉长垂，淡蓝眼睛温和而疲惫，脸上皱纹深。层叠的白石色教袍 #f2efe6 绣着金色光环几何纹 #d0b060，肩披金边长披肩，头戴顶端是几何光环的白色高冠，手持光环权杖。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A human pope in his eighties, thin but upright: snow-white short hair, long drooping white eyebrows, gentle and tired pale blue eyes, a deeply lined face. Layered white-stone colored vestments #f2efe6 embroidered with gold geometric halos #d0b060, a long gold-edged stole, a tall white mitre topped with a geometric halo, a halo scepter in hand. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：聆听神谕时的恍惚与虔诚。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: dazed devotion while listening to an oracle.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 高冠与权杖的顶端都是几何光环，不用十字或其他宗教符号。

subject.zh: 鬼人大诸侯，比常人高出一头多，肌肉夸张，赭红色厚皮，额上两支粗黑角，左角上刻着一道道胜痕，下颌短獠牙，黄褐眼睛凶悍。泛着红锈的夜铁重甲 #2a2a2e、#8a3a22，肩甲宽大，披黑熊皮，双手握一柄赤铁大斧。傲慢好战。Q 版约 1.8 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: An oni demon high lord, a head and more taller than an ordinary man, exaggerated muscles: thick ochre-red hide, two heavy black horns on his brow with notches of victory cut into the left one, short tusks in his lower jaw, fierce yellow-brown eyes. Night-iron heavy armor with red rust #2a2a2e, #8a3a22, huge pauldrons, a black bear pelt, a red iron great axe gripped in both hands. Arrogant and warlike. Chibi about 1.8 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：露出獠牙的嗜战狞笑。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a bloodthirsty grin baring his tusks.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 高大体型：帧内本体约 33 到 35 像素，比标准人形高；角上的胜痕只是刻痕，不是文字。

subject.zh: 一只小乌鸦，比家鸽略小，羽毛墨黑、羽尖带灰白，左侧头顶一撮白羽，左眼琥珀色，右眼黑色。爪上套着细小的爪形铁片，脖子上系一枚钥孔形小铜饰。动作快而突然，常歪着头。
subject.en: A small crow, a little smaller than a pigeon: ink-black feathers with ash-white tips, a tuft of white feathers on the left side of its head, left eye amber and right eye black. Tiny claw-shaped iron caps on its talons, a little keyhole-shaped copper charm tied at its neck. Quick, sudden movements, often tilting its head.

extra.zh: 这是小乌鸦的头像，头与颈入画；四种表情用歪头、炸毛、眯眼与缩脖来表现。右眼瞳孔是细长的钥孔形。
extra.en: This is the portrait of a small crow, head and neck in frame; show the four moods through head tilt, ruffled feathers, narrowed eyes and a hunched neck. The right pupil is a slender keyhole shape.

items.notes: 附小鸦形态三视图作参照；四格只有神态变化。 这是夜羽的状态变体：鸟形，不是人形；白羽与琥珀色眼睛都在它自己的左侧。

subject.zh: 十九岁的少年剑士，精瘦，黑色短发凌乱，额前一缕翘发，黑眼睛疲惫却清醒。卸下了红披风，白金铠甲满是划痕与灰尘 #c8c8cc，胸甲的光环纹磨暗了，深蓝内衬 #2a3a6a 露在外面，握一把普通钢剑，左手腕仍戴着没电的黑色运动手环。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A nineteen-year-old young swordsman, lean, short black hair in disarray with one cowlick, tired but clear black eyes. The red cape is gone; his white-gold armor is scratched and dusty #c8c8cc, the halo pattern on the breastplate worn dull, the deep blue lining #2a3a6a showing, a plain steel sword in hand, the dead black fitness band still on his left wrist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：疲惫却第一次轻松的笑。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a tired but, for once, unburdened smile.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 这是陆辰的状态变体：没有红披风，没有圣剑；运动手环仍在左腕。

subject.zh: 十七岁的少女圣女被光托起的模样：娇小，黑色长直发与齐刘海被光吹起，白缎带飘散，眼睛变成白金色、没有焦点。纯白圣女长袍 #f4f4f8 镶天蓝边，胸前挂护士表，背后浮着缓慢转动的几何纹光环 #e8dca0，双脚离地。神情空白。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A seventeen-year-old girl saint lifted by light: petite, her long straight black hair and blunt bangs blown upward, the white ribbon streaming loose, her eyes turned white-gold and unfocused. Pure white saint's robe #f4f4f8 with sky blue edging, the nurse's watch on her chest, a slowly turning geometric halo #e8dca0 floating behind her, feet off the ground. A blank expression. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：空洞的白金色眼睛直视前方。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: empty white-gold eyes staring straight ahead.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 这是白石结衣的状态变体：眼睛是白金色、没有焦点；双脚始终离地。

subject.zh: 在现实里现身的高挑女人：深褐长发，左半张脸带着温柔的笑，暖琥珀色眼睛，右半边身体化作一道暖金色的门框 #f0d890，门框里是幽暗的空。深夜蓝长袍 #262c48 只裹住另一半身体，腰间挂满大小不一的旧钥匙。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A tall woman appearing in the waking world: dark brown hair, the left half of her face smiling gently with a warm amber eye, the right half of her body turned into a warm gold door frame #f0d890 with dim emptiness inside it. A midnight blue robe #262c48 wraps only the other half of her body, old keys of every size hanging at her waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 8 格的角色专属表情：半张脸带笑、半边是门框的凝视。
extra.en: Panel 8 is the character's signature expression: a gaze with half a smiling face and half a door frame.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 这是门口的女人的状态变体：门框始终在她右半边；不出现任何名字与文字。

subject.zh: 十九岁的人族少女，个子小巧，圆脸，鼻尖几点雀斑。姜橙色短发别两枚铜发夹，榛褐色眼睛，嘴角挂着刚听到新鲜事的笑。公会制式的蓝色短外套 #5a7aa0 配白衬领 #e0e0e0，胸前别盾形铜徽，耳后夹一支羽笔。
subject.en: A petite nineteen-year-old human girl with a round face and a few freckles on her nose. Short ginger-orange hair held by two copper clips, hazel eyes, the smile of someone who just heard fresh gossip. Guild-issue blue short jacket #5a7aa0 with a white collar #e0e0e0, a small shield-shaped copper badge on the chest, a quill tucked behind one ear.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 接待员的亲切感在中性表情里也要看得出；羽笔别画成发饰。

subject.zh: 六十六岁的人族老文书，干瘦，背有点弓，脸窄而刻板，眉间一道竖纹。稀疏的白发梳得整整齐齐，厚圆镜片后是眯着的灰眼睛。深石板色旧外套 #3a3a4a 配灰褐袖套 #8a8a7a，领口夹一支鹅毛笔，指尖沾墨。一丝不苟。
subject.en: A sixty-six-year-old human clerk, thin and slightly stooped, a narrow stern face with a vertical crease between the brows. Thin white hair combed very neatly, squinting grey eyes behind thick round lenses. A dark slate old coat #3a3a4a with grey-brown sleeve guards #8a8a7a, a goose quill clipped at the collar, ink on his fingertips. Meticulous.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 近视的厚镜片是辨识点，四种表情都戴着眼镜。

subject.zh: 二十四岁的人族年轻修女，纤细，鹅蛋脸，眉眼温顺，嘴角总带一点不安。深炭色修女服 #2a2a3a 配白头巾与白领 #e8e8e8，头巾边露出几缕栗色头发，浅褐眼睛低垂，胸前挂一枚小小的木制圣徽。温柔胆怯。
subject.en: A twenty-four-year-old human young nun, slender with an oval face, mild features and a touch of unease at the corners of her mouth. A dark charcoal habit #2a2a3a with a white wimple and collar #e8e8e8, a few chestnut strands escaping the wimple, downcast light brown eyes, a small wooden holy symbol on her chest. Gentle and timid.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她是助祭，不是高阶神职：衣服朴素，没有金饰。

subject.zh: 六十三岁的人族敲钟老人，瘦长，肩背结实，满脸风霜的皱纹，一只耳朵里塞着一小团棉絮。灰白短发乱翘，一双灰褐小眼睛在悄悄打量人。褐色粗呢工作服 #5a4a3a 外套旧皮背心 #8a7a6a，肩上搭一圈钟绳。沉默寡言。
subject.en: A sixty-three-year-old human bell ringer, long and lean with strong shoulders, a weathered wrinkled face, a little tuft of cotton stuffed in one ear. Messy grey-white short hair, small grey-brown eyes quietly watching people. A brown coarse wool work smock #5a4a3a under an old leather vest #8a7a6a, a coil of bell rope over his shoulder. Silent and taciturn.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 耳朵里的棉絮是他装聋的小道具，要画出来。

subject.zh: 五十八岁的人族寡妇，矮胖结实，下巴紧绷，嘴角向下，灰蓝眼睛总在挑别人的错。灰白头发盘成紧紧的髻，罩着黑色蕾丝头巾。黑色寡妇长裙 #3a3a3a 配深褐披肩 #6a5a4a，胸前挂一枚擦得发亮的铜圣徽，手里攥着一串念珠。
subject.en: A fifty-eight-year-old human widow, short and stout, a tight jaw and downturned mouth, grey-blue eyes always looking for someone's fault. Grey-white hair in a tight bun under a black lace kerchief. A black widow's dress #3a3a3a with a dark brown shawl #6a5a4a, a polished copper holy symbol on her chest, prayer beads clutched in her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她代表镇上的虔诚压力：神情严厉，不要画成慈祥。

subject.zh: 五十五岁的人族孤儿院院长，微胖，圆脸上有操劳的细纹，笑容慈爱又疲惫，浅褐眼睛下有黑眼圈。灰发挽成低髻，几缕散在耳边。灰紫色旧长裙 #6a5a7a 系米色围裙 #d8c8b0，围裙口袋里露出针线与一只小木哨。
subject.en: A fifty-five-year-old human orphanage matron, a bit plump, a round face lined with toil, a loving but tired smile, light brown eyes with dark circles. Grey hair in a low bun, a few strands loose by her ears. An old dusty purple dress #6a5a7a with a beige apron #d8c8b0, needle, thread and a small wooden whistle peeking from the apron pocket.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她是十四个孩子的妈：神情温暖但累；灰紫色偏暖，不要画成暗紫。

subject.zh: 八岁的男孩，瘦小，脸色苍白，眼神安静早熟，总微微眯着眼，像怕光。黑得发蓝的短发 #2a2a3a 剪得参差，深灰眼睛。洗得发白的灰蓝孤儿院罩衫 #5a5a6a，袖子长过手背，脖子上围一条旧灰围巾。不爱说话。
subject.en: An eight-year-old boy, small and thin, pale, with a quiet, too-old gaze, always squinting slightly as if light hurt. Uneven short hair so black it looks blue #2a2a3a, dark grey eyes. A washed-out grey-blue orphanage smock #5a5a6a with sleeves past the backs of his hands, an old grey scarf around his neck. Hardly speaks.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 孩子的脸更圆更小；袖子盖住手背，不画任何纹路。

subject.zh: 五岁的小女孩，圆嘟嘟的脸，缺了一颗门牙，笑起来眼睛弯成两道缝。深棕头发扎成两个歪歪的小辫，系着褪色的粉布条，褐色大眼睛。打着补丁的粉灰色旧罩衫 #c8a0b0，领口别一朵布做的小花。爱笑黏人。
subject.en: A five-year-old little girl with a chubby face and a missing front tooth, eyes curving into slits when she laughs. Dark brown hair in two crooked pigtails tied with faded pink rags, big brown eyes. A patched dusty pink old smock #c8a0b0 with a little cloth flower pinned at the collar. Giggly and clingy.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 缺的门牙是她的辨识点；不画任何纹路或胎记。

subject.zh: 八十四岁的矮人铁匠，方形身板，肩宽几乎等于身高的一半，一双大手满是老茧。铁锈红长须编成三股粗辫，缀着铁环，浓眉压着火光下会反光的褐眼，脸颊有细小的铁灰矿纹。焦褐皮围裙 #6a3a2a 罩着黑衬衫 #3a3a3a，肩扛锻锤。
subject.en: An eighty-four-year-old dwarf blacksmith with a square frame, shoulders nearly half his height across, huge calloused hands. A rust-red long beard in three thick braids hung with iron rings, bushy brows over brown eyes that catch the light like a cat's, fine iron-grey ore flecks on his cheeks. A scorched brown leather apron #6a3a2a over a black shirt #3a3a3a, a forging hammer on his shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 矮人的方形剪影与编辫长须是辨识点；矿纹是细小的金属色斑点。

subject.zh: 三十八岁的人族伐木场工头，膀大腰圆，晒得黝黑，下巴一圈粗硬的黑胡子，眉骨高，一道旧斧疤横过鼻梁，深褐眼睛带着火气。红褐格子粗布衬衫 #7a4a2a 卷着袖子，外罩橄榄褐皮背心 #5a5a3a，肩上扛一把双刃伐木斧。
subject.en: A thirty-eight-year-old human lumber camp foreman, burly and deeply tanned, a ring of coarse black beard, heavy brows, an old axe scar across the bridge of his nose, dark brown eyes with a short temper. A red-brown checked coarse shirt #7a4a2a with rolled sleeves under an olive brown leather vest #5a5a3a, a double-bitted felling axe on his shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 疤在鼻梁上；神情带一点敌意。

subject.zh: 二十岁的人族年轻伐木工，高个子，手长脚长，脸上一层细汗与木屑，耳朵容易发红。剪得很短的栗棕头发，憨厚的浅褐眼睛总躲着人看。苔绿粗布上衣 #5a6a3a 配褐色背带裤 #7a5a3a，脖子上挂一条擦汗的旧毛巾。老实害羞。
subject.en: A twenty-year-old human young woodcutter, tall and gangly, a sheen of sweat and sawdust on his face, ears that redden easily. Close-cropped chestnut hair, honest light brown eyes that avoid people's gaze. A moss green coarse shirt #5a6a3a with brown overalls #7a5a3a, an old sweat towel around his neck. Honest and shy.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 他是普通年轻人，不要画得太魁梧。

subject.zh: 四十五岁的狼族兽人猎户首领，浅相：人脸，灰色狼耳与狼尾，一只耳朵缺了一角。高大沉稳，脸颊有褪色的猎纹彩绘，下巴短须。铁灰长发向后束起，浅金色眼睛不怒自威。深褐兽皮猎装 #4a3a2a 配橄榄褐披肩 #6a5a3a，颈挂狼牙串。
subject.en: A forty-five-year-old wolf beastfolk hunter chief, light aspect: human face, grey wolf ears and tail, one ear notched. Tall and steady, faded hunting stripes painted on his cheeks, a short beard. Iron-grey long hair tied back, pale gold eyes with quiet authority. Dark brown hide hunting gear #4a3a2a with an olive brown mantle #6a5a3a, a wolf-fang necklace.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 他是希雅的父亲：眼睛与发色要和她相近；缺角的耳朵是辨识点。

subject.zh: 十二岁的狼族兽人男孩，浅相：人脸，竖得高高的灰色狼耳与蓬松狼尾，个子小而灵活，脸上沾着泥，缺一颗犬牙。灰色短发乱成一团，浅金色眼睛亮晶晶。褐色短皮袄 #5a4632 配皮护腕 #8c6b45，腰挂一只小弹弓。调皮好胜。
subject.en: A twelve-year-old wolf beastfolk boy, light aspect: human face, tall pricked grey wolf ears and a fluffy wolf tail, small and nimble, mud on his face, a missing canine. Tangled grey short hair, bright pale gold eyes. A short brown leather jerkin #5a4632 with leather wristguards #8c6b45, a small slingshot at his belt. Mischievous and proud.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 希雅的弟弟：耳朵与眼睛同她一家；狼耳比例比大人大。

subject.zh: 三十五岁的熊族兽人猎户，浅相：人脸，头顶一对圆圆的棕色熊耳。比常人高大一圈，膀阔腰粗，下颌宽，满脸浓密的深棕胡须，褐色小眼睛。深褐熊皮坎肩 #5a3a1a 敞着胸口，双手戴熊掌形皮护手，肩扛一根粗木猎矛。暴躁直爽。
subject.en: A thirty-five-year-old bear beastfolk hunter, light aspect: human face with a pair of round brown bear ears on top of his head. A size bigger than an ordinary man, broad-shouldered and thick-waisted, a wide jaw, a dense dark brown beard, small brown eyes. A dark brown bearskin vest #5a3a1a open at the chest, bear-paw-shaped leather gauntlets, a thick wooden hunting spear on his shoulder. Hot-tempered and blunt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 圆熊耳要和狼耳分清；体型比普通人大一圈。

subject.zh: 四十一岁的人族镇卫队长，中等身材，结实，脸上带着熬夜的疲惫，下巴刮得发青，眼角细纹。深棕短发鬓角已白，灰褐眼睛沉稳。灰蓝卫队短罩袍 #4a5a6a 套在链甲外，斜挎皮肩带 #8a7a5a，腰挂短剑与铜哨。尽职而疲惫。
subject.en: A forty-one-year-old human town guard captain, average height and solid, weary from sleepless nights, a freshly shaved bluish jaw, fine lines at the eyes. Dark brown short hair greying at the temples, steady grey-brown eyes. A grey-blue guard tabard #4a5a6a over mail, a leather baldric #8a7a5a, a short sword and a copper whistle at his belt. Dutiful and tired.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 罩袍与民兵杰德同款，但他的更旧，多一条队长的皮肩带。

subject.zh: 二十三岁的人族年轻民兵，瘦高，脸蛋讨喜，笑容油滑，眼神有点飘。浅褐卷发精心抹过，额前留一缕，琥珀褐眼睛。和卫队同款的灰蓝罩袍 #4a5a6a 故意系歪一点显帅，皮腰带 #7a6a4a 上挂一支擦得锃亮却没用过的短矛。嘴甜虚荣。
subject.en: A twenty-three-year-old human young militiaman, tall and thin with a likeable face and a slick smile, eyes a little shifty. Carefully styled light brown curls with one lock over his forehead, amber-brown eyes. The same grey-blue guard tabard #4a5a6a worn deliberately askew to look dashing, a leather belt #7a6a4a, a polished but never-used short spear. Sweet-talking and vain.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 罩袍与卫队长巴托同款；他的头发打理得过分讲究。

subject.zh: 三十一岁的人族书记官，瘦削，尖下巴，薄嘴唇抿着，眼珠转得很快。黑发中分，抹得发亮，黑眼睛。深蓝灰书记官外套 #3a4a5a 配银灰马甲 #a0a0a0，袖口套着防墨袖套，耳后夹一支笔，怀里抱着一本账册。精明又胆怯。
subject.en: A thirty-one-year-old human clerk, thin with a pointed chin and pressed thin lips, quick darting eyes. Black hair parted in the middle and slicked shiny, black eyes. A dark blue-grey clerk's coat #3a4a5a with a silver-grey waistcoat #a0a0a0, ink sleeve guards, a pen tucked behind his ear, a ledger hugged to his chest. Shrewd yet cowardly.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 账册上不写字。

subject.zh: 二十八岁的人族女人，瘦而挺拔，五官冷艳，薄唇，右耳一排细银环，眼神冷静得看不出输赢。乌黑长发左侧剃短、右侧垂到肩，黑眼睛。黑色紧身短外套 #2a2a2a 衬深酒红衬衣 #7a1a2a，腰间一串骰子形挂坠，指间夹着两枚骨骰。
subject.en: A twenty-eight-year-old human woman, lean and upright, coolly striking features and thin lips, a row of fine silver rings in her right ear, a gaze so calm you cannot tell if she is winning or losing. Jet-black hair shaved short on the left and shoulder-length on the right, black eyes. A fitted black short jacket #2a2a2a over a deep wine red shirt #7a1a2a, dice charms at her belt, two bone dice between her fingers.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 剃短的一侧在左，耳环在右耳；骰子上的点数可以画，不画字。

subject.zh: 二十二岁的半身人小伙计，个子只到常人腰间，圆脸，脸颊与鼻梁布满雀斑状的吉斑，咧着嘴笑个不停。姜黄卷发蓬成一团，绿褐色大眼睛。草绿短外套 #6a8a3a 缀满口袋，土黄围巾 #c8a060，背一只大货包，腰挂一只小铜铃。话多乐天。
subject.en: A twenty-two-year-old halfling errand boy who stands only to an adult's waist: a round face with lucky freckle-spots across his cheeks and nose, an endless grin. A fluffy mop of ginger curls, big green-brown eyes. A grass green short jacket #6a8a3a covered in pockets, an ochre scarf #c8a060, a big goods pack on his back, a small copper bell at his belt. Chatty and cheerful.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 半身人的圆脸与卷发是辨识点；铃铛很小。

subject.zh: 三十六岁的人族独立行商，中等个子，精瘦，脸被日头晒成红褐色，眉头常皱着，一脸不服气。深棕短发压在一顶旧宽边毡帽下，褐色眼睛精明。沾着路尘的土黄旅行外套 #7a6a3a，深褐背带 #5a4a3a 上挂着手秤与钱袋。倔而正直。
subject.en: A thirty-six-year-old human independent peddler, medium height and wiry, his face sunburnt red-brown, brows usually knitted in a defiant look. Dark brown short hair under an old wide-brimmed felt hat, shrewd brown eyes. A dusty ochre travel coat #7a6a3a, a dark brown strap #5a4a3a hung with a hand scale and a coin purse. Stubborn and honest.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 画成风尘仆仆的路边小贩，与学者无关。

subject.zh: 十七岁的人族少女女招待，娇俏活泼，脸颊红扑扑，嘴角一颗小痣，笑起来有酒窝。橘铜色长发编成一条粗辫搭在肩前，琥珀色眼睛亮亮的。玫红束腰裙 #a04a5a 配米白短袖衬衫 #e8d0b0，头上一块小方巾，手托酒盘。爱说爱笑。
subject.en: A seventeen-year-old human barmaid, pretty and lively, rosy cheeks, a little mole by her mouth, dimples when she smiles. Copper-orange hair in a thick braid over one shoulder, bright amber eyes. A rose red bodice dress #a04a5a with a cream short-sleeved blouse #e8d0b0, a small kerchief on her head, a drink tray on one hand. Talkative and bubbly.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 醉月亭的女招待：配色与老板娘的酒红呼应，但更鲜亮。

subject.zh: 七十二岁的人族守墓老人，佝偻瘦弱，脸颊凹陷，白胡子稀疏，眼神和善又带着怯意，灰白眼睛有些浑浊。稀疏白发披散，戴一顶旧黑毡帽。黑灰长外套 #3a3a3a 下摆沾着泥，橄榄灰围巾 #5a5a4a，脖子上挂着几串驱邪的干草结与小骨片。
subject.en: A seventy-two-year-old human gravekeeper, bent and frail with hollow cheeks and a thin white beard, kind but timid cloudy grey eyes. Wispy white hair under an old black felt hat. A charcoal long coat #3a3a3a muddy at the hem, an olive grey scarf #5a5a4a, several strings of warding straw knots and small bone charms around his neck.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 驱邪的草结是他迷信的标志；色调灰暗，但神情温和。

subject.zh: 五十二岁的人族面包师，圆滚滚的肚子，红润的圆脸沾着面粉，两撇浓密的褐色八字胡，眼神有点怯。深棕短发稀了顶，戴一顶软白面包帽。米白工作衫 #e0d0b0 卷着袖子，系褐色围裙 #8a6a4a，耳后夹一支记账的炭笔。勤快又心软。
subject.en: A fifty-two-year-old human baker with a round belly and a ruddy round face dusted with flour, a bushy brown handlebar moustache, slightly timid eyes. Thinning dark brown hair under a soft white baker's cap. A cream work shirt #e0d0b0 with rolled sleeves, a brown apron #8a6a4a, a charcoal stick for tallying tucked behind his ear. Hardworking and soft-hearted.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 脸上的面粉与八字胡是辨识点。

subject.zh: 十九岁的人族姑娘，身材匀称，鹅蛋脸，眉毛清秀却透着倔强，眼神温柔。栗棕长发用发带束在脑后，鬓边别一枚麦穗形小发饰，褐色眼睛。豆沙粉长裙 #c88a9a 配米白围裙 #e8e0d0，袖口挽起，手上沾着一点面粉。
subject.en: A nineteen-year-old human young woman of even build with an oval face, delicate brows with a stubborn line, gentle eyes. Chestnut long hair tied back with a ribbon, a small wheat-ear hair pin at her temple, brown eyes. A dusky pink long dress #c88a9a with a cream apron #e8e0d0, sleeves rolled up, a little flour on her hands.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她是面包师的女儿，发色与父亲相近。

subject.zh: 二十六岁的人族冒险者，精壮，下巴扬着，嘴角挂着自负的笑，脸颊贴一块新膏药，眉角一道旧伤。蜂蜜金短发向上抓起，蓝灰眼睛。暗红短披风 #7a2a2a 搭在镶钉皮甲 #a08a6a 外，肩甲擦得发亮，背一柄双手剑。
subject.en: A twenty-six-year-old human adventurer, fit and strong, chin up with a cocky smile, a fresh plaster on his cheek and an old cut at the edge of his brow. Honey-blond short hair spiked up, blue-grey eyes. A dark red short cape #7a2a2a over studded leather armor #a08a6a with polished pauldrons, a two-handed sword on his back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 脸上的膏药是他屡败屡战的标志，四种表情里都要有。

subject.zh: 四十岁的人族农夫，敦实，背微弓，晒成麦色的方脸上有深深的抬头纹，下巴短胡茬，眼神朴实又谨慎。深棕短发压在一顶塌了的旧草帽下，褐色眼睛。土黄粗布短褂 #7a6a4a 配深褐裤子 #5a4a2a，脖子上搭汗巾，肩扛锄头。
subject.en: A forty-year-old human farmer, stocky and slightly stooped, a wheat-tanned square face with deep forehead lines, short stubble, an honest but cautious look. Dark brown short hair under a sagging old straw hat, brown eyes. An ochre coarse cloth tunic #7a6a4a with dark brown trousers #5a4a2a, a sweat cloth around his neck, a hoe over his shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 草帽帽檐窄而塌，和宽檐草帽的老船夫区分开。

subject.zh: 四十五岁的人族洗衣妇，身材丰满，双手被水泡得发红，脸庞红润，嘴角总挂着要讲新鲜事的笑。深棕头发用头巾包起，额前散着湿发，褐色眼睛机灵。赭褐粗布裙 #8a6a5a 卷着袖子，系米灰围裙 #d8d0c0，胳膊上挎一篮衣物。
subject.en: A forty-five-year-old human washerwoman, full-figured, hands red from water, a ruddy face with a smile always ready to share news. Dark brown hair wrapped in a headscarf with damp strands on her forehead, clever brown eyes. A reddish brown coarse dress #8a6a5a with rolled sleeves, a beige-grey apron #d8d0c0, a basket of laundry on her arm.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 泡红的双手是她的职业特征。

subject.zh: 六十二岁的人族老驿卒，精瘦硬朗，被风吹得通红的脸，灰白的海象胡，眼角笑纹很深。灰白短发压在一顶带帽檐的旧驿帽下，浅蓝眼睛。深蓝驿务外套 #2a3a5a，手拿马鞭，胸前斜挎一只鼓鼓的信袋 #8a6a3a，口袋里露出一把燕麦。
subject.en: A sixty-two-year-old human postrider, wiry and hale, a wind-reddened face, a grizzled walrus moustache, deep laugh lines. Grey-white short hair under an old brimmed post cap, pale blue eyes. A dark blue courier coat #2a3a5a, a riding crop in hand, a bulging mail satchel #8a6a3a slung across his chest, a handful of oats poking from a pocket.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 王国驿务的深蓝外套与信袋是辨识点。

subject.zh: 四十四岁的人族铁匠，敦实，肩背宽厚，一双被火燎过的粗手，脸上有烟熏的黑痕，络腮胡剃成短茬。深灰短发，额前一道烫伤的疤，灰绿眼睛眯着。煤灰粗布衬衫 #3a3a3a 外系焦痕斑斑的皮围裙 #6a4a32，腰间插铆钉锤与火钳。
subject.en: A forty-four-year-old human smith, stocky with a broad back, rough fire-scarred hands, soot smudges on his face, a beard shaved to short stubble. Dark grey short hair, a burn scar across his forehead, squinting grey-green eyes. A coal grey coarse shirt #3a3a3a under a scorched leather apron #6a4a32, a riveting hammer and tongs tucked in his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与矮人铁匠区分：人族体型，没有长须，烫疤在额头。

subject.zh: 十五岁的人族少年，瘦得像根芦苇，晒黑的脸上颧骨突出，眼神警惕，像在数每一个过路人。乱蓬蓬的黑褐短发，深褐眼睛。补丁摞补丁的灰褐短褂 #6a5a4a，腰缠一圈粗麻绳，戴磨破的皮手套，耳后夹一根刻着记号的木签。
subject.en: A fifteen-year-old human boy, thin as a reed, sharp cheekbones on a sun-darkened face, wary eyes that seem to be counting every passer-by. Shaggy dark brown short hair, dark brown eyes. A grey-brown tunic #6a5a4a patched over patches, a coil of thick hemp rope around his waist, worn-through leather gloves, a notched tally stick behind his ear.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 木签上只有刻痕，不是字。

subject.zh: 六十来岁的人族边境伯爵，久病消瘦，面色蜡黄，双颊凹陷，花白短须修剪整齐，灰褐眼睛仍带威严。稀疏的金灰头发向后梳。深绿镶金的伯爵长袍 #2a4a3a、#c8a040 披在睡衣外，胸前挂家族的鹰纹金章，膝上盖着毛毯。
subject.en: A human border count in his sixties, wasted by long illness, sallow skin and hollow cheeks, a neatly trimmed grizzled short beard, grey-brown eyes that still command. Thinning gold-grey hair combed back. A dark green robe of state with gold trim #2a4a3a, #c8a040 over his nightclothes, a family eagle crest in gold on his chest, a blanket over his knees.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 他病重卧床：头像要显出病容与残存的威严；鹰纹是图形，不是字。

subject.zh: 五十二岁的接生婆，中等身材，结实，脸庞宽而和善，两颊有晒斑，眼神温柔却很稳。灰褐头发盘起，用一块洗旧的蓝头巾包住，褐色眼睛。素净的灰绿长裙 #6a7a6a 配干净的白围裙，腰间挂着装草药的小布袋与一把小剪刀。
subject.en: A fifty-two-year-old midwife of medium build, sturdy, a broad kind face with sun spots on the cheeks, a gentle but steady gaze. Grey-brown hair pinned up under a washed-out blue headscarf, brown eyes. A plain grey-green long dress #6a7a6a with a clean white apron, small cloth herb pouches and a pair of little scissors at her waist.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 衣着朴素、低饱和；不画任何纹路。

subject.zh: 三十九岁的人族净炼师，瘦长，鼻梁上架一副圆护目镜片，脸颊有被药气熏出的浅斑，嘴角带着算账般的笑。浅褐短发，发际线略后退，灰蓝眼睛。学院式深棕长外套 #4a3a2a 外罩一件烧出小洞的皮围裙，胸前别银徽，腰挂一排小玻璃瓶。
subject.en: A thirty-nine-year-old human licensed purifier, long and thin, round protective lenses on his nose, faint stains on his cheeks from alchemical fumes, a smile like he is balancing books. Short light brown hair with a slightly receding hairline, grey-blue eyes. An academy-style dark brown long coat #4a3a2a under a leather apron pocked with burn holes, a silver badge on his chest, a row of small glass vials at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 玻璃瓶里是浑浊的浅灰液体；徽章上没有字。

subject.zh: 五十五岁的人族女村长兼客栈老板娘，高大壮实，宽肩粗臂，方下巴，笑起来声如洪钟。灰金短发，鬓角一缕编成小辫，蓝灰眼睛。深褐皮背心 #5a3a22 罩着芦苇绿粗布衫 #6a7a4a，腰挂收桥税的铜钱袋，手拎一根包铁木棒。
subject.en: A fifty-five-year-old human village head and innkeeper, tall and strong with broad shoulders and thick arms, a square jaw, a booming laugh. Short grey-blond hair with one small braid at the temple, blue-grey eyes. A dark brown leather vest #5a3a22 over a reed green coarse shirt #6a7a4a, a pouch of toll coppers at her belt, an iron-shod cudgel in her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她镇得住打架的客人：体态要硬朗。

subject.zh: 三十四岁的人族渔夫，瘦高，皮肤被河风吹得黝黑，下巴一圈浅胡，眼睛眯着像在看水面，神情安静。沙褐乱发，灰绿眼睛。芦苇色鱼皮短外套 #8a8a5a 泛着防水的油光，腰缠渔网与鱼篓，背一张长弓，颈挂骨制鱼钩坠。
subject.en: A thirty-four-year-old human fisherman, tall and thin, skin darkened by the river wind, a light beard along his jaw, eyes narrowed as if watching the water, a quiet manner. Messy sandy brown hair, grey-green eyes. A reed-colored fish-skin short coat #8a8a5a with a waterproof sheen, a net and creel around his waist, a longbow on his back, a bone fishhook pendant at his neck.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 鱼皮外套的鳞状纹理是辨识点。

subject.zh: 二十七岁的人族盐贩姑娘，个子小，脸蛋圆润，鼻尖发红，笑容爽快。浅栗色头发扎成高马尾，后颈总围着一条洗旧的黄围巾，榛褐色眼睛。土黄短外套 #a08a5a 配粗布长裙，背一个装盐的布袋，腰挂一杆小秤。
subject.en: A twenty-seven-year-old human salt seller, petite with a round face, a reddish nose tip, a frank cheerful smile. Light chestnut hair in a high ponytail, a washed-out yellow scarf always around the back of her neck, hazel eyes. An ochre short jacket #a08a5a with a coarse cloth skirt, a sack of salt on her back, a small hand scale at her belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 后颈总被围巾盖着，不画任何胎记。

subject.zh: 三十七岁的人族女人，瘦削利落，颧骨高，左眉梢一道细疤。灰褐长发编成一条贴头的辫子，灰绿眼睛眯着打量人。深灰皮外套 #4a4a4a 立着领口，围一条褪色的砖红围巾 #8a3a2a，双手戴磨旧的灰色长手套，指间夹一枚铜币。
subject.en: A wiry thirty-seven-year-old human woman with high cheekbones and a thin scar at the tip of her left eyebrow. Grey-brown hair in one tight braid, grey-green eyes narrowed in appraisal. Dark grey leather coat #4a4a4a with a raised collar, a faded brick-red scarf #8a3a2a, worn long grey gloves on both hands, a copper coin held between two fingers.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 手套是她的标志，四种表情里都要戴着；疤在左眉。

subject.zh: 五十八岁的人族外科医生，瘦削，一条腿瘸着，拄一根手杖，脸颊凹陷，胡子拉碴，眼神疲惫却极锐利。花白乱发扎在脑后，浅灰眼睛下挂着眼袋。深褐长外套 #4a3a30 上有几处旧血渍，袖口卷起露出缠绷带的手腕，腰挂手术刀包与药瓶。
subject.en: A fifty-eight-year-old human surgeon, gaunt, lame in one leg and leaning on a cane, hollow cheeks and scruffy stubble, tired but razor-sharp eyes. Unkempt grizzled hair tied at the back, pale grey eyes with heavy bags. A dark brown long coat #4a3a30 with a few old bloodstains, rolled cuffs showing bandaged wrists, a scalpel case and medicine bottles at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 血渍只是几处暗褐色斑点，不要画得血腥。

subject.zh: 四十九岁的人族矿头，粗壮矮墩，满脸灰尘，咧嘴时露出一颗灰白晶石镶的门牙，络腮胡里夹着灰。深灰短发压在一顶带灯架的皮矿帽下，褐色眼睛精明。厚帆布矿工服 #5a5a50 配皮护肩 #6a4a32，手套很厚，腰挂短柄矿镐。
subject.en: A forty-nine-year-old human mine boss, stocky and squat, face covered in dust, a front tooth replaced with a grey-white crystal that shows when he grins, ash caught in his full beard. Dark grey short hair under a leather mining cap with a lamp bracket, shrewd brown eyes. Heavy canvas miner's clothes #5a5a50 with leather shoulder guards #6a4a32, thick gloves, a short-handled pick at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 晶牙是灰白色的，不用紫色。

subject.zh: 三十一岁的人族女矿工，结实精悍，短下巴，嘴角倔强，额角有灰。深褐短发剪得像男孩，灰绿眼睛硬朗。无袖的旧帆布矿工背心 #5a5a50，右臂肌肉结实，左臂从肘到手覆着暗紫灰的结晶 #4a3a62，指节像石棱，肩扛一把矿锤。
subject.en: A thirty-one-year-old human woman miner, sturdy and tough, a short chin, a stubborn mouth, ash on her brow. Dark brown hair cropped like a boy's, hard grey-green eyes. An old sleeveless canvas miner's vest #5a5a50, a muscular right arm, her left arm covered from elbow to hand in dark purple-grey crystal #4a3a62 with knuckles like stone ridges, a mining hammer on her shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 结晶只在左臂，颜色是暗紫灰；四种表情里左肩与左臂都要露出一部分。

subject.zh: 四十岁的人族独居术士，高瘦，脸色发灰，眼窝很深，嘴角挂着讲价似的笑。黑发及肩夹几缕灰，下巴一撮山羊胡，琥珀褐眼睛。灰黑旧斗篷 #3a3a3a 里是锈红内衬 #7a3a2a，颈挂一串皮绳穿起的灰白晶片，手指戴几枚铁戒。
subject.en: A forty-year-old human hermit warlock, tall and thin, an ashen complexion and deep-set eyes, a haggling smile at his mouth. Shoulder-length black hair with a few grey streaks, a goatee, amber-brown eyes. An old charcoal cloak #3a3a3a with a rust red lining #7a3a2a, a leather cord strung with grey-white crystal shards around his neck, several iron rings on his fingers.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 晶片是灰白色的，不发紫光。

subject.zh: 六十六岁的人族拾荒老婆婆，矮小佝偻，满脸沟壑，缺了几颗牙，笑起来眼睛眯成线。灰白乱发包在褪色的灰紫头巾里，浑浊的褐眼睛却很尖。层层叠叠的破布衣 #6a6050 缀满捡来的小玩意：铜扣、陶片、晾衣钩。背一只大背篓。
subject.en: A sixty-six-year-old human scavenger granny, short and bent, a deeply furrowed face missing a few teeth, eyes vanishing into lines when she smiles. Unruly grey-white hair wrapped in a faded grey-violet headscarf, cloudy but sharp brown eyes. Layer upon layer of ragged clothes #6a6050 sewn with found trinkets: brass buttons, pottery shards, a clothes hook. A big basket on her back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 头巾是偏灰的淡紫，不是澱紫；身上的小玩意越杂越好。

subject.zh: 十七岁的人族少年头领，瘦而结实，脸上沾着灰，下巴一道新结痂的划伤，咧嘴笑时带着狠劲。脏金色乱发用布条扎在额前，蓝灰眼睛警觉。不合身的大号旧皮外套 #5a4a3a 敞着，里面是破洞的灰衫，腰带上插一把磨亮的铁勺。
subject.en: A seventeen-year-old human boy leader, thin but tough, ash on his face, a freshly scabbed scratch on his chin, a grin with an edge to it. Dirty blond messy hair held back with a strip of cloth, alert blue-grey eyes. An oversized old leather coat #5a4a3a worn open over a holed grey shirt, a polished iron spoon stuck in his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 铁勺是他的外号与标志，要清楚。

subject.zh: 三十九岁的妇人，清瘦，脸庞柔和，眼神温和而警惕，眼角有细纹。深棕头发编成一条长辫垂在背后，用灰蓝布条束住，褐色眼睛。素淡的灰蓝长裙 #5a6a7a 配旧米色披肩 #c8c0a8，双手总戴着一副薄布手套，腰间挂一小束晒干的草药。
subject.en: A thirty-nine-year-old woman, slender with a soft face, a gentle yet watchful gaze, fine lines at her eyes. Dark brown hair in one long braid down her back tied with a grey-blue strip of cloth, brown eyes. A plain grey-blue long dress #5a6a7a with an old beige shawl #c8c0a8, thin cloth gloves always on her hands, a small bundle of dried herbs at her waist.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 衣着朴素、低饱和；手套下面不画任何东西。

subject.zh: 九岁的男孩，瘦小，脸色有些苍白，眼睛又大又亮，总像在闻风里的味道。深棕短发软软的，刘海遮不住左额角一小块拱门形的深色胎记，褐色眼睛。母亲改小的灰蓝旧罩衫 #5a6a7a，脖子上围一条过大的米色围巾。
subject.en: A nine-year-old boy, small and a little pale, with big bright eyes that always seem to be sniffing the wind. Soft dark brown short hair whose bangs cannot hide a small arch-shaped dark birthmark at his left temple, brown eyes. An old grey-blue smock #5a6a7a cut down from his mother's, an oversized beige scarf around his neck.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 胎记在左额角，是深一点的肤色，不发光。

subject.zh: 七十一岁的人族老猎人，瘦高而挺直，晒成皮革色的脸上刻满皱纹，雪白短须，嘴唇常年抿着。灰白长发束成一束，浅灰眼睛像冬天的湖。旧兽皮斗篷 #6a6a60 的领口缝着一圈灰狼毛，里面是灰褐猎装，背一张磨得发亮的老弓。
subject.en: A seventy-one-year-old human old hunter, tall, lean and upright, a leathery face deeply lined, a snow-white short beard, lips habitually pressed shut. Grey-white long hair tied in one tail, pale grey eyes like a winter lake. An old hide cloak #6a6a60 with a collar of grey wolf fur over grey-brown hunting clothes, a polished old bow on his back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 他几乎不开口：四种表情的变化要克制。

subject.zh: 三十三岁的半身人女骡队头，个子只到常人腰间，圆脸被风吹得粗糙，脸颊有雀斑状的吉斑，嘴角紧抿。深栗色卷发剪得很短，琥珀色眼睛机警。满是灰的厚实赭褐旅行斗篷 #7a5a3a，胸前挂一只摘了铃舌的旧铜铃，手握赶骡短鞭。
subject.en: A thirty-three-year-old halfling mule-train leader who stands only to an adult's waist, a round face roughened by wind, lucky freckle-spots on her cheeks, lips pressed tight. Dark chestnut curls cropped very short, alert amber eyes. A thick ash-covered ochre-brown travel cloak #7a5a3a, an old copper bell with its clapper removed hanging at her chest, a short mule whip in her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 胸前的铜铃没有铃舌，是她的标志。

subject.zh: 六十岁的送魂人，瘦而挺直，脸庞安详，皱纹柔和，嘴唇总像在哼歌。灰白长发松松编成一条辫子垂在胸前，系着几根褪色的彩线，灰蓝眼睛温柔。层叠的灰白麻布长袍 #b8b8b0，披一条深灰长披巾 #4a4a50，手里握一盏小油灯。
subject.en: A sixty-year-old soul-singer, thin and upright, a peaceful face with soft wrinkles, lips that always seem to be humming. Grey-white long hair loosely braided over her chest and tied with a few faded colored threads, gentle grey-blue eyes. Layered grey-white linen robes #b8b8b0 with a long dark grey shawl #4a4a50, a small oil lamp in her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她不属于任何教会：不画圣徽或任何神职标志。

subject.zh: 五十六岁的人族主教，高大微胖，面色红润，下巴圆厚，银灰短发梳得整齐，浅灰眼睛带着居高临下的和蔼。象牙白主教长袍 #f0e8d0 镶金色光环纹 #c8a84a，头戴低矮的白色主教冠，胸前挂一枚沉甸甸的金圣徽，手持主教杖。
subject.en: A fifty-six-year-old human bishop, tall and a little heavy, a ruddy face with a full round chin, neatly combed silver-grey short hair, pale grey eyes with condescending kindness. An ivory bishop's robe #f0e8d0 trimmed with gold halo patterns #c8a84a, a low white bishop's mitre, a heavy gold holy symbol on his chest, a crozier in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 主教冠与权杖顶端是几何光环图形，不用十字。

subject.zh: 二十五岁上下的人族见习审判官，瘦长，脸色苍白，下巴尖，眼神狂热又闪躲，嘴唇紧抿。淡金短发剃得很短，浅蓝眼睛。审判庭见习生的白色短披风 #e8e8ec 配灰色制服 #8a8a90，胸前别一枚小号天平徽章，腋下夹一叠文书。
subject.en: A human trainee inquisitor in his mid twenties, long and thin, pale with a pointed chin, fervent but evasive eyes, lips pressed tight. Very short pale blond hair, pale blue eyes. A trainee's short white inquisition cape #e8e8ec over a grey uniform #8a8a90, a small scales badge on his chest, a stack of documents under his arm.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与审判官赛琳同属审判庭：配色相近，但他的披风短、徽章小，神情没有她的冷静。

subject.zh: 四十岁的人族修女，中等身材，结实，脸庞方正，眼神坚定而疲倦，手上有做粗活的茧。深炭色修女服 #2a2a3a 配白头巾 #e8e8e8，头巾边露出栗褐头发，褐色眼睛。袖子挽到小臂，系一条洗得发灰的围裙，腰挂绷带卷与小药箱。
subject.en: A forty-year-old human nun of medium build, sturdy, a square face, determined but weary eyes, calluses from hard work on her hands. A dark charcoal habit #2a2a3a with a white wimple #e8e8e8 showing chestnut hair at the edge, brown eyes. Sleeves rolled to the forearm, a greyed apron, a roll of bandages and a small medicine box at her waist.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与边石镇的伊莎修女同款修女服，但更年长、更干练。

subject.zh: 六十岁的人族公会大区会长，高大厚实，宽脸，短而硬的灰须，目光精明，一侧嘴角总像在算计。铁灰短发向后梳，灰蓝眼睛。深石板色正装外套 #3a3a4a 配铜褐色肩饰 #8a6a3a，胸前挂公会的盾形大徽章，手指戴一枚粗印戒。
subject.en: A sixty-year-old human guild district master, tall and heavyset, a broad face with a short bristly grey beard, a shrewd gaze, one corner of his mouth always calculating. Iron-grey short hair combed back, grey-blue eyes. A dark slate formal coat #3a3a4a with bronze-brown epaulettes #8a6a3a, a large shield-shaped guild badge on his chest, a thick signet ring.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 公会盾徽与边石分部同款但更大；徽章上没有字。

subject.zh: 三十出头的人族剑士，金色长发梳得一丝不乱，修剪整齐的短须，下巴抬得很高；穿擦得锃亮的钢胸甲，左肩是金色狮首护肩（#c8a04a），深红披风（#8a2a22）镶着金边，右手长剑，左手圆盾上画着一头金狮。
subject.en: A human swordsman in his early thirties, long golden hair combed perfectly in place, a neatly trimmed short beard, chin held high; a polished steel breastplate, a golden lion-head pauldron (#c8a04a) on the left shoulder, a deep red cape (#8a2a22) with gold trim, a longsword in his right hand and a round shield painted with a golden lion on his left arm.

items.notes: 附首领三视图 art_boss_reynard_walter_duel_ref（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照，他在场景里用首领立牌；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 外号金狮：全身偏金，狮子纹样只画图形；不画任何兽人特征。

subject.zh: 三十岁的人族接待主管，身材高挑，五官精致，嘴角挂着职业的微笑，眼睛却在记下每一句话。深棕长发盘成利落的髻，插一支铜簪，深褐眼睛。深蓝公会制服外套 #3a5a7a 配挺括的白领 #e0e0e0，胸前别盾形徽章，手拿登记板。
subject.en: A thirty-year-old human reception chief, tall with refined features, a professional smile, eyes that note every word. Dark brown long hair in a neat bun pinned with a copper hairpin, dark brown eyes. A deep blue guild uniform coat #3a5a7a with a crisp white collar #e0e0e0, a shield-shaped badge on her chest, a clipboard in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与边石镇的接待员同色系制服，但更成熟老练。

subject.zh: 五十岁上下的人族城防军统领，魁梧，肩膀像城墙，方脸刻满硬纹，下颌一道旧伤疤，神情寡言而刚直。花白短发剃得很短，铁灰眼睛。铁灰板甲 #5a5e64 外罩瓦伦堡的深蓝罩袍 #2a3a5a，肩披斗篷，腰挂宽刃剑。
subject.en: A human commander of the city watch around fifty, massive with shoulders like a city wall, a square face carved with hard lines, an old scar along his jaw, terse and upright. Grizzled hair cropped very short, iron-grey eyes. Iron-grey plate #5a5e64 under a Valen deep blue surcoat #2a3a5a, a cloak on his shoulders, a broad-bladed sword at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 瓦伦堡城防军的深蓝罩袍是他的辨识色。

subject.zh: 斑影部狮相的兽人女战士，中相：脸上有短毛与狮形鼻吻，一头蓬张的赤红鬃发（#b33a2a）披到肩背，金色竖瞳，身后一条带黑色尾簇的狮尾；穿皮与锁片的混合轻甲，护臂上有斑纹烙印，双手持一柄宽刃长柄战斧。
subject.en: A lion-aspect beastfolk warrior woman of the Dappleshade tribe, middle aspect: short fur and a lion-like muzzle on her face, a flared crimson mane (#b33a2a) down her shoulders and back, gold slit pupils, a lion tail with a black tuft; light armor of leather and mail plates, spotted brands on her bracers, a broad-bladed long-hafted battle axe in both hands.

items.notes: 附首领三视图 art_boss_herada_duel_ref（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照，她在场景里用首领立牌；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 外号赤鬃：鬃发是赤红色；狮相要和狼、狐分清，尾端有黑色簇毛。

subject.zh: 正值中年的矮人女商会会长，方形身板，肩宽厚，下巴有力，看人像在验货。铜红色鬓发编成两条粗辫，缀着金属环，深褐眼睛在灯下反光，脸颊有细小的铜红矿纹。墨绿厚呢外套 #2e4a3a 配金扣，胸前挂秤形金章，腋下夹契约匣。
subject.en: A middle-aged dwarf woman guild branch chief, square-built and broad-shouldered with a firm jaw, looking at people as if inspecting goods. Copper-red sidelocks in two thick braids hung with metal rings, dark brown eyes glinting in lamplight, fine copper-red ore flecks on her cheeks. A dark green heavy wool coat #2e4a3a with gold buttons, a scales-shaped gold medal on her chest, a contract case under her arm.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 矮人女性留编辫鬓发，不画胡须；秤形徽章是商会联合的标志。

subject.zh: 三十五岁上下的人族商行代表，修长优雅，五官端正而冷淡，嘴角一抹得体的浅笑。乌黑直发在脑后束成短马尾，灰色眼睛不带温度。剪裁合身的炭灰长外套 #34343a 配酒红领巾 #7a1e2a，领口别一枚小小的金冠形胸针，戴黑手套。
subject.en: A human trading house envoy in his mid thirties, tall and elegant with regular, cool features and a polite faint smile. Straight jet-black hair tied in a short tail at the nape, grey eyes without warmth. A well-cut charcoal long coat #34343a with a wine red cravat #7a1e2a, a small crown-shaped gold pin at the collar, black gloves.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 金冠商行的人：配色与金冠哈特呼应，金冠胸针很小。

subject.zh: 六十岁上下的人族粮商行会会长，矮胖，红脸膛，双下巴，花白络腮胡修成圆形，眼神挑剔而傲慢。稀疏灰发上戴一顶黑色软帽，褐色眼睛。麦黄色厚呢长袍 #b89a5a 配深褐毛皮领 #5a3a22，胸前挂麦穗形银链，粗短的手指戴着戒指。
subject.en: A human grain guild master around sixty, short and fat with a red face and a double chin, a grizzled full beard trimmed round, a fussy, haughty look. A black soft cap on thinning grey hair, brown eyes. A wheat-yellow heavy wool robe #b89a5a with a dark brown fur collar #5a3a22, a silver chain of wheat-ear links on his chest, stubby fingers with rings.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 麦穗银链是粮商行会的标志。

subject.zh: 四十五岁上下的人族猎人头领，瘦高精悍，晒黑的长脸，法令纹很深，下巴短须，眼神沉默而警惕。灰褐长发编成一条辫子，鬓角插一小截鹿角，绿褐色眼睛。墨绿皮猎装 #3a4a32 配鹿皮披肩 #8a6a4a，背长弓，腰挂剥皮刀。
subject.en: A human hunter chief around forty-five, tall, lean and hard, a long tanned face with deep lines, a short beard, silent watchful eyes. Grey-brown long hair in one braid with a small piece of antler tucked at the temple, green-brown eyes. Dark green leather hunting gear #3a4a32 with a deerskin mantle #8a6a4a, a longbow on his back, a skinning knife at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 鹿角会的标志是一小截鹿角；他不喜欢城里人，神情冷淡。

subject.zh: 四十来岁的鹿族兽人德鲁伊，浅相：人脸，头顶一对分叉的小鹿角与垂着的鹿耳。清瘦，神情平和却带着愁容，眼角下垂。浅灰褐长发披在肩上，鹿角缠着青藤，湿润的深褐眼睛。苔绿与灰白相间的麻布长袍 #6a7a5a，颈挂木珠，手持白杉木杖。
subject.en: A deer beastfolk druid in his forties, light aspect: human face, a pair of small forked antlers and drooping deer ears. Thin, calm yet sorrowful, the corners of his eyes turned down. Light grey-brown long hair over his shoulders, green vines wound around his antlers, moist dark brown eyes. A linen robe in moss green and grey-white #6a7a5a, a string of wooden beads at his neck, a white fir staff in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 鹿角是剪影特征；不画花，避开女神的枯花与新花元素。

subject.zh: 五十五岁上下的人族女院长，瘦高，背挺得笔直，薄唇紧抿，神情谨慎学究。银灰头发盘成高髻，插两支细长银簪，鼻梁上一副金丝夹鼻眼镜，灰蓝眼睛。深蓝灰学院长袍 #3a4458 镶银边 #b8bcc8，胸前挂一枚星盘形的院长徽章。
subject.en: A human academy branch director around fifty-five, tall and thin with a ramrod back, thin pressed lips, cautious and scholarly. Silver-grey hair in a high bun pinned with two long silver hairpins, gold-rimmed pince-nez on her nose, grey-blue eyes. A deep blue-grey academy robe #3a4458 trimmed in silver #b8bcc8, an astrolabe-shaped director's badge on her chest.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 星盘徽章是学院的标志，刻度上不画字。

subject.zh: 二十四岁的人族见习史官，清瘦，脸上有雀斑，眼睛又圆又亮，总像刚发现了什么，兴奋难掩。栗棕卷发乱糟糟，耳后夹一支羽笔，褐色眼睛。深蓝灰学院短袍 #3a3a5a 配灰色袖套 #8a8a9a，怀里抱着一摞旧书与一卷手稿。
subject.en: A twenty-four-year-old human apprentice historian, slim and freckled, round bright eyes always excited about some discovery. Messy chestnut curls with a quill behind his ear, brown eyes. A dark blue-grey academy short robe #3a3a5a with grey sleeve guards #8a8a9a, an armful of old books and a rolled manuscript.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 书与手稿上没有字。

subject.zh: 七十岁上下的人族占卜婆婆，瘦小，满脸皱纹，双眼蒙着一条褪色的蓝布，嘴角挂着慈祥又神秘的笑。花白头发编成许多细辫，缀着小贝壳与铜片。层层叠叠的彩色碎布披肩 #8a4a6a、#c89a4a，手里摩挲着一串骨牌。
subject.en: A human fortune-telling granny around seventy, small and wrinkled, her eyes covered by a faded blue cloth, a kindly yet mysterious smile. Grizzled hair in many thin braids hung with tiny shells and copper flakes. Layer upon layer of colorful patchwork shawls #8a4a6a, #c89a4a, a string of bone tiles rubbed between her fingers.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她是盲人：四种表情里蒙眼布都在；骨牌上只有点纹。

subject.zh: 三十来岁的半身人女巢主，个子只到常人腰间，圆脸机灵，脸颊有雀斑状的吉斑，嘴角挂着讨价还价的笑。深棕卷发在头顶扎成一个冲天的小髻，像一截灯芯，黑亮的眼睛滴溜溜转。深灰兜帽短斗篷 #3a3a40 下是多口袋皮背心，腰挂小铜提灯与一串钥匙。
subject.en: A halfling woman gang boss around thirty who stands only to an adult's waist, a clever round face with lucky freckle-spots, a haggler's smile. Dark brown curls tied in a small topknot sticking straight up like a wick, quick black eyes. A short hooded dark grey cloak #3a3a40 over a leather vest full of pockets, a small copper lantern and a ring of keys at her belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号灯芯：头顶冲天的小发髻是她的剪影特征。

subject.zh: 四十多岁的人族药师，身形清瘦，灰白的鬓角梳得服帖，戴细框圆眼镜，神情温和而空洞；深灰长外套外系着有药渍的皮围裙，腰带上插满彩色药瓶，左手背画着一道门形记号，右手捏着一只装淡紫晶屑的爆罐。
subject.en: A human apothecary in his forties, slender, graying temples combed flat, thin round spectacles, a gentle but hollow expression; a dark gray long coat with a stained leather apron over it, colored potion vials stuck all along his belt, a door-shaped mark painted on the back of his left hand, a burst jar of pale purple crystal grit pinched in his right hand.

items.notes: 附首领三视图 art_boss_emil_keywarden_fight_ref（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照，他在场景里用首领立牌；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 外表温和可信，不要画成阴险的样子；手背的门形记号与爆罐在头像里看不见，不画。

subject.zh: 二十岁上下的年轻女子，瘦弱，脸色苍白，眼睛红肿，神情胆怯而焦急，总咬着下唇。浅棕头发乱乱地扎在脑后，褐色眼睛。洗旧的灰褐长裙 #6a5e52 外罩一件不合身的深灰斗篷，双手紧紧攥着一条旧布带。
subject.en: A young woman around twenty, frail and pale, red-rimmed eyes, timid and anxious, always biting her lower lip. Light brown hair tied back messily, brown eyes. A washed-out grey-brown dress #6a5e52 under an ill-fitting dark grey cloak, both hands clutching an old strip of cloth.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她是被胁迫的人，不是坏人：神情惶恐，不画任何组织标志。

subject.zh: 七十岁上下的人族老管家，瘦高挺直，长脸严肃，白色连鬓胡子修得一丝不苟，眼神沉稳。白发向后梳得服帖，淡灰眼睛。深绿管家长礼服 #2a4a3a 配银扣与雪白领巾，胸前一枚小小的鹰纹银章，戴白手套。
subject.en: A human old steward around seventy, tall, thin and upright, a long serious face, white sideburns trimmed immaculately, a steady gaze. White hair combed flat, pale grey eyes. A dark green steward's tailcoat #2a4a3a with silver buttons and a snow-white cravat, a small silver eagle badge on his chest, white gloves.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 鹰纹与伯爵家一致；他是仆人，衣服整洁，不镶金。

subject.zh: 二十五岁的人族吟游诗人，修长俊俏，笑容灿烂，眼神带点不羁。红棕卷发长到下巴，插一根彩色长羽，琥珀色眼睛。紫红短外套 #7a3a7a 配芥黄衬衫与腰带 #e0c060，斜挎一把旧鲁特琴，琴颈系着彩带。
subject.en: A twenty-five-year-old human bard, slender and handsome, a sunny smile with a hint of mischief. Red-brown curls to his chin with a long colorful feather tucked in, amber eyes. A magenta short jacket #7a3a7a with a mustard shirt and sash #e0c060, an old lute slung across his back with ribbons tied to its neck.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 紫红色偏亮偏红，不是暗紫。

subject.zh: 六十岁上下的人族老兵村长，结实，一条腿瘸着，拄一根木拐，脸上横着几道旧疤，花白的硬胡茬，开口就像要骂人。灰白短发剃得贴头，褐色眼睛。褪色的旧军外套 #5a5a4a 打着补丁，外披羊毛斗篷 #7a6a52，腰挂旧短刀。
subject.en: A human veteran village head around sixty, sturdy, lame in one leg and leaning on a wooden crutch, several old scars across his face, bristly grizzled stubble, looking like he is about to curse. Grey-white hair buzzed close, brown eyes. A faded, patched old military coat #5a5a4a under a wool cloak #7a6a52, an old short knife at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 木拐与旧军外套是辨识点。

subject.zh: 三十五岁上下的女人，清瘦，脸庞柔和，眼神警惕又温柔，话很少。乌黑长发编成一条松辫，用灰布条束住，深灰眼睛。素净的灰褐长裙 #6a6052 配一条厚实的深蓝围巾 #3a4a5a，围巾总围到下巴，手戴无指手套。
subject.en: A woman around thirty-five, slender with a soft face, watchful yet gentle eyes, very quiet. Jet-black hair in a loose braid tied with a grey cloth strip, dark grey eyes. A plain grey-brown dress #6a6052 with a thick deep blue scarf #3a4a5a always wrapped up to her chin, fingerless gloves on her hands.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 衣着朴素、低饱和；围巾与手套下面不画任何东西。

subject.zh: 三十五岁的人族卫兵长，身材敦实，脸膛宽，下巴刮得干净，嘴角挂着不信邪的冷笑。深褐短发压在一顶圆顶铁盔下，褐色眼睛半眯。灰蓝城防罩袍 #5a6a7a 套在链甲外，皮护肩 #8a7a5a，手持一柄长戟。
subject.en: A thirty-five-year-old human gate sergeant, stocky with a broad face and a clean-shaven jaw, a skeptical smirk. Dark brown short hair under a round iron helmet, half-closed brown eyes. A grey-blue watch tabard #5a6a7a over mail, leather shoulder guards #8a7a5a, a long halberd in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 他什么都不信：表情多是不屑。

subject.zh: 十二岁的人族孤女，瘦小灵活，晒黑的脸上沾着河泥，鼻头翘，眼睛机灵大胆。红褐短发被风吹得乱翘，用麻绳随便扎着，褐色眼睛。灰蓝粗布短衫 #6a7a8a 卷着袖子，土褐短裤 #a08a6a，光着脚，腰挂一只装铜板的小布袋。
subject.en: A twelve-year-old human orphan girl, small and nimble, river mud on her sun-darkened face, an upturned nose, bold clever eyes. Red-brown short hair tousled by the wind and tied any old way with hemp twine, brown eyes. A grey-blue coarse short shirt #6a7a8a with rolled sleeves, earth-brown shorts #a08a6a, bare feet, a little cloth pouch of coppers at her waist.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她在渡口打杂：衣服常湿，神情大胆。

subject.zh: 四十五岁上下的人族女税务官，瘦削，脸窄，嘴唇薄，眉头总微微皱着，眼神挑剔。深棕头发紧紧盘成小髻，鼻梁上架着方框眼镜，灰色眼睛。深灰高领长裙 #4a4a50 配黑色袖套，腰挂一串算珠与一只墨水瓶，怀抱账簿。
subject.en: A human tax officer around forty-five, thin with a narrow face and thin lips, brows always slightly knitted, a fault-finding gaze. Dark brown hair in a tight small bun, square-framed glasses on her nose, grey eyes. A dark grey high-collared dress #4a4a50 with black sleeve guards, a string of abacus beads and an ink bottle at her waist, a ledger in her arms.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 账簿上没有字与数字。

subject.zh: 五十二岁的人族首席骑士，高大厚重，方下巴，鼻梁有断过的痕迹，眼神沉静如铁。灰金短发与修剪整齐的短须，浅灰眼睛。打磨光亮的全身板甲 #a8acb4 外罩深绿镶金的家族罩袍 #2a4a3a，胸口绣鹰纹，背一面大盾，腰挂长剑。
subject.en: A fifty-two-year-old human first knight, tall and heavy, a square jaw, a nose that has been broken, a gaze as calm as iron. Grey-blond short hair and a neatly trimmed short beard, pale grey eyes. Polished full plate #a8acb4 under a dark green family surcoat with gold trim #2a4a3a embroidered with an eagle, a large shield on his back, a longsword at his hip.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 伯爵家的深绿罩袍与鹰纹；气势要稳重。

subject.zh: 二十四岁的人族贵族小姐，身材纤长，五官端庄，眉宇间透着务实的聪明，嘴角带一点俏皮。蜂蜜金长发编成冠状盘在头上，浅蓝眼睛。淡天蓝丝绸长裙 #8ab0d0 配银灰短披肩 #b8bcc4，手上沾了一点墨，怀里抱着一卷画满线条的图纸。
subject.en: A twenty-four-year-old human noble lady, tall and slender with composed features, practical cleverness about her brows, a hint of playfulness at her mouth. Honey-blonde hair braided into a crown around her head, pale blue eyes. A pale sky blue silk gown #8ab0d0 with a silver-grey short cape #b8bcc4, a smudge of ink on her hand, a rolled sheet of line drawings in her arms.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 图纸上只有线条，没有字与数字。

subject.zh: 三十三岁的半身人账房，个子只到常人腰间，圆脸，脸颊有雀斑状的吉斑，嘴角挂着算计的微笑。深棕卷发梳得服帖，左眼挂一片单片眼镜，黑眼睛精明。墨蓝海员式短外套 #2a3a5a 配黄铜扣，腰挂一串九颗珠子的算珠与一把短剑。
subject.en: A thirty-three-year-old halfling accountant who stands only to an adult's waist, a round face with lucky freckle-spots, a calculating little smile. Dark brown curls combed flat, a monocle in his left eye, shrewd black eyes. An ink-blue sailor-style short jacket #2a3a5a with brass buttons, a string of nine abacus beads and a short sword at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 九颗珠子的算珠是他的外号与标志。
