items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 他常年待在地下：脸色苍白；粉笔灰是辨识点。

subject.zh: 四十六岁的人族圣骑士副团长，高大厚实，方脸，下巴短须，眼神坚定而仁厚。深棕短发，褐色眼睛。白银板甲 #c8ccd4 外罩绣金色光环的白罩袍，肩披深蓝斗篷 #2a3a6a，左臂挎一面绘着光环的大鸢盾。
subject.en: A forty-six-year-old human paladin vice grand master, tall and thick, a square face with a short beard, resolute and kindly eyes. Dark brown short hair, brown eyes. Silver plate #c8ccd4 under a white surcoat embroidered with a gold halo, a deep blue cloak #2a3a6a, a large kite shield painted with a halo on his left arm.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与大团长同款深蓝斗篷；他以盾为标志。

subject.zh: 四十一岁的人族女卫队长，高大结实，短下巴，神情严肃，眼神警觉如守门人。黑色短发剪得贴耳，深褐眼睛。金边白钢板甲 #d8dade 外罩白金相间的卫队罩袍 #f2efe6、#c8a040，手持长戟，头盔夹在臂下。
subject.en: A forty-one-year-old human woman captain of the temple guard, tall and sturdy, a short chin, a serious expression, eyes as watchful as a gatekeeper's. Black hair cropped close to the ears, dark brown eyes. Gold-edged white steel plate #d8dade under a guard surcoat of white and gold #f2efe6, #c8a040, a long halberd in hand, a helmet tucked under her arm.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 圣殿卫队的白金配色。

subject.zh: 四十四岁的人族首席执行官，精悍高瘦，脸窄而冷，嘴角一丝冷笑，眼神像在找可拆的地方。灰黑短发向后梳，灰色眼睛。白色审判庭罩袍 #eceef2 下是灵便的黑铁甲，腰间挂撬棍与一串铁钥匙，背一柄双手大剑。
subject.en: A forty-four-year-old human chief executor, lean and tall, a narrow cold face, a faint sneer, eyes searching for something to tear down. Salt-and-pepper short hair combed back, grey eyes. A white inquisition surcoat #eceef2 over nimble black iron armor, a crowbar and a ring of iron keys at his belt, a two-handed greatsword on his back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号锁匠：撬棍与钥匙是标志。

subject.zh: 三十三岁的人族女侍从骑士，修长矫健，脸庞明朗，眼神执着，鼻梁上有晒斑。栗色长发编成一条粗辫，灰绿眼睛。轻便的白银半身甲 #c8ccd4 外罩深蓝旅行斗篷 #2a3a6a，腰挂长剑，怀里揣着一张卷起的河道图。
subject.en: A thirty-three-year-old human woman squire knight, tall and agile, an open bright face, determined eyes, sun freckles on her nose. Chestnut long hair in a thick braid, grey-green eyes. Light silver half plate #c8ccd4 under a deep blue travel cloak #2a3a6a, a longsword at her hip, a rolled river map tucked in her coat.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号寻船人：河道图是辨识点，图上没有字。

subject.zh: 三十一岁的人族皇族青年，高大英武，下巴方正，眉眼与剑帝有几分相似，嘴角带着傲气，眼神多疑。铁灰短发剪得利落，灰色眼睛。镶金的黑钢板甲 #2e2e30 外披帝国紫披风 #5a2a6a，胸前双剑交叉的金徽，腰佩华丽长剑。
subject.en: A thirty-one-year-old human young imperial prince, tall and martial, a square jaw, features somewhat like the emperor's, a proud mouth, suspicious eyes. Neatly cut iron-grey short hair, grey eyes. Gold-trimmed black steel plate #2e2e30 under an imperial purple cape #5a2a6a, a gold badge of crossed swords on his chest, an ornate longsword at his hip.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与剑帝同为帝国紫与黑甲，但甲镶金、剑华丽，与剑帝的朴素相反。

subject.zh: 二十九岁的人族年轻参谋，瘦高，脸庞清秀，眼神机敏，嘴角带着书生气的笑。浅褐头发剪短，鼻梁上一副细框眼镜，灰蓝眼睛。赭红参谋军装 #7a3a2a 配铁灰肩章，胸前别着几枚地图钉，手里卷着一张沙盘地图。
subject.en: A twenty-nine-year-old human young staff officer, tall and thin with fine features, quick eyes, a bookish smile. Short light brown hair, thin-rimmed glasses, grey-blue eyes. An ochre-red staff uniform #7a3a2a with iron-grey epaulettes, a few map pins stuck on his chest, a rolled sand-table map in his hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 地图上只有线条与色块。

subject.zh: 五十六岁的人族谍报司长，中等身材，脸庞平凡得让人记不住，嘴角一抹淡淡的笑，眼神却深不见底。灰发剪短，灰色眼睛。朴素的灰色长外套 #6a6a6e 扣到领口，戴灰手套，胸前一枚不起眼的灰铁徽，手拿一只灰色文件夹。
subject.en: A fifty-six-year-old human spymaster, medium build with a face so ordinary it is hard to remember, a faint smile, eyes of bottomless depth. Short grey hair, grey eyes. A plain grey long coat #6a6a6e buttoned to the collar, grey gloves, an inconspicuous grey iron badge on his chest, a grey folder in his hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 全身灰色调，刻意不起眼。

subject.zh: 五十岁的人族女度支卿，身材敦实，脸庞宽，眼神精明而强硬，嘴角带一丝讥讽。深褐头发盘成紧髻，插一支铁簪，褐色眼睛。赭红与黑的文官长袍 #6a2e22、#1e1e22，胸前一枚麦穗与天平的金章，腋下夹着厚厚的账册。
subject.en: A fifty-year-old human woman imperial treasurer, stocky with a broad face, shrewd and tough eyes, a hint of sarcasm at her mouth. Dark brown hair in a tight bun with an iron hairpin, brown eyes. A civil robe in ochre-red and black #6a2e22, #1e1e22, a gold medal of wheat and scales on her chest, a thick ledger under her arm.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 帝国文官的赭红；账册上不写字。

subject.zh: 六十二岁的人族帝国大主教，高大，脸庞方正，眉毛浓重，神情庄严中带着世故。灰白头发剪短，灰色眼睛。白色主教长袍 #f2efe6 外罩赭红披带 #8a3a22，胸前光环金章，头戴白色主教冠，手持光环权杖。
subject.en: A sixty-two-year-old human imperial archbishop, tall with a square face and heavy brows, solemn yet worldly. Short grey-white hair, grey eyes. A white bishop's robe #f2efe6 with an ochre-red stole #8a3a22, a gold halo medal on his chest, a white mitre, a halo scepter in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 帝国的赭红披带区别于教国的深红。

subject.zh: 六十六岁的人族女公爵，丰腴端庄，脸庞圆润，眼神精明而傲慢，嘴角带着矜持的笑。银白长发盘起，戴一顶麦穗编成的金色细冠，浅褐眼睛。麦黄色锦缎长裙 #c8a050 配赭红披肩 #8a3a22，手上戴着家族的印戒。
subject.en: A sixty-six-year-old human duchess, full-figured and dignified, a round face, shrewd and haughty eyes, a reserved smile. Silver-white hair pinned up under a fine gold circlet woven like wheat ears, light brown eyes. A wheat-yellow brocade gown #c8a050 with an ochre-red shawl #8a3a22, the family signet ring on her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号麦冠：麦穗形细冠是标志。

subject.zh: 四十七岁的人族斗场主，高大发福，满面红光，大胡子打着蜡卷，笑声洪亮，眼神精明。黑色卷发抹得油亮，褐色眼睛。华丽的金红条纹外套 #c8902a、#8a1c22 敞着领口，胸前挂粗金链，手拿一只铜制传声喇叭。
subject.en: A forty-seven-year-old human arena master, tall and portly, beaming red-faced, a big waxed curled moustache, a booming laugh, shrewd eyes. Oiled black curls, brown eyes. A flashy gold and red striped coat #c8902a, #8a1c22 open at the collar, a thick gold chain on his chest, a brass speaking trumpet in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号金嗓：传声喇叭是他的标志。

subject.zh: 二十八岁的人族女斗士，精壮高挑，肩臂肌肉结实，脸上几道新旧伤痕，嘴角挂着不服的笑，眼神如火。赭红短发剃掉一侧，深褐眼睛。无袖的皮质斗士胸甲 #6a3a22，双臂缠着绷带，腰系红布带，手握一柄阔刃短剑。
subject.en: A twenty-eight-year-old human woman gladiator, tall and powerful with solid shoulders and arms, old and new scars on her face, a defiant grin, fiery eyes. Ochre-red short hair shaved on one side, dark brown eyes. A sleeveless leather gladiator's cuirass #6a3a22, bandages wound around both arms, a red cloth sash, a broad short sword in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号不倒：神情始终不服输；与拳手萨莎区分，她用剑。

subject.zh: 五十四岁的人族女大匠，结实，宽肩，手臂粗壮，脸上有炉火烘出的红印，眼神严谨。灰褐短发用皮带束住，额上推着一副护目镜，灰色眼睛。赭红帝国工服 #7a3a2a 外系厚皮围裙，腰挂卡尺与锻锤，胸前挂一枚齿轮形铁徽。
subject.en: A fifty-four-year-old human woman master smith, sturdy and broad-shouldered with powerful arms, red marks from forge heat on her face, rigorous eyes. Grey-brown short hair held by a leather band, goggles pushed up on her forehead, grey eyes. An ochre-red imperial work uniform #7a3a2a under a thick leather apron, calipers and a forging hammer at her belt, a gear-shaped iron badge on her chest.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 齿轮铁徽是兵工监的标志。

subject.zh: 七十七岁的人族老铁匠，矮壮，背宽厚，双臂筋肉虬结，脸上满是火星烫出的小疤，白色络腮胡被燎得参差，眼神平静。秃顶，一只耳边挂着小小的铜听筒，灰色眼睛。焦黑的皮围裙 #3a2e24 罩着破旧衬衫，手握一把长柄火钳。
subject.en: A seventy-seven-year-old human old blacksmith, short with a broad back, knotted arm muscles, a face covered in tiny spark burns, a white full beard singed ragged, a calm gaze. Bald, a small brass ear trumpet hooked by one ear, grey eyes. A scorched black leather apron #3a2e24 over a ragged shirt, a long-handled pair of fire tongs in his grip.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号火钳：长柄火钳是标志；看起来只是耳背的老铁匠。

subject.zh: 六十三岁的人族面摊老板娘，矮胖，圆脸红润，笑容和蔼，手臂却结实得出奇，眼神平静。灰白头发包在一块白头巾里，褐色眼睛。洗旧的蓝布衫 #4a6a8a 系白围裙，袖子卷到肘，手握一把长柄汤勺。
subject.en: A sixty-three-year-old human noodle stall owner, short and plump, a ruddy round face, a kindly smile, yet surprisingly strong arms, a calm gaze. Grey-white hair wrapped in a white headscarf, brown eyes. A worn blue cloth shirt #4a6a8a with a white apron, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a long-handled ladle in her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号汤勺：她看起来只是面摊老板娘，手臂的结实是唯一的破绽。

subject.zh: 三十九岁的人族女剑卫长，高挑精悍，脸庞冷峻，下颌线条硬，眼神像出鞘的剑。黑色短发剃到耳上，灰色眼睛。黑钢轻甲 #2e2e30 配帝国紫肩带 #5a2a6a，背后交叉挂着两柄长剑，戴黑手套。
subject.en: A thirty-nine-year-old human woman captain of the sword guard, tall and lean, a cold face with a hard jawline, eyes like a drawn blade. Black hair shaved above the ears, grey eyes. Black steel light armor #2e2e30 with an imperial purple shoulder sash #5a2a6a, two longswords crossed on her back, black gloves.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 剑帝亲卫的黑钢与帝国紫；背后双剑是标志。

subject.zh: 五十七岁的人族军团长，敦实，脸庞方正，被风沙磨得粗糙，花白短须，眼神谨慎沉稳。灰发剃短，褐色眼睛。帝国制式钢甲 #8a8a90 外披赭红斗篷 #8a3a22，胸前军团铁徽，腰挂一卷工事图与一把工兵锤。
subject.en: A fifty-seven-year-old human legion commander, stocky with a square face roughened by wind and sand, a grizzled short beard, cautious steady eyes. Grey hair cropped short, brown eyes. Imperial-pattern steel armor #8a8a90 under an ochre-red cloak #8a3a22, an iron legion badge on his chest, a rolled fortification plan and a sapper's hammer at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 军团铁徽不写数字；工事图上只有线条。

subject.zh: 四十五岁的人族女战祭，魁梧，满身战疤，脸颊画着两道暗红的纹，眼神狂热，嘴角咧开。暗红长发编成粗辫，缀着铁环，琥珀色眼睛。赤黑相间的皮甲 #6a1e1e、#1e1a1a，肩披一块破旧的红帐布，腰挂断剑形铁坠与一柄战斧。
subject.en: A forty-five-year-old human woman war-priestess, massive and covered in battle scars, two dark red stripes painted on her cheeks, fervent eyes, a wide grin. Dark red long hair in a thick braid hung with iron rings, amber eyes. Red and black leather armor #6a1e1e, #1e1a1a, a ragged red tent cloth over her shoulders, a broken-sword iron pendant and a battleaxe at her belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号血帐：肩上的红帐布是标志；脸上的是颜料，不是血。

subject.zh: 四十八岁的人族骑兵军团长，高大精悍，脸窄长，被高沼的风吹得黝黑，灰黑短须，眼神古怪而沉郁。黑发夹灰，扎成短辫，灰色眼睛。厚重的骑兵钢甲 #6a6a70 外披灰褐狼皮斗篷，胸前军团铁徽，腰佩骑兵弯刀。
subject.en: A forty-eight-year-old human cavalry legion commander, tall and lean, a long narrow face darkened by moorland wind, a salt-and-pepper short beard, odd, brooding eyes. Black hair streaked with grey in a short braid, grey eyes. Heavy cavalry steel armor #6a6a70 under a grey-brown wolfskin cloak, an iron legion badge on his chest, a cavalry saber at his hip.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号高沼狼：他的狼皮斗篷偏褐，与元帅的灰狼皮区分。

subject.zh: 四十四岁的人族女战法师团长，修长，脸庞冷静，眉毛细直，眼神像在丈量距离，鬓角一道细小的烫疤。红铜色头发剪到齐肩，琥珀色眼睛。赭红战法师长袍 #8a3a22 镶黑边，外罩皮质护胸，手持一根顶端嵌红晶的铁杖。
subject.en: A forty-four-year-old human woman battle mage commander, tall and slender, a calm face with thin straight brows, eyes that seem to measure distance, a thin burn scar at her temple. Copper-red hair cut at the shoulders, amber eyes. An ochre-red battle mage's robe #8a3a22 with black trim under a leather chest guard, an iron staff topped with a red crystal.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 红晶是火系法杖的晶石，不发紫光。

subject.zh: 五十二岁的人族驿运总长，矮壮，脸膛红，两撇浓密的八字胡，眼神忙碌而务实。灰褐短发压在一顶带帽檐的驿运制帽下，褐色眼睛。赭红驿运制服外套 #7a3a2a 配黄铜扣，斜挎一只大信袋，腰挂铜哨与一块车队木牌。
subject.en: A fifty-two-year-old human postal-road director, short and sturdy, a red face, a bushy handlebar moustache, busy, practical eyes. Grey-brown short hair under a brimmed courier cap, brown eyes. An ochre-red courier uniform coat #7a3a2a with brass buttons, a big satchel across his chest, a brass whistle and a wooden caravan tag at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 帝国驿运的赭红制服，与洛萨驿卒的深蓝区分；木牌上不写字。

subject.zh: 三十八岁的人族女会首，高大结实，晒得黝黑，肩臂有力，下巴一道细疤，眼神爽快坚定。黑色卷发扎成粗马尾，用一截缆绳绑着，深褐眼睛。袖子卷起的海蓝工装 #2a5a7a 配厚皮马甲，肩上盘着一圈粗缆绳，手戴磨旧的皮手套。
subject.en: A thirty-eight-year-old human woman dock guild head, tall and sturdy, deeply tanned with strong shoulders and arms, a thin scar on her chin, a frank resolute gaze. Black curls in a thick ponytail tied with a length of rope, dark brown eyes. A sea blue work shirt with rolled sleeves #2a5a7a under a thick leather vest, a coil of heavy rope over her shoulder, worn leather gloves.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号缆绳：肩上的粗缆绳是标志。

subject.zh: 七十岁的人族老馆长，瘦小，背微驼，脸窄，白色山羊胡修得尖尖的，眼神锐利而幽默。稀疏白发向后梳，鼻梁上一副金丝圆眼镜，灰色眼睛。黑色律师长袍 #1e1e22 配白色宽翻领，胸前挂一枚卷轴形银章，手捧一册厚厚的宪章抄本。
subject.en: A seventy-year-old human old charter keeper, small and slightly stooped, a narrow face with a pointed white goatee, sharp yet humorous eyes. Thin white hair combed back, gold-rimmed round glasses, grey eyes. A black lawyer's gown #1e1e22 with a wide white collar, a scroll-shaped silver badge on his chest, a thick bound copy of the charter in his hands.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 抄本上不写字。

subject.zh: 五十五岁的港半身人总监，个子只到常人腰间，圆脸，脸颊有雀斑状的吉斑，眉头微皱像在心算。灰褐卷发梳得整齐，鼻梁上一副方框眼镜，褐色眼睛。海蓝短外套 #2a5a7a 配一排铜扣，指尖沾着墨与印泥，腋下夹着一叠汇票。
subject.en: A fifty-five-year-old harbor halfling bill-office director who stands only to an adult's waist, a round face with lucky freckle-spots, a slight frown as if calculating in his head. Neatly combed grey-brown curls, square-framed glasses, brown eyes. A sea blue short jacket #2a5a7a with a row of copper clasps, ink and seal paste on his fingertips, a stack of bills of exchange under his arm.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号铜扣：一排铜扣是标志；汇票上不写字与数字。

subject.zh: 一百四十二岁的矮人女大司祭，方形身板，神情庄重，脸颊有细小的铁灰矿纹，眼神沉静如秤。银白鬓发编成两条长辫，缀着金秤形小环，深褐眼睛。金黄与白的祭司长袍 #d8b040、#f0ece4，胸前挂一架小金秤，腰挂一串沉重的旧铜钥匙。
subject.en: A hundred-and-forty-two-year-old dwarf woman high priestess, square-built with a solemn bearing, fine iron-grey ore flecks on her cheeks, eyes as steady as a balance. Silver-white sidelocks in two long braids hung with tiny gold scale-shaped rings, dark brown eyes. A priestess robe in gold and white #d8b040, #f0ece4, a small gold balance on her chest, a ring of heavy old copper keys at her waist.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 女性矮人不画胡须；金秤是交易女神神职的标志。

subject.zh: 五十九岁的人族女秤主，瘦高，脸庞被海风与盐晒得发白，眼神冷静挑剔，薄唇紧抿。银灰长发盘成高髻，插一支玻璃簪，灰蓝眼睛。白与浅蓝的厚绸长裙 #e8eef0、#8ab0c8，胸前挂一枚秤形小金章与一片磨光的镜面玻璃坠。
subject.en: A fifty-nine-year-old human woman scale-master, tall and thin, a face bleached by sea wind and salt, calm fault-finding eyes, thin pressed lips. Silver-grey hair in a high bun with a glass hairpin, grey-blue eyes. A heavy silk gown in white and pale blue #e8eef0, #8ab0c8, a small scales-shaped gold badge and a polished mirror-glass pendant on her chest.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 镜面玻璃坠是她的标志。

subject.zh: 四十八岁的人族银行家，中等身材，脸庞圆润，嘴角挂着得体的商人笑，眼神算计。黑发梳成油亮的偏分，留着细胡子，褐色眼睛。炭灰长外套 #3a3a3e 套着一双灰色长袖套，酒红领巾 #7a1e2a，胸前秤形金章，手拿一份合约。
subject.en: A forty-eight-year-old human banker, medium build with a round face, a polished merchant's smile, calculating eyes. Black hair slicked into a shiny side part, a thin moustache, brown eyes. A charcoal long coat #3a3a3e with grey sleeve covers, a wine red cravat #7a1e2a, a scales-shaped gold badge on his chest, a contract in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号灰袖：灰色长袖套是标志；配色随金冠派的炭灰与酒红；合约上不写字。

subject.zh: 九十六岁的矮人女裁缝，方形身板，粗壮的手指却灵巧，脸颊有铁灰矿纹，眼神挑剔而骄傲。灰白鬓发编成两条粗辫，别着一排九根银针，深褐眼睛。深酒红的裁缝工作裙 #6a1e2a 配皮围裙，脖子上挂着软尺，胸前插着划粉。
subject.en: A ninety-six-year-old dwarf woman tailor, square-built with thick yet nimble fingers, iron-grey ore flecks on her cheeks, a critical proud gaze. Grey-white sidelocks in two thick braids pinned with a row of nine silver needles, dark brown eyes. A deep wine red tailor's work dress #6a1e2a with a leather apron, a tape measure around her neck, tailor's chalk tucked at her chest.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号九针：发辫上的九根银针是标志；不画胡须。

subject.zh: 四十一岁的港半身人女司钟，个子只到常人腰间，圆脸，脸颊有雀斑状的吉斑，眼神机敏，嘴巴总在飞快报价。栗色卷发剪成齐耳，插一支铅笔，绿色眼睛。海蓝马甲 #2a5a7a 配白衬衫，胸前挂一只小铜钟，手拿敲钟的小锤。
subject.en: A forty-one-year-old harbor halfling woman exchange bell-keeper who stands only to an adult's waist, a round face with lucky freckle-spots, quick eyes, a mouth always rattling off prices. Chestnut curls cut at the ears with a pencil tucked in, green eyes. A sea blue waistcoat #2a5a7a over a white shirt, a small brass bell hanging on her chest, a little striking hammer in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 小铜钟与小锤是她的标志。

subject.zh: 五十三岁的人族执政官，中等身材，脸庞方正，短须修剪整齐，眼神圆滑又疲惫。灰黑头发向后梳，褐色眼睛。左右两半配色不同的官服，一边海蓝 #2a5a7a、一边赭红 #8a3a22，胸前挂一枚桥形银章，手拿一本关税簿。
subject.en: A fifty-three-year-old human magistrate, medium build with a square face, a neatly trimmed short beard, smooth yet weary eyes. Salt-and-pepper hair combed back, brown eyes. An official coat split down the middle in two colors, sea blue #2a5a7a on one side and ochre-red #8a3a22 on the other, a bridge-shaped silver badge on his chest, a customs ledger in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号两岸：左右两色的官服是标志；关税簿上不写字。

subject.zh: 三十三岁的丘居半身人女潜者，个子只到常人腰间，结实，圆脸被海水泡得黝黑，脸颊有雀斑状的吉斑，笑容灵动。湿漉漉的深褐卷发贴在额头，海绿色眼睛。贴身的海豹皮潜水衣 #3a4a50，腰挂网兜与短刀，脖子上挂一只螺号。
subject.en: A thirty-three-year-old hill halfling woman diver who stands only to an adult's waist, sturdy, a round face darkened by seawater, lucky freckle-spots on her cheeks, a lively smile. Wet dark brown curls stuck to her forehead, sea green eyes. A close-fitting sealskin diving suit #3a4a50, a net bag and short knife at her waist, a conch horn hanging at her neck.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号长息：颈上的螺号是标志。

subject.zh: 六十八岁的丘居半身人老妈妈，个子只到常人腰间，圆滚滚的，红润的圆脸笑容慈祥，脸颊有雀斑状的吉斑。灰白卷发包在一块碎花头巾里，褐色眼睛。暖黄围裙 #d8a040 罩着赭红长裙 #8a4a2a，手里端着一盘冒热气的馅饼。
subject.en: A sixty-eight-year-old hill halfling granny who stands only to an adult's waist, round as a dumpling, a ruddy round face with a kindly smile, lucky freckle-spots on her cheeks. Grey-white curls wrapped in a small flowered headscarf, brown eyes. A warm yellow apron #d8a040 over a rust-red dress #8a4a2a, a steaming plate of pies in her hands.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她总在招呼人吃饭：神情温暖。

subject.zh: 一百三十一岁的深炉矮人炉长，方形身板，肤色苍白，脸颊有银白矿纹，眼神沉稳。长须编成三股粗辫，须尾被炉火燎成余烬般的暗红，银灰眼睛反光。厚重的黑皮炉工服 #2e2a26，额上推着一副深色护目镜，手握长柄火钳。
subject.en: A hundred-and-thirty-one-year-old deep-forge dwarf furnace master, square-built, pale-skinned with silver-white ore flecks on his cheeks, a steady gaze. A long beard in three thick braids whose tips are singed a dark ember red, silver-grey eyes that catch the light. Heavy black leather forge clothes #2e2a26, dark goggles pushed up on his forehead, long-handled tongs in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号烬须：须尾的暗红是辨识点；深炉矮人肤色苍白。

subject.zh: 一百七十四岁的深炉矮人女大匠，方形身板，肤色苍白如石，脸颊满是银白矿纹，神情冷峻专注。银白鬓发编成两条粗辫，缀着白铁环，淡银色眼睛。灰白皮工作服 #b8b4ac 外系黑围裙，额上一副厚护目镜，手握一柄白色小锻锤。
subject.en: A hundred-and-seventy-four-year-old deep-forge dwarf woman master smith, square-built, skin pale as stone, cheeks full of silver-white ore flecks, cold and focused. Silver-white sidelocks in two thick braids hung with white iron rings, pale silver eyes. A grey-white leather work suit #b8b4ac with a black apron, thick goggles on her forehead, a small white forging hammer in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号白砧：全身偏白；不画胡须。

subject.zh: 一百六十岁的矮人契石官，方形身板，脸庞方正严肃，铁灰矿纹，眉毛浓重，眼神像在审视契约。灰白长须编成整齐的双辫，缀着石质小环，深褐眼睛。深灰石色长袍 #6a6660，胸前挂一块刻着秤纹的小石板，手握一枚石印章。
subject.en: A hundred-and-sixty-year-old dwarf contract-stone officer, square-built with a stern square face, iron-grey ore flecks, heavy brows, eyes that seem to scrutinize a contract. A grey-white long beard in two neat braids hung with small stone rings, dark brown eyes. A dark stone-grey robe #6a6660, a small stone tablet engraved with a scales emblem on his chest, a stone seal in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 石板与印章上只有秤纹图形，不刻字。

subject.zh: 八十八岁的矮人女将，方形身板，肩宽厚，下巴方硬如铁，脸颊有铁灰矿纹，眼神坚定不移。铜红鬓发编成粗辫盘在脑后，缀着铁环，深褐眼睛。厚重的铁灰板甲 #5a5a60，左臂挎一面巨大的方形塔盾，腰挂战锤。
subject.en: An eighty-eight-year-old dwarf woman general, square-built and broad-shouldered, a jaw hard and square as iron, iron-grey ore flecks on her cheeks, unwavering eyes. Copper-red sidelocks braided and coiled at the back hung with iron rings, dark brown eyes. Heavy iron-grey plate #5a5a60, a huge square tower shield on her left arm, a warhammer at her belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号铁颚：方硬的下巴是辨识点；不画胡须。

subject.zh: 七十三岁的矮人炮师，方形身板，眉毛被火燎得只剩一半，脸上有火药熏黑的痕迹，铁灰矿纹，眼神专注。深棕长须编成短粗的单辫，缀着铜环，褐色眼睛。焦黑的皮炮手服 #3a2e24 配黄铜护目镜，腰挂一串装晶粉的小皮袋，肩扛铜点火杆。
subject.en: A seventy-three-year-old dwarf cannoneer, square-built, eyebrows half singed away, powder soot on his face, iron-grey ore flecks, focused eyes. A dark brown beard in one short thick braid with copper rings, brown eyes. A scorched black leather gunner's suit #3a2e24 with brass goggles, small leather pouches of crystal powder at his belt, a brass linstock on his shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 晶粉是灰白色，不发紫光。

subject.zh: 四十六岁的人族女医者，瘦削，脸庞疲惫却温和，眼角细纹，嘴角紧抿。深棕头发包在苔绿头巾里，褐色眼睛。洗旧的苔绿长袍 #5a6a4a 配白围裙，一块布口罩挂在颈下，腰挂药箱与一串草药，袖口沾着煤灰。
subject.en: A forty-six-year-old human woman healer, thin, a tired but gentle face, fine lines at her eyes, lips pressed tight. Dark brown hair wrapped in a moss green headscarf, brown eyes. A worn moss green robe #5a6a4a with a white apron, a cloth face mask hanging at her neck, a medicine case and a bunch of herbs at her waist, coal dust on her cuffs.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她治矿镇的咳病：颈下的布口罩是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一百五十一岁的深炉矮人扫炉人，方形身板，背微驼，肤色苍白，脸颊有银白矿纹，满身煤灰，眼神平静得出奇。雪白长须编成两股，奇怪的是一点煤灰也不沾，银灰眼睛。破旧的黑布工服 #2a2a2a，手握长柄扫帚，腰挂煤灰桶。
subject.en: A hundred-and-fifty-one-year-old deep-forge dwarf furnace sweeper, square-built and slightly stooped, pale skin with silver-white ore flecks, covered in coal dust, a strangely calm gaze. A snow-white long beard in two braids that, oddly, holds not a speck of soot, silver-grey eyes. Ragged black cloth work clothes #2a2a2a, a long-handled broom in his grip, a soot bucket at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 唯一的破绽：满身煤灰，胡子却雪白干净。

subject.zh: 四十四岁的铃路半身人女运务长，个子只到常人腰间，圆脸，脸颊有雀斑状的吉斑，神情干练。深棕卷发编成一条短辫，绿褐色眼睛。厚实的赭褐旅行斗篷 #7a5a3a，胸前斜挎一串成排的小铜铃，腰挂地图筒与哨子。
subject.en: A forty-four-year-old bell-road halfling woman logistics chief who stands only to an adult's waist, a round face with lucky freckle-spots, a capable look. Dark brown curls in a short braid, green-brown eyes. A thick ochre-brown travel cloak #7a5a3a, a sash strung with a row of small copper bells across her chest, a map tube and a whistle at her belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 成排的铃铛是铃路会的标志。

subject.zh: 七十一岁的铃路半身人老信差，个子只到常人腰间，圆脸皱纹密布，脸颊有雀斑状的吉斑，笑容慢悠悠的，眼神却像能看穿人。白色卷发蓬松，褐色眼睛。褪色的土黄信差外套 #a08a5a，腰挂一只旧铜铃，背鼓鼓的信袋，拄一根短手杖。
subject.en: A seventy-one-year-old bell-road halfling old courier who stands only to an adult's waist, a round, finely wrinkled face with lucky freckle-spots, an unhurried smile, yet eyes that seem to see right through you. Fluffy white curls, brown eyes. A faded ochre courier's coat #a08a5a, an old copper bell at his waist, a bulging mail sack on his back, a short walking stick.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号慢铃：看起来只是走路很慢的老信差。

subject.zh: 四十岁的人族副团长，瘦高精干，脸窄，薄唇，眼神冷静得像在核对条款。黑色短发梳得服帖，深褐眼睛。金黄与海蓝的军团制服 #c8a040、#2a5a7a 外罩半身钢甲，胸前秤形金章，耳后夹一支红色羽笔，腰佩长剑。
subject.en: A forty-year-old human vice commander, tall, thin and efficient, a narrow face with thin lips, eyes as calm as someone checking clauses. Neat black short hair, dark brown eyes. A legion uniform in gold and sea blue #c8a040, #2a5a7a under a steel half-plate, a scales-shaped gold badge on his chest, a red quill tucked behind his ear, a longsword at his hip.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号红笔：耳后的红色羽笔是标志。

subject.zh: 千岁的精灵长老，高大清瘦，长耳向后上方斜伸，银白长发从根白到梢、发梢仍带苔绿，太阳穴与锁骨有密密的年轮纹，神情沉默而固执，深绿眼睛。深褐与苔绿的长老袍 #4a3a2a、#5a6a3a，肩上是树皮纹的护肩，手持盘根木杖。
subject.en: A thousand-year-old elf elder, tall and gaunt, long ears sweeping up and back, silver-white hair from root to tip with moss green still at the ends, dense growth-ring marks at his temples and collarbone, silent and stubborn, deep green eyes. An elder's robe in dark brown and moss green #4a3a2a, #5a6a3a, bark-textured pauldrons, a staff of tangled roots.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 根环氏的深褐、苔绿与树皮护肩；与艾尔温区分，他的袍子偏深褐，没有耳坠。

subject.zh: 五百多岁的精灵女先知，纤细苍白，长耳向后上方斜伸，太阳穴有五圈浅色年轮纹，常年闭着双眼，神情神秘安静。苍白近银的长发垂到膝，缀着几缕苔色丝线。苍白与苔色的层叠薄袍 #e0e4dc、#8a9a6a，额前系一条苔绿发带。
subject.en: An elf woman seer over five hundred years old, slender and pale, long ears sweeping up and back, five pale growth-ring marks at her temples, eyes always closed, mysterious and quiet. Pale near-silver hair to her knees woven with a few moss-colored threads. Layered thin robes in pale white and moss #e0e4dc, #8a9a6a, a moss green band tied across her brow.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她总是闭着眼：四种表情都闭眼，靠眉与嘴变化。

subject.zh: 看上去三十来岁的精灵游猎长，修长精悍，长耳向后上方斜伸，太阳穴三圈浅色年轮纹，神情傲慢锐利，夏青色眼睛。青灰长发束成马尾，插着几根鹰羽。青灰与墨绿的猎装 #5a6a6e、#2a4a3a，左肩戴一只供鹰停落的皮护肩，背长弓。
subject.en: An elf hunt-master who looks about thirty, tall and lean, long ears sweeping up and back, three pale growth-ring marks at his temples, arrogant and sharp, summer teal eyes. Blue-grey long hair in a ponytail with a few hawk feathers. Hunting clothes in blue-grey and dark green #5a6a6e, #2a4a3a, a leather perch guard on his left shoulder for his hawk, a longbow on his back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号鹰羽：发间鹰羽与肩上的鹰架护肩是标志。

subject.zh: 看上去四十来岁的精灵女德鲁伊，修长温和，长耳向后上方斜伸，太阳穴四圈浅色年轮纹，神情宁静，琥珀色眼睛。深褐长发上戴一圈长满青苔的藤冠。深褐与苔绿的德鲁伊长袍 #4a3a2a、#5a6a3a，颈挂橡果与木珠串，手持一根抽芽的藤杖。
subject.en: An elf woman druid who looks about forty, tall and gentle, long ears sweeping up and back, four pale growth-ring marks at her temples, serene, amber eyes. Dark brown long hair crowned with a ring of moss-covered vines. A druid robe in dark brown and moss green #4a3a2a, #5a6a3a, a string of acorns and wooden beads at her neck, a sprouting vine staff in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号苔冠：长满青苔的藤冠是标志；冠上不插花。

subject.zh: 一百七十多岁、看上去二十出头的精灵青年，瘦削，长耳向后上方斜伸，太阳穴只有一圈年轮纹，神情激愤，眼神锋利，夏青色眼睛。青灰长发乱乱地扎起，额前垂着几缕。青灰与墨绿的轻猎装 #5a6a6e、#2a4a3a，腰挂一支折断的箭，背短弓。
subject.en: An elf youth over one hundred seventy who looks barely twenty, lean, long ears sweeping up and back, only one growth-ring mark at his temples, an indignant look, sharp summer teal eyes. Blue-grey long hair tied up messily with a few strands over his brow. Light hunting clothes in blue-grey and dark green #5a6a6e, #2a4a3a, a broken arrow hanging at his belt, a short bow on his back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号折箭：腰间那支折断的箭是标志。

subject.zh: 看上去三十来岁的精灵女集市主，修长优雅，长耳向后上方斜伸，太阳穴两圈年轮纹，下半张脸罩着灰紫薄纱，只露出一双含笑的灰蓝眼睛。银灰长发编成侧辫。灰紫与银的长袍 #7a7088、#c0c4cc，腰挂一本皮面账簿与一串银铃。
subject.en: An elf woman market-keeper who looks about thirty, tall and elegant, long ears sweeping up and back, two growth-ring marks at her temples, a thin grey-violet veil over the lower half of her face, only a pair of smiling grey-blue eyes showing. Silver-grey long hair in a side braid. A robe in grey-violet and silver #7a7088, #c0c4cc, a leather-bound ledger and a string of silver bells at her waist.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号面纱：灰紫偏浅偏灰，不是澱紫；账簿上不写字。

subject.zh: 看上去五十来岁的精灵老弓匠，高瘦，长耳向后上方斜伸，太阳穴六圈年轮纹，鬓角已白，神情孤僻安静，灰绿眼睛。灰白长发随便束在脑后。褪色而打着补丁的灰绿旧猎装 #6a7060，腰挂刮刀与弓弦，手握一段削到一半的弓胚。
subject.en: An elf old bowyer who looks about fifty, tall and thin, long ears sweeping up and back, six growth-ring marks at his temples, greying at the temples, solitary and quiet, grey-green eyes. Grey-white long hair tied back carelessly. Faded, patched grey-green old hunting clothes #6a7060, a scraper and bowstrings at his belt, a half-carved bow stave in his hands.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外放者：衣服旧而不带氏族纹饰。

subject.zh: 看上去三十来岁的精灵女织匠，纤细温柔，长耳向后上方斜伸，太阳穴四圈年轮纹，神情专注，浅蓝眼睛。银白长发编成一圈盘发，插一只新月形银织梭。浅蓝与白的长袍 #9ac0d8、#f0f4f4，肩上搭着一匹泛着微光的薄布。
subject.en: An elf woman weaver who looks about thirty, slender and gentle, long ears sweeping up and back, four growth-ring marks at her temples, focused, pale blue eyes. Silver-white hair braided into a coil and pinned with a crescent-shaped silver shuttle. A robe in pale blue and white #9ac0d8, #f0f4f4, a bolt of faintly shimmering thin cloth over her shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号月梭：新月形银织梭是标志。

subject.zh: 五十四岁的獾族兽人女德鲁伊，中相：脸上覆着灰白短毛，脸颊两道黑白相间的獾纹，短鼻吻，圆小的耳朵。矮壮结实，手指粗短，神情务实，黑亮的小眼睛。土褐厚皮袍 #6a5a40 挂满骨饰与干草药，手握一把挖根的短铲。
subject.en: A fifty-four-year-old badger beastfolk woman druid, middle aspect: grey-white short fur over her face with two black-and-white badger stripes down her cheeks, a short muzzle, small round ears. Short and sturdy with thick stubby fingers, a practical look, small shining black eyes. A heavy earth-brown hide robe #6a5a40 hung with bone charms and dried herbs, a short root-digging spade in her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号灰獾：脸上的黑白獾纹是辨识点。

subject.zh: 看上去四十来岁的精灵乐师，修长，长耳向后上方斜伸，额上一条宽布发带遮住太阳穴，神情慵懒忧郁，灰色眼睛半闭。苍白近银的长发披散到背。褪色的灰绿旅人外套 #6a7062，怀里抱一把断了一根弦的木竖琴。
subject.en: An elf musician who looks about forty, tall and slender, long ears sweeping up and back, a wide cloth headband across his brow hiding his temples, a languid melancholy look, half-closed grey eyes. Pale near-silver long hair loose down his back. A faded grey-green traveler's coat #6a7062, a wooden harp with one broken string in his arms.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号断弦：断了一根弦的竖琴是标志；发带始终遮住太阳穴。

subject.zh: 八十三岁的老妇人，瘦小而挺直，满脸慈和的皱纹，眼神明亮温暖，嘴角带笑。雪白长发编成许多细辫，盘在头顶，缀着木珠。洗旧的灰褐亚麻长袍 #8a8070，披一条苔绿手织披肩 #5a6a4a，颈挂一只小木笛。
subject.en: An eighty-three-year-old elderly woman, small but upright, a face of kindly wrinkles, bright warm eyes, a smile at her lips. Snow-white long hair in many thin braids coiled on top of her head and hung with wooden beads. A worn grey-brown linen robe #8a8070 with a hand-woven moss green shawl #5a6a4a, a small wooden flute hanging at her neck.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 衣着朴素、低饱和；不画任何纹路。

subject.zh: 看上去二十出头的精灵女医者，纤细，长耳向后上方斜伸，太阳穴一圈浅色年轮纹，神情认真温和，春绿色眼睛。银白长发扎成低马尾，系着浅蓝丝带。浅蓝与白的医者长袍 #9ac0d8、#f0f4f4，腰挂一排小水晶药瓶与一卷绷带。
subject.en: An elf woman healer who looks barely twenty, slender, long ears sweeping up and back, one pale growth-ring mark at her temples, earnest and gentle, spring green eyes. Silver-white hair in a low ponytail tied with a pale blue ribbon. A healer's robe in pale blue and white #9ac0d8, #f0f4f4, a row of small crystal medicine vials and a roll of bandages at her waist.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 晨露氏的浅蓝与白；比灵泉守纳茜娅年轻得多。

subject.zh: 看上去二十多岁的精灵女哨长，修长矫健，长耳向后上方斜伸，太阳穴两圈年轮纹，眉梢挂着霜，神情冷淡警觉，冬灰色眼睛。银白短发剪到下巴。白灰色毛皮镶边的猎装 #c8ccd0 配青灰斗篷 #5a6a6e，背长弓。
subject.en: An elf woman outpost captain who looks in her twenties, tall and agile, long ears sweeping up and back, two growth-ring marks at her temples, frost on her brows, a cool watchful look, winter grey eyes. Silver-white hair cut at the chin. White-grey fur-trimmed hunting clothes #c8ccd0 with a blue-grey cloak #5a6a6e, a longbow on her back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号白霜：配色偏冷白，眉梢挂霜。

subject.zh: 四十一岁的兔族兽人酋长，浅相：人脸，一对灰白长兔耳，其中一只耳尖折下。瘦小机敏，脸颊有雀斑，神情狡黠而话多，褐色圆眼睛。灰褐短发。轻便的芥黄短袍 #b8903a 配皮绑腿，背一排信筒，胸前挂一枚风哨。
subject.en: A forty-one-year-old rabbit beastfolk chieftain, light aspect: human face, a pair of grey-white long rabbit ears, one with a folded tip. Small and quick, freckled cheeks, sly and talkative, round brown eyes. Short grey-brown hair. A light mustard short robe #b8903a with leather leg wraps, a row of message tubes on his back, a wind whistle on his chest.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 折下的一只耳尖是辨识点；比少年泰姆年长，背的信筒更多。

subject.zh: 三十九岁的野猪族兽人酋长，中相：脸上覆着褐色粗鬃，宽大的猪鼻吻，下颌一对上翘的獠牙，小而竖的耳朵。粗壮魁梧，神情鲁莽好斗，红褐色小眼睛，背上一道竖立的黑鬃。缠着红布的粗皮甲 #5a4030，肩扛一柄双刃战斧。
subject.en: A thirty-nine-year-old boar beastfolk chieftain, middle aspect: coarse brown bristles over his face, a broad pig snout, a pair of upturned tusks from his lower jaw, small upright ears. Thickset and massive, reckless and combative, small red-brown eyes, a ridge of black bristles standing along his back. Rough hide armor #5a4030 wrapped with red cloth, a double-bitted battleaxe on his shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 獠牙与背鬃是剪影特征。

subject.zh: 四十五岁的牛族兽人骑兵长，中相：脸上覆着黑褐短毛，宽厚的牛鼻吻，一对包着铁套的粗长弯角，角上缠着红绳。高大魁梧，神情沉稳威严，深褐眼睛。厚毡与铁片缀成的骑兵甲 #5a4a3a，肩披赭红斗篷 #8a3a2a，手持长骑枪。
subject.en: A forty-five-year-old bull beastfolk cavalry commander, middle aspect: black-brown short fur over his face, a broad bovine muzzle, a pair of thick long curved horns capped with iron and wound with red cord. Tall and massive, steady and commanding, dark brown eyes. Cavalry armor of thick felt and iron plates #5a4a3a, a rust-red cloak #8a3a22, a long lance in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号铁角：包铁的角是标志。

subject.zh: 五十二岁的豹族兽人女酋长，中相：脸上覆着金黄短毛，额头与脸颊恰好九块醒目的黑斑，豹的鼻吻轮廓，圆耳与长尾。精瘦，神情冷淡精明，金色竖瞳。深褐轻皮甲 #4a3a2a，颈挂一串兽牙，腰挂一对弯刀。
subject.en: A fifty-two-year-old leopard beastfolk woman chieftain, middle aspect: golden short fur over her face with exactly nine bold black spots across her brow and cheeks, a leopard muzzle outline, round ears and a long tail. Lean, cool and shrewd, golden slit pupils. Dark brown light leather armor #4a3a2a, a string of beast fangs at her neck, a pair of curved knives at her belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号九斑：脸上的九块黑斑是辨识点。

subject.zh: 四十七岁的狼族兽人战祭，中相：脸上覆着灰黑短毛，狼的鼻吻，一只耳朵从中撕裂。精壮，满身红色战纹彩绘，神情狂热，赤金色眼睛。灰黑鬃发编成几股粗辫，缀着骨哨。赤黑相间的毡甲 #6a1e1e、#1e1a1a，手持一根挂红布条的骨杖。
subject.en: A forty-seven-year-old wolf beastfolk war-priest, middle aspect: grey-black short fur over his face, a wolfish muzzle, one ear split down the middle. Wiry and strong, covered in red war-paint patterns, fervent red-gold eyes. A grey-black mane in several thick braids hung with bone whistles. Felt armor in red and black #6a1e1e, #1e1a1a, a bone staff hung with strips of red cloth.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号裂哨：撕裂的耳朵与骨哨是标志；他满身红纹，与灰脊洛坎区分。

subject.zh: 六十七岁的鹿族兽人女匠人，浅相：人脸，一对分叉鹿角上刻满细密的花纹，垂着的鹿耳。瘦小，手指灵巧，神情专注慈和，深褐眼睛。灰白长发编成粗辫。土黄毡袍 #b8903a 配皮围裙，腰挂一排刻刀，手捧一截正在雕刻的兽骨。
subject.en: A sixty-seven-year-old deer beastfolk woman artisan, light aspect: human face, a pair of forked antlers covered in fine carved patterns, drooping deer ears. Small with nimble fingers, focused and kindly, dark brown eyes. Grey-white long hair in a thick braid. An earth-yellow felt robe #b8903a with a leather apron, a row of carving knives at her waist, a piece of bone being carved in her hands.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号千刻：鹿角上刻满的花纹只是纹样，不是字。

subject.zh: 七十九岁的鹿族兽人老萨满，中相：脸上覆着灰白短毛，细长的鹿鼻吻，一对苍白的老鹿角上不挂任何饰物。瘦小佝偻，双眼蒙着白翳像是盲的，目光总落在对方身后。灰白长发披散。灰褐毡袍 #6a6050，颈挂一串祖灵石，手拄骨杖。
subject.en: A seventy-nine-year-old deer beastfolk old shaman, middle aspect: grey-white short fur over her face, a slender deer muzzle, a pair of pale old antlers bare of any ornament. Small and bent, her eyes clouded white as if blind, her gaze always resting just behind whoever she faces. Loose grey-white long hair. A grey-brown felt robe #6a6050, a string of ancestor stones at her neck, a bone staff to lean on.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号无声角：鹿角上没有任何饰物，与其他长角部的人相反。

subject.zh: 三十六岁的兔族兽人信使，浅相：人脸，一对竖起的沙褐长兔耳，耳尖带黑。瘦削，神情胆小怯懦，总缩着肩，琥珀色圆眼睛。沙褐乱发。洗旧的土黄短袍 #b8903a 配皮绑腿，背一只信筒，腰挂一只小水囊。
subject.en: A thirty-six-year-old rabbit beastfolk messenger, light aspect: human face, a pair of upright sandy-brown long rabbit ears with black tips. Thin, timid and meek, always hunching his shoulders, round amber eyes. Messy sandy-brown hair. A worn earth-yellow short robe #b8903a with leather leg wraps, a message tube on his back, a small waterskin at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 表面上是胆小的信使；四种表情都带一点怯意。

subject.zh: 四十四岁的狐族兽人女市主，浅相：人脸，红褐狐耳，一条蓬松的红尾，尾尖系着一只小铜铃。身材丰腴，笑容精明热络，琥珀色狐狸眼。红褐长发盘起，插着骨簪。红褐与白的毡袍 #8a4a2a、#f0ece4，颈挂银币串，手持一杆小秤。
subject.en: A forty-four-year-old fox beastfolk woman market-mistress, light aspect: human face, red-brown fox ears, a fluffy red tail with a small copper bell tied at its tip. Full-figured, a shrewd warm smile, amber fox eyes. Red-brown hair pinned up with bone pins. A felt robe in red-brown and white #8a4a2a, #f0ece4, a string of silver coins at her neck, a small hand scale in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号铃尾：尾尖的小铜铃是标志。

subject.zh: 四十六岁的半魔男子，修长清秀，额上一对很小的银色短角，左眼银灰、右眼深红的异色瞳，肤色是略带灰蓝的苍白，神情温和而疲倦。黑色长发束在脑后。深紫与黑的夜学长袍 #3a2048、#141218，胸前一枚新月形银针，手拿一本合起的书。
subject.en: A forty-six-year-old half-demon man, slender and refined, a pair of very small silver horns on his brow, heterochromatic eyes, the left silver-grey and the right deep red, pale skin with a faint grey-blue tinge, gentle and weary. Black long hair tied back. A night-lore robe in deep purple and black #3a2048, #141218, a crescent-shaped silver pin on his chest, a closed book in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号银角：小银角与异色瞳是辨识点；配色随养母夜后。

subject.zh: 五十八岁的灰魔女宰辅，中等身材，灰色皮肤，额前一对小角，脸庞端正，眼神精明而疲惫，眼角细纹。灰黑头发盘成紧髻，深灰眼睛。朴素的深灰长袍 #4a4a50 配黑色袖套，胸前一枚小银秤章，怀里抱着厚厚的户籍簿。
subject.en: A fifty-eight-year-old grey-demon woman chancellor, medium build, grey skin, a pair of small horns at her brow, a composed face, shrewd yet weary eyes with fine lines. Salt-and-pepper hair in a tight bun, dark grey eyes. A plain dark grey robe #4a4a50 with black sleeve guards, a small silver scales badge on her chest, a thick census register in her arms.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 灰魔外表最接近人族：灰皮肤与额前小角是辨识点；户籍簿上不写字。

subject.zh: 约一百一十岁的蛇人度支官，修长，皮肤覆着暗黄与褐色相间的细鳞，几处鳞片正在剥落，颈侧颈褶收着，金色竖瞳精明，额上一对短小的角。黑发剃短。墨绿长外套 #2a4a3a 配皮账袋，腰挂一串铜钥与一本鳞皮账簿。
subject.en: A serpentfolk treasurer about a hundred and ten, tall and slender, skin covered in fine scales of dark yellow and brown with a few patches peeling, neck frills folded, shrewd golden slit pupils, a pair of short small horns on his brow. Black hair cropped short. A dark green long coat #2a4a3a with a leather ledger pouch, a ring of copper keys and a scale-skin ledger at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号蜕账：正在剥落的鳞片是辨识点；账簿上不写字。

subject.zh: 约一百三十岁的蛇人女谍报长，纤细，皮肤覆着几乎黑色的细鳞，在光下泛着暗绿，颈褶紧贴，冷冷的金色竖瞳，额上一对短角，嘴唇极薄。黑发剪成齐耳。贴身的黑色暗行者装束 #141218，戴黑手套，指间夹着一只小银药瓶。
subject.en: A serpentfolk woman spymaster about a hundred and thirty, slender, skin covered in nearly black fine scales with a dark green sheen in the light, neck frills pressed flat, cold golden slit pupils, a pair of short horns, very thin lips. Black hair cut at the ears. A fitted black stalker's outfit #141218, black gloves, a tiny silver vial pinched between her fingers.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号无声鳞：鳞色近黑；表情变化很少。

subject.zh: 外表四十来岁的夜魔女将军，高挑，灰蓝苍白肤色，黑眼白配银色虹膜，额上一对后掠细角，黑发像烟一样微微漂浮，束成高辫。夜黑的战袍 #1e1e2a 外罩银边护甲，手提一盏发着冷白光的提灯，腰佩一根银杖。
subject.en: A night demon woman general who looks about forty, tall, pale grey-blue skin, black sclera with silver irises, a pair of swept-back thin horns, black hair drifting faintly like smoke and tied in a high braid. A night-black battle robe #1e1e2a with silver-edged armor, a lantern glowing cold white in one hand, a silver wand at her hip.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号冥灯：冷白光的提灯是标志，不用紫光。

subject.zh: 鬼人将军，比常人高出一头，肩背厚如铁砧，青黑色厚皮，额上两支粗短的黑角，下颌短獠牙，眼神凶悍，琥珀色眼睛。黑发剃成短茬。厚重的黑铁甲 #2a2a2e 镶着赤铁边 #8a3a22，手握一柄方头巨锤。
subject.en: An oni general a head taller than an ordinary man, shoulders and back as thick as an anvil, thick blue-black hide, two heavy short black horns on his brow, short tusks, fierce amber eyes. Black hair cut to stubble. Heavy black iron armor #2a2a2e trimmed with red iron #8a3a22, a square-headed great hammer in his grip.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 赤铁边是赤铁公麾下的标志；与逃兵拉兹格区分，他的角完整。

subject.zh: 外表五十来岁的夜魔术士，瘦高，灰蓝苍白肤色，黑眼白配银色虹膜，额上一对后掠细角，手臂缠满皮绳与骨扣，神情冷淡。灰黑长发如烟，披到背上。深灰褐的术士长袍 #3e3632，腰挂一串刻着契约纹的骨牌，手握一条皮绳编的长鞭。
subject.en: A night demon warlock who looks about fifty, tall and thin, pale grey-blue skin, black sclera with silver irises, a pair of swept-back thin horns, arms wound with leather cords and bone clasps, a cold expression. Smoky salt-and-pepper long hair down his back. A dark grey-brown warlock's robe #3e3632, a string of bone tablets carved with pact patterns at his belt, a braided leather whip in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 契约纹只是花纹，不是字；不画澱紫的光。

subject.zh: 鬼人祭斗长，比常人高出一头，肌肉虬结，赭红厚皮上满是刀疤，额上两支角都折断了一截，下颌短獠牙，眼神狂野，赤金色眼睛。黑发编成一条粗辫。赤黑相间的皮甲 #6a1e1e、#1e1a1a，脸上画着红纹，手握一柄断了半截的大剑。
subject.en: An oni duel-master a head taller than an ordinary man, knotted muscles, ochre-red hide covered in blade scars, both horns broken off partway, short tusks, wild red-gold eyes. Black hair in one thick braid. Leather armor in red and black #6a1e1e, #1e1a1a, red paint on his face, a greatsword broken in half in his grip.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号折角：两支角都折了一截是辨识点。

subject.zh: 约四十岁、在蛇人中算年轻的女书记，纤细，皮肤覆着刚蜕过的浅绿细鳞，光滑发亮，颈褶小巧，好奇的金色竖瞳，额上一对小角。黑发编成两条辫子。墨绿与浅灰的书记长袍 #2a4a3a、#b8b8b0，手捧一卷鳞片装订的书，指尖沾墨。
subject.en: A serpentfolk woman scribe about forty, young for her kind, slender, skin covered in freshly shed pale green scales smooth and glossy, small neck frills, curious golden slit pupils, a pair of small horns. Black hair in two braids. A scribe's robe in dark green and pale grey #2a4a3a, #b8b8b0, a scale-bound book in her hands, ink on her fingertips.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号新蜕：鳞片新而发亮；书上不写字。

subject.zh: 鬼人女大匠，比常人高出一头，肩臂粗壮，铁灰色厚皮，额上一对粗短的弯角，下颌短獠牙，神情冷静专注，银灰眼睛。黑发剃短，只留头顶一束扎起。黑皮工作围裙 #2a2a2e 罩着短袖衫，双臂缠着防火布，手握一柄泛冷光的黑铁锤。
subject.en: An oni woman master smith a head taller than an ordinary person, thick shoulders and arms, iron-grey hide, a pair of thick short curved horns, short tusks, calm and focused silver-grey eyes. Black hair shaved except for one tuft tied on top. A black leather work apron #2a2a2e over a short-sleeved shirt, fireproof cloth wrapped around both arms, a black iron hammer with a cold sheen in her grip.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号冷锤：泛冷光的黑铁锤是标志。

subject.zh: 约七十岁的蛇人女织工，修长，皮肤覆着雾一样灰白的细鳞，颈褶上缀着细银环，温和的金色竖瞳，额上一对小角。黑发盘成低髻，插着骨梭。层层叠叠的深灰夜纱长袍 #3a3a44，薄得几乎透明，手上缠着几缕黑纱线。
subject.en: A serpentfolk woman weaver about seventy, tall and slender, skin covered in fine misty grey-white scales, small silver rings on her neck frills, gentle golden slit pupils, a pair of small horns. Black hair in a low bun pinned with a bone shuttle. Layer upon layer of dark grey night-gauze robes #3a3a44 so thin they are nearly transparent, a few strands of black yarn wound around her hands.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号雾鳞：灰白的鳞色是辨识点。

subject.zh: 四十五岁的灰魔矿工，结实，灰色皮肤上满是煤灰，额前两处被锯平的角根，脸庞方正，眼神沉稳坚定。灰黑短发。打着补丁的粗布矿工服 #4a4a44，头戴一顶挂着小油灯的皮帽，肩扛一把矿镐。
subject.en: A forty-five-year-old grey-demon miner, sturdy, grey skin streaked with coal dust, two sawn-flat horn stumps at his brow, a square face, steady resolute eyes. Short charcoal hair. Patched coarse miner's clothes #4a4a44, a leather cap with a small oil lamp hanging from it, a pick on his shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号无角：被锯平的角根是辨识点。

subject.zh: 七十三岁的灰魔御厨，矮胖结实，灰色皮肤，额前一对齐根断掉的小角，圆脸红润，笑容和气，手臂却粗得惊人，眼神平静。灰白头发包在白头巾里，褐色眼睛。白色厨师衫配深褐围裙 #5a3a22，手握一把宽大的锅铲。
subject.en: A seventy-three-year-old grey-demon royal cook, short, stout and sturdy, grey skin, a pair of small horns broken off at the root on her brow, a ruddy round face with a friendly smile, yet astonishingly thick arms and a calm gaze. Grey-white hair in a white headscarf, brown eyes. A white cook's shirt with a dark brown apron #5a3a22, a broad spatula in her grip.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号锅铲：断角与锅铲是辨识点；看起来只是和气的厨娘。

subject.zh: 十九岁的翼魔少女，轻巧瘦小，背后一对浅褐色蝠翼，头上是小巧的角质耳冠，脸庞明朗，眼神灵动，琥珀色眼睛。浅褐短发被风吹乱。贴身的皮质飞行服 #6a5038，防风护目镜挂在颈上，斜挎一只信筒。
subject.en: A nineteen-year-old winged demon girl, light and small, a pair of light brown bat wings on her back, a small horny ear-crown on her head, a bright face, lively amber eyes. Light brown short hair tousled by wind. A fitted leather flight suit #6a5038, wind goggles hanging at her neck, a message tube slung across her body.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号快翼：护目镜与信筒是辨识点。

subject.zh: 约一百四十岁的蛇人祭司，高瘦，皮肤覆着灰黑相间的细鳞，颈褶微张，像在倾听什么，金色竖瞳半闭，额上一对短角。光头。赤黑相间的祭司长袍 #6a1e1e、#1e1a1a，颈挂一串骨铃，手持一根顶端是空心骨环的长杖。
subject.en: A serpentfolk priest about a hundred and forty, tall and thin, skin covered in grey and black fine scales, neck frills slightly flared as if listening for something, golden slit pupils half closed, a pair of short horns. A shaved head. A priest's robe in red and black #6a1e1e, #1e1a1a, a string of bone bells at his neck, a long staff topped with a hollow bone ring.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号渊听：颈褶微张的倾听姿态是辨识点。

subject.zh: 古龙化成的人形：外表四十来岁的高瘦男子，青绿色长发与同色的竖瞳，脸颊与手背有淡淡的青色鳞片残影，神情悠闲而深远。宽松的青灰长袍 #4a6a6e 配星纹腰带，手指间拈着一枚白色棋子。
subject.en: An ancient dragon in human form: a tall, lean man who looks about forty, long teal hair and teal slit pupils of the same hue, faint teal scale shadows on his cheeks and the backs of his hands, leisurely and far-seeing. A loose blue-grey robe #4a6a6e with a star-patterned sash, a white game piece between his fingers.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 龙族人形：与鳞同色的发与瞳、鳞片残影、竖瞳；棋子是普通的白色圆子。

subject.zh: 六十六岁的人族星守，瘦高，背微驼，脸被高山的阳光晒得发红，白色长须，眼神专注而清亮。白发拢在一顶厚毡帽下，浅灰眼睛。厚实的深蓝星纹毛呢长袍 #22304a，肩披毛皮披肩，胸前挂一只黄铜星盘，手持长柄望远镜。
subject.en: A sixty-six-year-old human star-keeper, tall, thin and slightly stooped, a face reddened by high-mountain sun, a long white beard, focused clear eyes. White hair gathered under a thick felt cap, pale grey eyes. A heavy deep blue wool robe patterned with stars #22304a, a fur shoulder cape, a brass astrolabe hanging on his chest, a long-handled telescope in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 星盘刻度上不写字。

subject.zh: 四十七岁的人族女城守，高大结实，脸庞冷峻，颧骨上有冻伤的红痕，眼神冷硬。铁灰短发剪得利落，灰色眼睛。厚重的钢甲 #6a6a70 外披白毛皮领的赭红斗篷 #8a3a22，左臂挎一面塔盾，盾面绘着隘口的图形。
subject.en: A forty-seven-year-old human woman fortress warden, tall and sturdy, a cold stern face with red frostbite on her cheekbones, hard eyes. Iron-grey hair cut sharp, grey eyes. Heavy steel armor #6a6a70 under an ochre-red cloak #8a3a22 with a white fur collar, a tower shield on her left arm painted with the emblem of a mountain pass.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号冷关：帝国赭红加雪地毛皮领。

subject.zh: 一百一十八岁的矮人工头，方形身板，脸颊冻得通红，铜红矿纹，眉毛挂霜，神情粗豪。铜红长须编成双辫，冻着冰碴，深褐眼睛。厚毛皮矿工外套 #6a5a48 配皮兜帽，背一副折叠炉架，手握一把冰镐。
subject.en: A hundred-and-eighteen-year-old dwarf foreman, square-built, cheeks red from cold, copper-red ore flecks, frost on his brows, a gruff manner. A copper-red long beard in two braids with ice crystals caught in it, dark brown eyes. A heavy fur miner's coat #6a5a48 with a leather hood, a folding forge frame on his back, an ice pick in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号冰镐：冰镐与胡须上的冰碴是辨识点。

subject.zh: 三十九岁的人族山民走私者，精瘦，脸被雪光晒得黝黑，鼻头冻得发红，咧嘴一笑露出缺了的犬齿，眼神狡猾。黑发塞在毛皮帽里，灰褐眼睛。层层厚毛皮外套 #6a5a48，背一只大背篓，篓里露出一片银亮的蜕下的大鳞。
subject.en: A thirty-nine-year-old human mountain smuggler, wiry, a face darkened by snow glare, a frost-red nose, a grin missing a canine, sly eyes. Black hair stuffed into a fur hat, grey-brown eyes. Layers of thick fur coats #6a5a48, a big basket on his back with a shining silver shed scale poking out of it.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 背篓里的蜕鳞是他的标志。

subject.zh: 四十五岁的海岛女珍珠商，身材修长，皮肤被海风晒成深铜色，眼角笑纹很深，神情热络精明。被盐晒得发浅的卷发高高盘起，插着珍珠簪，海绿色眼睛。鲜艳的海蓝与珊瑚红层叠披裹 #2a6a8a、#d86a4a，颈挂几串珍珠与贝壳。
subject.en: A forty-five-year-old island woman pearl merchant, tall and slender, skin tanned deep bronze by sea wind, deep laugh lines at her eyes, warm and shrewd. Salt-bleached curls piled high with pearl pins, sea green eyes. Bright layered wraps in sea blue and coral red #2a6a8a, #d86a4a, several strands of pearls and shells at her neck.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 潮民按海岛人的样子画：深铜肤色、盐褪的头发、珍珠与贝壳饰品。

subject.zh: 七十四岁的海岛老引水人，瘦削精悍，深铜色皮肤满是皱纹，白色短须，眼神平静如风暴前的海。稀疏白发扎成小髻。褪色的珊瑚红短衫 #b86a4a 配海蓝腰布 #2a6a8a，颈挂一枚鲸骨坠，手持一根测深竿。
subject.en: A seventy-four-year-old island old harbor pilot, lean and hard, deep bronze skin full of wrinkles, a short white beard, eyes as calm as the sea before a storm. Thin white hair in a small topknot. A faded coral red short shirt #b86a4a with a sea blue sash #2a6a8a, a whalebone pendant at his neck, a sounding pole in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 看起来只是个老引水人：神情平静，不显山露水。

subject.zh: 五十八岁的海岛女守骨人，结实，深铜色皮肤，额头与脸颊画着白色的波纹彩绘，神情沉静，海灰色眼睛。灰白长发编成许多细辫，缀着小骨片。粗麻与海兽皮的长袍 #6a6050，颈挂一串鲸骨珠，手持一根鲸骨长杖。
subject.en: A fifty-eight-year-old island woman bone-keeper, sturdy, deep bronze skin, white wave patterns painted on her forehead and cheeks, a calm expression, sea grey eyes. Grey-white long hair in many thin braids hung with small bone pieces. A robe of coarse hemp and sea-beast hide #6a6050, a string of whalebone beads at her neck, a long whalebone staff.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 白色波纹是彩绘，不是天生的纹路。

subject.zh: 五十九岁的人族黑档官，瘦长，脸窄，一边眉毛总挑着像在提问，眼神好奇又多疑。灰白头发乱翘，鼻梁上一副厚圆眼镜，浅灰眼睛。深灰鉴定官长袍 #3e3e44 配黑色袖套，胸前挂一片透明鉴定水晶，腋下夹一只上锁的黑皮档案匣。
subject.en: A fifty-nine-year-old human black-archive officer, long and thin with a narrow face, one eyebrow always raised as if asking a question, curious yet suspicious eyes. Messy grey-white hair, thick round glasses, pale grey eyes. A dark grey appraiser's robe #3e3e44 with black sleeve guards, a clear appraisal crystal on his chest, a locked black leather archive case under his arm.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号问号：挑起的一边眉毛是辨识点。

subject.zh: 六十二岁的人族考官长，高大挺直，方脸，花白短须，眉头紧锁，眼神一丝不苟。灰发剃得整齐，灰色眼睛。深灰公会制服 #3a3a3e 外罩半身钢甲，胸前公会盾徽，腰间插一把铁制长尺，背一柄长剑。
subject.en: A sixty-two-year-old human chief examiner, tall and ramrod straight, a square face, a grizzled short beard, a knitted brow, meticulous eyes. Neatly cut grey hair, grey eyes. A dark grey guild uniform #3a3a3e under a steel half-plate, the guild shield badge on his chest, an iron measuring rod tucked in his belt, a longsword on his back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号铁尺：腰间的铁尺是标志；盾徽上没有字。

subject.zh: 四十四岁的人族女法师，修长清冷，脸色苍白，眼神冷静得像结了冰，冰蓝眼睛。雪白长发披到背，额前一缕黑发。白色霜纹长袍 #e8eef2 外罩一件黑羽领斗篷 #1e1e22，手持一根顶端结着冰晶的白杖。
subject.en: A forty-four-year-old human woman mage, tall and cool, a pale face, eyes so calm they seem frozen, ice blue. Snow-white long hair down her back with a single black lock at the front. A white robe patterned with frost #e8eef2 under a cloak with a black feather collar #1e1e22, a white staff topped with an ice crystal.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号白鸦：白发、白袍配黑羽领是辨识点。

subject.zh: 九十七岁的矮人冒险者，方形身板，肩宽如墙，铁灰矿纹，鼻梁塌过，咧嘴笑时缺一颗牙。黑灰长须编成一条粗辫，缀着石环，深褐眼睛。厚重的灰岩色板甲 #6a6660，双手戴一对石块般的大铁拳套，背一面圆盾。
subject.en: A ninety-seven-year-old dwarf adventurer, square-built with shoulders like a wall, iron-grey ore flecks, a once-flattened nose, a grin missing a tooth. A salt-and-pepper beard in one thick braid with stone rings, dark brown eyes. Heavy rock-grey plate #6a6660, a pair of huge boulder-like iron gauntlets, a round shield on his back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号石拳：石块般的大拳套是标志。

subject.zh: 六十六岁的人族公会理事，魁梧，背微驼，脸上满是风霜与旧疤，白色短须，眼神沉稳固执。灰白短发，褐色眼睛。深灰长外套 #3a3a3e 配公会盾徽，手拄一截断矛改成的手杖。
subject.en: A sixty-six-year-old human guild councilor, burly and slightly stooped, a weathered face with old scars, a short white beard, steady stubborn eyes. Grey-white short hair, brown eyes. A dark grey long coat #3a3a3e with the guild shield badge, leaning on a walking stick made from a broken spear.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号断矛：断矛改的手杖是标志。

subject.zh: 五十七岁的人族女学监，瘦削挺直，脸窄，嘴唇抿紧，眼神挑剔而谨慎。深灰头发盘成髻，插一支红色批注笔，鼻梁上一副半月形眼镜，灰色眼睛。深墨蓝学监长袍 #2a3048 配黑色袖套，怀里抱一册厚厚的目录。
subject.en: A fifty-seven-year-old human woman academy censor, thin and upright, a narrow face, tight lips, critical cautious eyes. Dark grey hair in a bun pinned with a red annotating pen, half-moon glasses, grey eyes. A deep ink-blue censor's robe #2a3048 with black sleeve guards, a thick catalog in her arms.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号审校：发间的红色批注笔是标志；目录上不写字。

subject.zh: 六十九岁的人族老书库守，瘦小佝偻，脸色苍白，眼睛总半闭着，像在黑暗里也看得见，神情安详。稀疏白发，下巴白须，浅灰眼睛。褪色的灰色长袍 #7a7a7e，腰间挂一盏从不点燃的旧油灯，怀里抱着几本书。
subject.en: A sixty-nine-year-old human old librarian, small, bent and pale, eyes always half closed as though he can see in the dark, a peaceful expression. Thin white hair, a white beard, pale grey eyes. A faded grey long robe #7a7a7e, an old oil lamp that is never lit hanging at his waist, a few books in his arms.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号无灯：腰间那盏不点的灯是标志。

subject.zh: 四十八岁的人族女测绘院长，干练，脸庞方正，眉头常皱，眼神专注于数字。深棕短发别在耳后，鼻梁上一副方框眼镜，灰绿眼睛。深蓝学院外套 #2a3a5a 配皮护腕，胸前挂一只黄铜测量仪，手拿一卷画满等高线的图纸。
subject.en: A forty-eight-year-old human woman survey director, brisk with a square face, brows often knitted, eyes fixed on numbers. Dark brown short hair tucked behind her ears, square-framed glasses, grey-green eyes. A deep blue academy coat #2a3a5a with leather wristguards, a brass surveying instrument hanging on her chest, a roll of paper drawn with contour lines in hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 图纸上只有线条，不写数字。

subject.zh: 六十三岁的人族录纹大师，矮胖，圆脸，眼神慈和而专注，指尖被墨染成蓝黑。灰白卷发，鼻梁上一副放大镜片眼镜，褐色眼睛。深褐皮装帧围裙 #5a4030 罩着白衬衫，腰挂一排刻刀与装订锥，手里捧一本厚得惊人的书。
subject.en: A sixty-three-year-old human inscription master, short and plump, a round face, kind focused eyes, fingertips stained blue-black with ink. Grey-white curls, magnifying spectacles, brown eyes. A dark brown leather bookbinder's apron #5a4030 over a white shirt, a row of engraving knives and binding awls at his belt, an astonishingly thick book in his hands.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号千页：厚书是标志；书上不写字。

subject.zh: 二十六岁的半精灵女研究员，纤瘦，耳朵比人族长、尖却短，没有年轮纹，眼睛亮得过分，神情兴奋专注。浅金乱发随手扎起，插着两支笔，浅绿眼睛。沾满粉笔灰的深蓝学院外套 #2a3a5a，胸前挂一串钥匙状的小铜量具，怀抱一卷画满拱形图的纸。
subject.en: A twenty-six-year-old half-elf woman researcher, slim, ears longer than a human's, pointed but short, no growth-ring marks, eyes far too bright, excited and focused. Pale blond messy hair tied up any old way with two pens stuck in it, pale green eyes. A chalk-dusted deep blue academy coat #2a3a5a, a string of small key-shaped copper measuring tools on her chest, a roll of paper covered in arch diagrams in her arms.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 半精灵：耳朵尖而短，没有年轮纹；图纸上只有拱形线条，不写字。

subject.zh: 三十一岁的人族书记，清瘦，脸庞斯文，眼神温和，带着一点恍惚。栗色短发，额前一缕翘着，灰蓝眼睛。墨蓝史官长袍 #2a3048 配白色立领，胸前一枚银羽笔别针，手握一支羽笔与一块写字板。
subject.en: A thirty-one-year-old human scribe, slim with a scholarly face, gentle eyes with a touch of absent-mindedness. Short chestnut hair with one lock sticking up, grey-blue eyes. An ink-blue historian's robe #2a3048 with a white stand-up collar, a silver quill pin on his chest, a quill and a writing board in his hands.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 他是首席史官的学生：同款墨蓝长袍与银羽笔别针；写字板上不写字。

subject.zh: 四十六岁的人族账房，中等身材，脸庞平凡，笑容和善，眼神却总在留意门口。灰褐短发梳得整齐，褐色眼睛。海蓝商会制服外套 #2a5a7a 配白衬衫，袖口沾着几根灰白的鸽羽，腋下夹一本账簿。
subject.en: A forty-six-year-old human bookkeeper, average build with an ordinary face, a friendly smile, yet eyes always watching the door. Neatly combed grey-brown short hair, brown eyes. A sea blue merchant-league uniform coat #2a5a7a over a white shirt, a few grey-white pigeon feathers clinging to his cuffs, a ledger under his arm.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号鸽笼：袖口的鸽羽是唯一的暗示；不画任何组织标志。

subject.zh: 三十五岁的人族男子，精瘦，脸上有几道斗场留下的旧疤，鼻梁歪过，眼神阴郁。黑色短发剃得贴头，深褐眼睛。磨旧的皮质斗士背心 #5a3a22，腰间挂一只空空的剑鞘，双手缠着发黄的绷带。
subject.en: A thirty-five-year-old human man, wiry, a few old arena scars on his face, a once-broken nose, brooding eyes. Black hair buzzed close, dark brown eyes. A worn leather gladiator vest #5a3a22, an empty sword scabbard hanging at his belt, yellowed bandages wound around both hands.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号空鞘：腰间的空剑鞘是标志。

subject.zh: 三十九岁的人族修女，纤细，脸庞温顺，眼神低垂，嘴角带着恭顺的笑。深棕头发全部收进白头巾里，褐色眼睛。灰白修女服 #d8d4cc，双手戴着白色长手套，手提一盏黄铜框的照纹灯。
subject.en: A thirty-nine-year-old human nun, slender with a meek face, lowered eyes, a deferential smile. Dark brown hair tucked entirely into a white wimple, brown eyes. A grey-white nun's habit #d8d4cc, long white gloves on both hands, a brass-framed mark-revealing lantern carried in one hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 她是掌灯修女：外表温顺；手套下不画任何东西；不画任何组织标志。

subject.zh: 二十八岁的年轻追踪者，瘦长灵活，鼻翼微微张着像在嗅气味，神情专注而冷淡。乱糟糟的深棕头发，眼角细长，琥珀褐眼睛。灰褐兜帽皮外套 #5a4e40，颈上围一条深色围巾，腰挂一卷细绳与一把猎刀。
subject.en: A twenty-eight-year-old young tracker, long, thin and agile, nostrils slightly flared as if catching a scent, focused and cool. Messy dark brown hair, narrow amber-brown eyes. A grey-brown hooded leather coat #5a4e40, a dark scarf around his neck, a coil of thin cord and a hunting knife at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号嗅门：嗅气味的神态是辨识点；不画任何组织标志。

subject.zh: 五十二岁的半魔男子，瘦削，灰褐皮肤，额上一边一支小角、另一边只剩角根，左眼金色、右眼灰色的异色瞳，嘴角一抹冷笑。黑发夹灰，向后梳。深灰与暗红的长外套 #3a3a40、#6a2a2a，戴黑手套，指间转着一枚铁环。
subject.en: A fifty-two-year-old half-demon man, gaunt, grey-brown skin, a small horn on one side of his brow and only a stump on the other, heterochromatic eyes, gold on the left and grey on the right, a cold smirk. Black hair streaked with grey, combed back. A long coat in dark grey and dark red #3a3a40, #6a2a2a, black gloves, an iron ring spinning between his fingers.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号双瞳：异色瞳是辨识点；与银角埃利斯区分，他的瞳色是金与灰。

subject.zh: 十五岁的少年，瘦小，脸色发黄，眼神执拗又惶恐，嘴唇干裂。乱糟糟的浅棕头发，褐色眼睛。不合身的旧灰斗篷 #6a6a64 罩着打补丁的短衫，手腕缠着布条，怀里紧紧揣着一只小小的木雕。
subject.en: A fifteen-year-old boy, small and thin with a sallow face, stubborn yet frightened eyes, chapped lips. Messy light brown hair, brown eyes. An ill-fitting old grey cloak #6a6a64 over a patched tunic, cloth wrapped around his wrists, a small wooden carving clutched tight to his chest.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 神情惶恐；手腕布条下不画任何东西。

subject.zh: 五十七岁的人族酒馆老板娘，丰满，脸庞和善，笑纹很深，眼神温暖而警觉。灰白卷发盘起，用一块蓝头巾束住，褐色眼睛。暖褐长裙 #7a5232 配白围裙，脖子上围着一条厚围巾，手里擦着一只陶杯。
subject.en: A fifty-seven-year-old human tavern keeper, full-figured with a kind face and deep laugh lines, warm yet watchful eyes. Grey-white curls pinned up and tied with a blue kerchief, brown eyes. A warm brown long dress #7a5232 with a white apron, a thick scarf around her neck, polishing a clay cup.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 围巾下不画任何东西；神情亲切。

subject.zh: 十九岁的少女，身形轻快，脸庞明朗，眼神好奇而大胆，嘴角带着跃跃欲试的笑。深褐长发编成许多细辫，缀着小木珠，与祖母同样的发式，浅褐眼睛。苔绿短外套 #5a6a4a 配灰褐绑腿，腰挂一串木制小钥匙与一张短弓。
subject.en: A nineteen-year-old young woman, light on her feet, a bright face, curious bold eyes, an eager smile. Dark brown long hair in many thin braids hung with small wooden beads, styled like her grandmother's, light brown eyes. A moss green short jacket #5a6a4a with grey-brown leg wraps, a string of small wooden keys and a short bow at her belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 发式与祖母奥菲拉一致；木钥匙只是木制小饰物。

subject.zh: 五十一岁的人族佣兵副团长，精壮，一道烧伤疤从耳根延到下巴，眼神冷静却藏着火气。灰白短发剃到贴头，冰蓝眼睛。磨旧的帝国制式铁甲 #5a5a60 外披褪色的赭红斗篷，胸前挂一截断剑形铁坠，腰挂双手斧。
subject.en: A fifty-one-year-old human mercenary vice captain, wiry and strong, a burn scar running from his ear to his jaw, calm eyes that hide a temper. Grey-white hair buzzed close, ice blue eyes. Worn imperial-pattern iron armor #5a5a60 under a faded ochre-red cloak, a broken-sword iron pendant on his chest, a two-handed axe at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号冷火：冰蓝眼睛配烧伤疤；与团长老铁同款装束。

subject.zh: 巨大银龙头部的局部特写，画面只容得下一只眼与周围：鳞片像磨旧的镜面，映着淡淡的天青色天光，眼睛是白色的，没有瞳孔，像一轮月亮，眼眶边的鳞如山岩般粗粝，额角露出一截岩石般的角根。古老、安静而威严。
subject.en: A partial close-up of a colossal silver dragon's head, the frame holding only one eye and its surroundings: scales like worn mirrors reflecting faint sky-blue light, a white pupilless eye like a moon, rugged rock-like scales around the socket, the base of a stony horn at the brow. Ancient, quiet and majestic.

items.notes: 龙不走纸娃娃，这一张直接按描述生成，附原龙的三视图作参照，鳞色与眼睛与之一致；四格只有神态变化。 只画局部，绝不画出完整的龙头或龙身；四种表情靠眼睑开合与鳞片的起伏表现。

subject.zh: 鬼人老妇，比常人高，背微驼，赭红厚皮上有日晒的斑，额上一对细短的角缠着葡萄藤，下颌小獠牙，眼神温和而哀伤，琥珀色眼睛。花白头发包在绿头巾里。褪色的绿褐粗布裙 #5a6a42 配围裙，手提一篮深红葡萄。
subject.en: An elderly oni woman, tall but slightly stooped, sun spots on her ochre-red hide, thin short horns wound with grapevine, small tusks, gentle sorrowful amber eyes. Grizzled hair under a green headscarf. A faded green-brown coarse dress #5a6a42 with an apron, a basket of deep red grapes in her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号葡萄藤：角上缠的葡萄藤是标志；葡萄画成深红色。

subject.zh: 沉睡的赤色古龙头部局部特写：岩浆般暗红的鳞片层层叠叠，鳞缝里透出余烬的橙光，一只半闭的赤金色竖瞳带着睡意，眼角的鳞如凝固的熔岩，额边一截黑曜石般的粗角。画面只容得下眼周。
subject.en: A partial close-up of a sleeping crimson ancient dragon's head: magma-dark red scales layered thick with ember-orange light glowing in the seams, one half-closed sleepy red-gold slit eye, scales at the eye's corner like cooled lava, the base of an obsidian-like horn at the brow. The frame holds only the area around the eye.

items.notes: 龙不走纸娃娃，这一张直接按描述生成；四格只有神态变化。 只画局部，绝不画完整的龙；四种表情靠眼睑与瞳孔表现。

subject.zh: 冰川下沉睡的白色古龙头部局部特写：雪白的鳞片覆着薄冰与霜花，鳞片边缘透着冰蓝，一只紧闭的眼被霜封住，眼睑下的鳞像冰川的裂纹，额边一截冰晶般的角根。画面只容得下眼周。
subject.en: A partial close-up of a white ancient dragon asleep under a glacier: snow-white scales coated in thin ice and frost flowers, their edges glowing ice blue, one eye closed and sealed by frost, scales under the eyelid like glacier crevasses, the base of an ice-crystal horn at the brow. The frame holds only the area around the eye.

items.notes: 龙不走纸娃娃，这一张直接按描述生成；四格只有神态变化。 只画局部，不画完整的龙；表情靠眼睑与霜的裂开表现。

subject.zh: 放山羊的隐士，高瘦，裹着一件厚重的灰色兜帽斗篷 #6a6a6a，兜帽压得很低，阴影里隐约露出灰蓝苍白的下巴与一双银色眼睛，兜帽两侧有角的隆起。手拄一根放羊长杖，周身飘着细雪，兜帽上却一片也不沾。
subject.en: A goat-herding hermit, tall and thin, wrapped in a heavy grey hooded cloak #6a6a6a with the hood pulled low, shadows hinting at a pale grey-blue chin and a pair of silver eyes, bumps of horns at the sides of the hood. Leaning on a long shepherd's staff, fine snow drifting all around him, yet not a flake settles on his hood.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 兜帽始终压低；只有银瞳与兜帽下角的隆起暗示他的种族。

subject.zh: 四十七岁的人族矿工头，矮壮，肩背厚实，脸上嵌着洗不掉的黑灰，下巴一圈修短的灰褐胡子，眉头紧锁，灰色眼睛总在估量人。深褐短发压在旧毡帽下。灰褐帆布工装 #5a5048 外罩磨亮的皮背心 #6a4a32，腰挂一卷量绳，肩扛一截粗木支柱。
subject.en: A forty-seven-year-old human mine foreman, short and broad, thick shoulders and back, coal grime worked permanently into his face, a close-trimmed grey-brown beard, a furrowed brow, grey eyes always sizing people up. Short dark brown hair under an old felt hat. Grey-brown canvas work clothes #5a5048 under a leather vest worn shiny #6a4a32, a coil of measuring cord at his belt, a thick timber pit prop on his shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 独眼团只是团名，他两眼完好，不戴眼罩；肩上的木支柱是标志，与矿头 art_por_herbert_crystaltooth 区分，没有晶牙与灯架矿帽。

subject.zh: 三十六岁的人族磨坊主妇，敦实，圆脸，颧骨泛红，笑容温和却带着倦意，浅褐眼睛下有淡淡的黑眼圈。亚麻色头发包在沾着面粉的白头巾里。蓝灰粗布长裙 #5a6a7a 系米白围裙 #e0d4bc，袖子挽到肘上，前臂落着面粉，手握一把木面粉勺。
subject.en: A thirty-six-year-old human miller's wife, sturdy, round-faced, flushed cheekbones, a warm but tired smile, faint dark circles under light brown eyes. Flaxen hair wrapped in a flour-dusted white headscarf. A blue-grey coarse cloth dress #5a6a7a with an off-white apron #e0d4bc, sleeves rolled to the elbow, flour on her forearms, a wooden flour scoop in her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 磨坊人家的蓝灰与米白；与面包师 art_por_ped、art_por_lisa 父女区分，她没有面包帽与麦穗发饰。

subject.zh: 四十一岁的人族寡妇，瘦而结实，脸颊微凹，嘴角紧绷，眼神冷静戒备。深褐头发编成一条辫子，压在黑色头巾下，褐色眼睛。褐色粗布衫外系硬皮围裙 #6a4a2a，双手被鞣液染成深褐，左腕缠一条褪色的黑布带，腰挂一只装肉干的小布袋。
subject.en: A forty-one-year-old human widow, thin but tough, slightly hollow cheeks, a tight-set mouth, calm and guarded eyes. Dark brown hair in a single braid under a black headscarf, brown eyes. A brown coarse shirt under a stiff leather apron #6a4a2a, both hands stained deep brown by tanning liquor, a faded black cloth band around her left wrist, a small cloth pouch of jerky at her belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 黑头巾与左腕黑布带是守寡的标志；与皮革匠 art_por_wiebke_gerber 区分，她不戴额前皮箍，发色深褐。

subject.zh: 五十五岁的人族织工行会会长，身材厚实，方下巴，嘴角下撇，眼神像在验布。花白的浅金头发收进雪白的亚麻头巾，灰蓝眼睛。茜红厚呢长裙 #8a3a2a 配黑丝绒领口，胸前垂一枚小银纺锤坠，指间捏着一截打了结的毛线样。
subject.en: A fifty-five-year-old human weavers' guild head, solidly built, square jaw, mouth turned down, eyes that look as if inspecting cloth. Greying pale blonde hair tucked into a snow-white linen coif, grey-blue eyes. A madder-red heavy wool dress #8a3a2a with a black velvet collar, a small silver spindle pendant on her chest, a knotted yarn sample pinched between her fingers.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与同为织工行会的 art_por_sibylle_spindler 区分：她更年长厚实，白头巾配茜红裙，不用织梭发簪与银剪刀。

subject.zh: 五十岁的人族马市主人，高大，腰身发福，晒得通红的宽脸，浓密的灰褐八字胡，灰蓝眼睛像在给人估价。头上压一顶旧绿呢软帽 #4a5a3a，帽檐垂一束马鬃穗。褐色厚呢骑马外套 #6a4a2a 敞着领，肩搭一副皮笼头，手握一根量马木杖。
subject.en: A fifty-year-old human horse-market owner, tall and paunchy, a broad sunburnt face, a thick grey-brown moustache, grey-blue eyes that seem to be pricing you. An old green felt soft cap #4a5a3a with a tassel of horsehair hanging from the brim. A brown heavy wool riding coat #6a4a2a open at the collar, a leather halter over his shoulder, a horse-measuring stick in his hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 量马木杖上只有刻痕，不写数字；他不拿马鞭，与车夫 art_por_lotti_rutways 区分。

subject.zh: 三十八岁的人族女驯犬人，精瘦结实，脸被风吹得粗糙，鼻梁上一道细疤，眼神直率，带着护犬的凶。浅褐头发编成一条紧辫，灰绿眼睛。橄榄褐猎装 #5a5a3a 配皮护臂，胸前别一枚小鹿角形铜徽，颈挂一支骨哨，肩头斜搭几条皮牵绳。
subject.en: A thirty-eight-year-old human woman dog trainer, lean and wiry, a wind-roughened face, a thin scar across the bridge of her nose, frank eyes with a protective edge. Light brown hair in one tight braid, grey-green eyes. An olive-brown hunting outfit #5a5a3a with leather bracers, a small antler-shaped brass badge on her chest, a bone whistle at her throat, several leather leashes slung across one shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 鹿角铜徽只是小胸章，不画成头上的真鹿角；与王都驯兽师 art_por_tilda_rennert 区分，她衣着朴素。

subject.zh: 六十九岁的人族老德鲁伊畜医，高瘦，手长脚长，晒黑的脸上满是深纹，眼神温和而仔细，浅灰绿眼睛。灰白头发剪得极短，耳边别一片干橡叶。苔褐粗布长外套 #5a5a42 外罩斑驳的皮围裙，口袋插着几只药瓶，颈挂一只灌药用的牛角。
subject.en: A sixty-nine-year-old human druid and livestock healer, tall and lean with long limbs, a tanned face full of deep lines, gentle and careful pale grey-green eyes. Grey-white hair cropped very short, a dried oak leaf tucked behind one ear. A moss-brown coarse long coat #5a5a42 under a mottled leather apron with a few medicine vials in its pockets, a drenching horn for dosing animals hanging at her neck.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与欧拉婆婆 art_por_oola 区分：她高瘦短发，没有藤杖、麻雀与木屐；灌药的牛角是她的标志。

subject.zh: 十一岁的遗民女孩，外表与常人无异，瘦小，尖下巴，眼睛大而亮，常微微侧着头，像在听远处有人叫她。深栗色短发剪得参差，系一条洗旧的蓝布发带，灰褐眼睛。大人旧衣改小的灰绿罩衫 #6a7a6a，外套一件大一号的米褐毛线背心 #b8a088。
subject.en: An eleven-year-old Remnant girl who looks like any other child, small and thin, a pointed chin, big bright eyes, her head often tilted as if hearing someone call her from far away. Uneven short dark chestnut hair tied with a faded blue cloth ribbon, grey-brown eyes. A grey-green smock #6a7a6a cut down from an adult's old dress, under a beige knitted vest #b8a088 one size too big.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 门纹在掌心，头像里不画手掌；衣着低饱和；与慈济院的 art_por_leni_mercy 区分，她更大，深栗短发配蓝发带。

subject.zh: 六十三岁的人族老兵首领，骨架高大，背依旧挺直，长脸被北风刻出深纹，鼻梁断过，灰白短须，眼神沉稳得像在点名。灰白头发剃得很短，浅灰眼睛。褪色的军团灰外套 #5a5a58 配旧毛皮领，颈围深红旧围巾 #7a2a2a，背一面铁边满是凹痕的圆盾。
subject.en: A sixty-three-year-old human veterans' leader, big-framed and still ramrod straight, a long face carved deep by the north wind, a once-broken nose, a short grey-white beard, steady eyes like a man calling roll. Grey-white hair shaved very short, pale grey eyes. A faded legion-grey coat #5a5a58 with an old fur collar, a dark red old scarf #7a2a2a around his neck, a round shield with a dented iron rim on his back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与盾墙教官 art_por_arno_greywall 区分：他更高更瘦，穿外套不穿重甲，圆盾与深红围巾是辨识点。

subject.zh: 五十八岁的人族老掌旗兵，中等身材，敦实，圆脸满是风霜，花白络腮胡，眼神和气又倔。稀疏的灰褐头发向后梳，褐色眼睛。缝补多次的军团灰外套 #5a5a58 外罩自鞣的旧皮甲背心 #7a5a3a，肩扛一根卷着灰蓝旗布的旗杆，领口别一根穿麻线的粗针。
subject.en: A fifty-eight-year-old human standard-bearer, medium height and stocky, a weathered round face, a grizzled full beard, good-natured yet stubborn eyes. Thinning grey-brown hair combed back, brown eyes. A much-mended legion-grey coat #5a5a58 under an old leather armor vest he tanned himself #7a5a3a, a flagpole with furled grey-blue cloth on his shoulder, a thick needle threaded with linen pinned at his collar.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 旗布始终卷起，不画旗徽与字；与老兵首领 art_por_leonhard_stock 同款灰外套，他矮胖、扛旗杆、有络腮胡。

subject.zh: 三十四岁的遗民男子，外表与人族无异，精瘦，脸被荒原的日头与灰晒成暗褐，短胡茬里夹着灰，眼神沉着。深褐短发，额上推着黄铜框护目镜，灰色眼睛。灰褐厚布外衣 #6a6050 围着灰白长巾，左肩扣一块厚皮护肩，腰挂扳手与短撬棍，背一柄短矛。
subject.en: A thirty-four-year-old Remnant man who looks entirely human, lean, his face baked dark brown by the wasteland sun and ash, ash caught in his stubble, composed eyes. Short dark brown hair, brass-framed goggles pushed up on his forehead, grey eyes. A grey-brown heavy cloth tunic #6a6050 with a long grey-white scarf, a thick leather pauldron buckled on his left shoulder, a wrench and a short pry bar at his belt, a short spear on his back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 门纹在左肩，被皮护肩完全盖住，不画出来；与拾玻璃人 art_por_ester_glass 区分，他是持矛的男子。

subject.zh: 六十二岁的人族老石匠，骨架粗大，肩臂结实得不像老人，方脸晒成褐色，眉骨一道旧疤，眼神冷硬。铁灰头发剪到耳下，用灰布带箍住，灰色眼睛。沾满石粉的粗帆布工装 #8a8478 外罩旧皮护肩，口袋插着石凿，肩头靠着一柄缠布握把的长柄铁戟。
subject.en: A sixty-two-year-old human stonemason, big-boned, shoulders and arms too strong for her age, a square sun-browned face, an old scar over one brow, hard cold eyes. Iron-grey hair cut below the ears and held by a grey cloth band, grey eyes. Stone-dusted coarse canvas work clothes #8a8478 under an old leather shoulder guard, a stone chisel in her pocket, a long iron halberd with a rag-wrapped grip leaning on her shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 武人与石匠要同时看得出：长柄铁戟与满身石粉；与苇桥村长 art_por_barbara_schmitz 区分，她瘦硬冷峻。

subject.zh: 四十四岁的人族骡贩，精瘦，长脸被灰风吹得干裂，鼻梁晒脱了皮，络腮胡里积着灰，眼神精明又满不在乎，浅褐眼睛。灰褐乱发塞在灰毡宽檐帽下。灰白山羊毛斗篷 #a09a8a 裹着肩，颈挂一枚涂成灰色的骡蹄铁，肩头搭一副骡笼头。
subject.en: A forty-four-year-old human mule dealer, lean, a long face cracked dry by ash wind, a peeling sunburnt nose, ash collected in his full beard, shrewd and careless light brown eyes. Messy grey-brown hair stuffed under a grey felt wide-brimmed hat. A grey-white goat-hair cloak #a09a8a wrapped around his shoulders, a mule shoe painted grey hanging at his neck, a mule halter over one shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 灰色骡蹄铁坠是外号灰蹄的标志；与骡队头 art_por_polly_mutebell 区分，他是瘦长的人族男子，不挂铃。

subject.zh: 四十五岁的人族女驯兽师，高挑利落，脸庞瘦长，眼角细纹，嘴角挂着见惯宫廷的淡笑，眼神锐利。深棕头发盘在脑后，插一根斑纹鹰羽，琥珀色眼睛。深绿猎装 #2e4a32 配王室蓝滚边 #3a4a7a，颈挂一支银猎哨，手腕缠着一条黄铜扣的猎犬牵绳。
subject.en: A forty-five-year-old human woman beast trainer, tall and brisk, a long lean face, fine lines at the eyes, the faint smile of someone used to the court, sharp eyes. Dark brown hair pinned up at the back with a barred hawk feather, amber eyes. A deep green hunting outfit #2e4a32 with royal blue piping #3a4a7a, a silver hunting whistle at her throat, a hound leash with a brass buckle wound around her wrist.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 王室猎苑的深绿配王室蓝滚边；她手上不托鹰，与帝国驯鹰人 art_por_sebald_weiss 区分。

subject.zh: 五十三岁的人族王室马厩长，身形笔挺，宽肩，长脸，灰白唇髭修得笔直，眼神严格，带着老骑手的沉稳。灰黑短发梳得服帖，灰蓝眼睛。王室蓝骑装外套 #3a4a7a 配黑皮马甲与擦亮的高领，胸前一枚马蹄铁形银章，手握一根包皮的短驯马杖。
subject.en: A fifty-three-year-old human royal stable master, upright and broad-shouldered, a long face, a neatly squared grey-white moustache, strict eyes with an old rider's composure. Short grey-black hair combed flat, grey-blue eyes. A royal blue riding coat #3a4a7a with a black leather waistcoat and a polished high collar, a horseshoe-shaped silver badge on his chest, a short leather-wrapped schooling stick in his hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 体面的王室官员，衣着整洁；与马市主人 art_por_olaf_hufner 区分，没有软帽与笼头，也不发福。

subject.zh: 五十一岁的人族圣骑士队长，高大沉重，常年不见日光，脸色苍白，眼窝深，眼下青黑，眼神沉默。灰白头发剃到贴头，浅灰眼睛。灰黑板甲 #3a3c42 镶着发暗的银边，外罩褪成灰白的罩袍 #c8c4b8，胸口光环纹被烟熏暗，手提一柄长柄钉锤。
subject.en: A fifty-one-year-old human paladin captain, tall and heavy, pale from years without daylight, deep-set eyes with dark shadows beneath, a silent gaze. Grey-white hair shaved close, pale grey eyes. Charcoal plate armor #3a3c42 with tarnished silver edging under a surcoat faded to grey-white #c8c4b8, the halo emblem on the chest darkened by soot, a long-hafted spiked mace in his hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 城下的暗守：盔甲灰黑无光，与耀白甲的 art_por_ulrich_von_eisen 相反；不画蓝白光或紫光。

subject.zh: 四十四岁的人族学者，瘦长，肩背微弓，脸色苍白，下巴一圈没打理的短须，眼神热切又带讥讽。黑发夹着白丝，乱拢到耳后，褐色眼睛。深蓝灰讲师长袍 #34405a，胸前一块颜色更深的方印像摘掉了徽章，颈挂小沙漏坠，腋下夹一本皮带捆紧的旧书。
subject.en: A forty-four-year-old human scholar, tall and thin with slightly hunched shoulders, a pale face, an untended short beard, eager eyes with a sardonic edge. Black hair streaked with white, pushed messily behind his ears, brown eyes. A dark blue-grey lecturer's gown #34405a with a darker square patch on the chest where a badge was removed, a small hourglass pendant at his neck, an old book bound shut with a leather strap under his arm.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 胸前摘掉徽章留下的深色方印是辨识点；书上不写字；与录纹大师 art_por_felix_fehling 区分，他瘦长苍白。

subject.zh: 五十八岁的人族老斗士，宽肩厚背，满脸旧疤，一道横疤贯过双眼，两眼蒙着乳白的翳，头总是微微偏着在听。花白头发剃成短茬，下巴灰白胡茬。磨旧的皮质斗士肩甲 #5a3a22 只护左肩，颈上松松挂着一条褪色的蒙眼布，肩扛一柄双手长柄斧。
subject.en: A fifty-eight-year-old human pit veteran, broad-shouldered and thick-backed, a face full of old scars, one horizontal scar running across both eyes, both eyes clouded milky white, his head always tilted slightly to listen. Grizzled hair cut to stubble, grey-white stubble on his chin. A worn leather pit pauldron #5a3a22 on his left shoulder only, a faded blindfold hanging loose around his neck, a two-handed long axe on his shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 双眼都是白翳，四种表情都不画瞳孔；与鹿族老萨满 art_por_sera_silenthorn 区分，他是人族斗士。

subject.zh: 二十九岁的人族女斗士，高壮，肩臂粗实，下巴一道旧刀疤，眼神凶悍，嘴角咧着。黑发剪得很短，额前一道深红颜料横纹，深褐眼睛。无袖皮斗士胸甲 #6a4a32，左肩一块铁肩甲，腰系与妹妹同色的青绿布带 #2a5a5a，手握一柄宽刃砍刀。
subject.en: A twenty-nine-year-old human woman pit fighter, tall and powerful, thick shoulders and arms, an old blade scar on her chin, fierce eyes, a wide grin. Black hair cropped very short, a dark red stripe of paint across her brow, dark brown eyes. A sleeveless leather fighter's breastplate #6a4a32, an iron pauldron on her left shoulder, a teal sash #2a5a5a matching her sister's, a broad-bladed falchion in her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与妹妹 art_por_vey_twinblade 成对：同色青绿布带，她的铁肩甲在左；额前红纹是颜料，不是血。

subject.zh: 二十七岁的人族女斗士，比姐姐纤细，动作轻快，眉眼与姐姐相像，神情冷静得近乎淡漠。黑色长发束成一条高马尾，深褐眼睛。无袖皮斗士胸甲 #6a4a32，右肩一块铁肩甲，腰系与姐姐同色的青绿布带 #2a5a5a，手握一柄细长的弯刀。
subject.en: A twenty-seven-year-old human woman pit fighter, slimmer and quicker than her sister, with the same brows and eyes, an expression cool to the point of indifference. Long black hair in a high ponytail, dark brown eyes. A sleeveless leather fighter's breastplate #6a4a32, an iron pauldron on her right shoulder, a teal sash #2a5a5a matching her sister's, a long slender sabre in her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与姐姐 art_por_nell_twinblade 镜像：她的铁肩甲在右，高马尾配细弯刀；两人眉眼要像一家人。

subject.zh: 三十岁的海岛深潜者，修长精悍，深铜色皮肤，肩背线条像游鱼，眼白被海水泡得微红，神情安静。被盐晒成浅褐的卷发在头顶扎成小髻，插一根鱼骨簪，海灰色眼睛。无袖的深藻绿短褂 #3a5a4a，颈挂骨制鼻夹与一片空牡蛎壳，肩上斜挎采珠网兜。
subject.en: A thirty-year-old island deep diver, long and sinewy, deep copper skin, shoulders and back shaped like a swimming fish, the whites of his eyes slightly reddened by seawater, a quiet expression. Salt-faded light brown curls tied in a small topknot with a fishbone pin, sea-grey eyes. A sleeveless dark kelp-green vest #3a5a4a, a bone nose clip and an empty oyster shell hanging at his neck, a pearl-diving net bag slung across his shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 潮民按海岛人画：深铜肤色、盐褪的头发；与半身人潜者 art_por_cici_conchhorn 区分，他是高个男子，没有螺号。

subject.zh: 十九岁的牛族兽人少女，浅相：人脸，一对向前弯的奶白短角，两侧垂着软软的牛耳，身子结实，脸颊晒红，眼神认真又有点紧张，深褐眼睛。栗色长发编成两条辫。角上缠着新的红黄彩绳，灰白毡袍外套蹄印纹短坎肩 #8a5a3a，手持一面绷牛皮的小手鼓。
subject.en: A nineteen-year-old bull-folk beastkin girl, light aspect: a human face, a pair of short cream-white horns curving forward, soft drooping cow ears at the sides, a sturdy build, sun-reddened cheeks, earnest and slightly nervous dark brown eyes. Long chestnut hair in two braids. New red and yellow cords wound around her horns, a hoofprint-patterned short vest #8a5a3a over a grey-white felt robe, a small cowhide hand drum in her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 长角部的角缠彩绳，与角上不挂饰物的 art_por_sera_silenthorn 相反；浅相是人脸，不画牛鼻吻。

subject.zh: 三十四岁的深炉矮人女炉工，还很年轻，方形身板，肤色苍白，脸颊有银白矿纹，神情倔强专注。炭黑鬓发编成两条短辫，缀着铜环，灰银眼睛在火光下反光。烟灰皮工作服 #4a4640，小臂布满火星烫出的浅红小疤，护目镜挂在颈上，肩搭一块焦黄的隔热厚布。
subject.en: A thirty-four-year-old deep-forge dwarf woman furnace hand, still young, a square build, pale skin with silver-white ore marks on her cheeks, a stubborn focused expression. Charcoal-black sideburn braids, two short ones hung with copper rings, grey-silver eyes that catch the firelight. A smoke-grey leather work suit #4a4640, forearms dotted with small pinkish spark burns, goggles hanging at her neck, a scorched yellow heat cloth over one shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号烬手：小臂上的浅红烫疤是标志；女性矮人不画胡须；与师傅 art_por_igva_whiteanvil 区分，她是黑发。

subject.zh: 二十二岁的鬼人斗士，比常人高出一头，年轻精悍，肌肉还没长到夸张，铁灰色厚皮，额上两支粗角，右角齐中间断掉，下颌短獠牙，眼神不服，橙黄眼睛。黑发扎成一束短尾。简单的皮胸带 #3a2a22，双臂缠着布条，背一柄朴素的铁大剑。
subject.en: A twenty-two-year-old oni fighter a head taller than an ordinary man, young and lean, his muscles not yet grown to oni excess, thick iron-grey hide, two heavy horns on his brow with the right one snapped off at the middle, short tusks, defiant orange-yellow eyes. Black hair tied in a short tail. A simple leather chest harness #3a2a22, cloth wrapped around both arms, a plain iron greatsword on his back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号半角：只有右角断了一半，左角完好；与双角都折的 art_por_uga_brokenhorn、独角的 art_por_rogo_breakchain 区分。

subject.zh: 看上去三十来岁的精灵女守护者，修长沉静，长耳向后上方斜伸，太阳穴两圈浅色年轮纹，神情专注，春绿色眼睛。黑褐长发编成粗辫，辫梢缠着根须般的褐色细丝。深褐与苔绿的斗篷 #4a3a2a、#5a6a3a，左肩一块树皮纹护肩，腰挂一把弯月形修枝刀。
subject.en: An elf woman guardian who looks about thirty, tall and calm, long ears sweeping back and up, two faint growth rings at her temples, a focused expression, spring-green eyes. Dark brown hair in a thick braid, its tip wound with brown threads like fine rootlets. A deep brown and moss-green cloak #4a3a2a, #5a6a3a, a bark-textured pauldron on her left shoulder, a crescent pruning knife at her belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 沉根氏按根环氏的深褐、苔绿与树皮护肩画；与长老 art_por_othelan_deeproot 区分，她年轻、单肩护肩、带修枝刀。
