subject.zh: 看上去二十出头的精灵女斥候，修长轻捷，长耳向后上方斜伸，太阳穴一圈浅色年轮纹，神情安静警觉，秋琥珀色眼睛。烟灰色长发剪到肩。灰紫与银灰的猎装 #7a7088、#a0a4ac，面纱拉到下巴下面当围巾，腰挂一卷绳捆的桦皮卷，背一张短弓。
subject.en: An elf woman scout who looks barely past twenty, slender and light-footed, long ears sweeping back and up, one faint growth ring at her temples, a quiet watchful expression, autumn-amber eyes. Smoke-grey hair cut to the shoulders. A grey-violet and silver-grey hunting outfit #7a7088, #a0a4ac, her clan veil pulled down under her chin like a scarf, a roll of birch bark tied with cord at her belt, a short bow on her back.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 雾叶氏的灰紫偏浅偏灰，不是澱紫；面纱放下露出整张脸，与戴面纱的 art_por_lisera_mistleaf 区分。

subject.zh: 九十六岁的鬼人老兵，比常人高出一头，背微驼，赭红厚皮褪成暗褐，额上两支粗角刻满细痕，铁灰浓眉像两道铁条压着眼，下颌短獠牙，眼神沉郁，琥珀色眼睛。白发编成一条粗辫。旧黑铁胸甲 #2a2a2e，肩披破旧毛皮披风，手拄一柄锻锤。
subject.en: A ninety-six-year-old oni veteran a head taller than an ordinary man, slightly stooped, ochre-red hide faded to dark brown, two heavy horns covered in fine notches, thick iron-grey brows like two iron bars over his eyes, short tusks, brooding amber eyes. White hair in one thick braid. An old black iron breastplate #2a2a2e, a ragged fur mantle on his shoulders, leaning on a forging hammer.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 外号铁眉：铁灰浓眉是辨识点，角上只是刻痕；与 art_por_moz_blackanvil 区分，他年迈白发、背微驼。

subject.zh: 外表四十多岁的夜魔老兵，瘦高，灰蓝苍白肤色，黑眼白配银色虹膜，额上一对后掠细角，左角根一道旧裂痕，神情沉默，像在听脚下的动静。黑发如烟，剪到颈后。厚重的煤黑长外套 #2a2a30 配霜灰内衬 #9a9ea4，手握一根顶端是闭合铁环的长杖。
subject.en: A night demon veteran who looks in his forties, tall and thin, pale grey-blue skin, black sclera with silver irises, a pair of swept-back thin horns with an old crack at the base of the left one, a silent expression, as if listening to something below his feet. Smoky black hair cut at the nape. A heavy coal-black long coat #2a2a30 with a frost-grey lining #9a9ea4, a long staff topped with a closed iron ring in his grip.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 铁环杖与外套都不发光，不画紫光；与冥灯 art_por_osta_nightlamp 区分，他不提灯，左角根有裂痕。

subject.zh: 看不出年纪的夜魔钥贩，瘦削，灰蓝苍白肤色，黑眼白配银色虹膜，额上一对后掠细角各套一只银环，嘴角挂着生意人的笑。黑发如烟，半掩在深兜帽下。夜黑长外套 #1e1e26 的内襟挂满一排排生铁钥匙，指间转着一把形状古怪的铁钥。
subject.en: A night demon key dealer of no readable age, gaunt, pale grey-blue skin, black sclera with silver irises, a silver ring on each of his swept-back thin horns, a merchant's smile. Smoky black hair half hidden under a deep hood. A night-black long coat #1e1e26 whose inner lapels are hung with rows of raw iron keys, an oddly shaped iron key twirling between his fingers.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 钥匙一律是生铁与暗银色，不用门扉金，也不刻字；与蛇人度支官 art_por_satis_sheddedledger 区分。

subject.zh: 五十二岁的金湾人族商行掌柜，微胖，晒成棕色的圆脸，方正的黑灰短须，笑容强作镇定，褐色眼睛藏着心事。黑发抹油向后梳，左耳一只小金环。宝蓝与橙黄的织锦外套 #2a4a8a、#d8902a，十指戴满戒指，唯独右手食指空着，留一圈浅色戒痕。
subject.en: A fifty-two-year-old Goldbay human merchant-house master, slightly plump, a round sun-browned face, a squared black-and-grey short beard, a forced composed smile, brown eyes hiding a worry. Oiled black hair combed back, a small gold hoop in his left ear. A royal blue and orange-gold brocade coat #2a4a8a, #d8902a, rings on every finger except his right index finger, which is bare with a pale ring mark.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 右手食指的浅色戒痕是辨识点，那里不画戒指；金湾的鲜艳织锦，与 art_por_hart 的三件套西装区分。

subject.zh: 六十一岁的人族女秤主，身材结实，方正的下颌与弟弟奥兰多一样，眼神沉稳精明，嘴角带着不肯让步的笑。灰白头发剪成齐耳短发，褐色眼睛。深石板灰厚呢外套 #3a4048 配黄铜扣，领口别一枚桥形银针，腰挂两枚封蜡印章，一枚海蓝、一枚赭红。
subject.en: A sixty-one-year-old human woman house-master of a money exchange, solidly built, with the same square jaw as her brother Orlando, steady shrewd eyes, a smile that will not give ground. Grey-white hair cut in a chin-length bob, brown eyes. A dark slate-grey heavy wool coat #3a4048 with brass buttons, a bridge-shaped silver pin at the collar, two wax seals at her belt, one sea blue and one ochre red.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与弟弟 art_por_orlando_steyr 要有相似的方下颌；她的外套是单色，两色只在两枚印章上，印面只有图形。

subject.zh: 四十七岁的半身人女宝石匠，个子只到常人腰间，圆脸，脸颊有雀斑状的吉斑，神情挑剔而专注。灰褐卷发盘成紧髻，插着一根细钢镊，右眼夹着一只黄铜放大镜筒，绿色眼睛。深海蓝皮工作围裙 #22384a 罩着白衬衫，指尖托一颗切了一半的无色晶石。
subject.en: A forty-seven-year-old halfling woman gem cutter, only waist-high to an ordinary person, a round face with freckle-like luck spots on her cheeks, a fastidious focused expression. Grey-brown curls in a tight bun with fine steel tweezers stuck through it, a brass jeweller's loupe clamped in her right eye, green eyes. A deep sea-blue leather work apron #22384a over a white shirt, a half-cut colorless crystal balanced on her fingertips.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 晶石画成无色或淡蓝，不用澱紫；放大镜筒在右眼，与戴单片镜的 art_por_timo_ninebead 区分。

subject.zh: 六十八岁的人族隐修者，枯瘦高挑，光头，脸被高山风雪吹得发红干裂，灰白短须，眼神平静而执拗，浅灰眼睛。打满补丁的厚羊皮斗篷 #7a6e5a 兜帽搭在肩后，帽边插一根灰黑的大鹫羽，颈上用皮绳挂一块黑褐的落铁，怀抱一摞绳捆的记录册。
subject.en: A sixty-eight-year-old human hermit, gaunt and tall, bald, a face reddened and chapped by mountain wind and snow, a short grey-white beard, calm and obstinate pale grey eyes. A heavily patched thick sheepskin cloak #7a6e5a with the hood thrown back, a large grey-black vulture feather tucked in the hood's edge, a dark brown lump of fallen star-iron on a leather cord at his neck, a cord-tied stack of record books in his arms.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 与观穹台星守 art_por_eld_rahn 区分：他光头、披羊皮斗篷，没有星盘与望远镜；记录册上不写字。

subject.zh: 看上去三十来岁的精灵女主事，修长端庄，长耳向后上方斜伸，太阳穴两圈浅色年轮纹，神情客气，夏青色眼睛。银灰长发盘成发冠，下半张脸罩着灰紫薄纱，纱缘缀几枚绳结。灰紫与银的德鲁伊长袍 #7a7088、#c0c4cc，手持一根挂满打结细绳的木杖。
subject.en: An elf woman steward who looks about thirty, tall and poised, long ears sweeping back and up, two faint growth rings at her temples, a courteous expression, summer-teal eyes. Silver-grey hair coiled into a crown, the lower half of her face veiled in sheer grey-violet gauze with a few small cord knots along its hem. A grey-violet and silver druid's robe #7a7088, #c0c4cc, a wooden staff hung with many knotted cords in her hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 挂满绳结的木杖是标志；灰紫偏浅偏灰，不是澱紫；与 art_por_lisera_mistleaf 区分，她盘发冠，不带账簿与银铃。

subject.zh: 五十五岁的人族驯鹰人，精瘦挺拔，脸庞窄长，被高沼的风吹得黝黑，灰色唇髭修得整齐，眼神冷静专注。灰褐短发，灰色眼睛。赭黄与深褐的猎装 #a07a3a、#5a4030，左手戴到肘的厚皮鹰手套，拳上立着一只戴皮头罩的灰背隼，腰挂一只装鲜肉的皮袋。
subject.en: A fifty-five-year-old human falconer, lean and upright, a long narrow face darkened by highmoor wind, a neatly trimmed grey moustache, calm focused eyes. Short grey-brown hair, grey eyes. An ochre and dark brown hunting outfit #a07a3a, #5a4030, a thick leather falconry gauntlet up to the left elbow with a hooded grey-backed falcon standing on his fist, a leather pouch of fresh meat at his belt.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 隼站在左拳上并戴头罩；与精灵游猎长 art_por_tarien_greenstring 的肩上鹰架护肩区分。

subject.zh: 四十九岁的人族驯犬人，矮壮，粗脖子，满脸胡茬，左耳缺了一块像被咬过，眼神粗鲁又护短。灰黑短发剃得贴头，褐色眼睛。沾着狗毛的厚皮围裙 #6a4a32 罩着灰衬衫，前臂缠着厚皮护套，肩上搭一只带铁钉的旧斗犬项圈，手攥一根短牵绳。
subject.en: A forty-nine-year-old human dog handler, short and thickset, a thick neck, a stubbled face, a chunk missing from his left ear as if bitten, rough but protective eyes. Grey-black hair shaved close, brown eyes. A thick dog-hair-flecked leather apron #6a4a32 over a grey shirt, heavy leather guards on his forearms, an old iron-studded fighting-dog collar over one shoulder, a short leash gripped in his fist.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 缺了一块的左耳与铁钉项圈是辨识点；与瓦伦堡驯犬人 art_por_berit_sand 区分，他是斗场的粗汉。

subject.zh: 三十八岁的铃路半身人女账房，个子只到常人腰间，圆脸，脸颊有雀斑状的吉斑，嘴角抿着认真的笑，黑亮的眼睛精明。沙褐卷发扎成两个低髻。深芥绿短外套 #5a6a2a 缀满口袋，胸前别一只小铜铃，左肩趴着一只橘色虎斑猫，猫尾垂在她胸前。
subject.en: A thirty-eight-year-old Bell Road halfling woman bookkeeper, only waist-high to an ordinary person, a round face with freckle-like luck spots on her cheeks, a serious little smile, shrewd shining black eyes. Sandy brown curls in two low buns. A dark mustard-green short coat #5a6a2a covered in pockets, one small brass bell pinned to her chest, an orange tabby cat lying across her left shoulder with its tail hanging down her front.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 肩上的账房猫是标志，画成普通橘猫；与七铃站长 art_por_mina_sevenbell 区分，她只挂一只铃。

subject.zh: 四十五岁的灰魔牧人，结实，灰色皮肤被冻原的风吹得粗糙，额前一对小角被牧绳磨得发亮，脸庞方正，眼神沉默而防备，深灰眼睛。灰黑短发乱翘，下巴一圈短胡茬。厚重的驯鹿皮外袍 #7a6a58 翻着白毛领，颈挂一只铜羊铃，肩上斜挎一卷牧绳。
subject.en: A forty-five-year-old grey-demon herder, sturdy, grey skin roughened by tundra wind, a pair of small horns at his brow rubbed shiny by herding rope, a square face, silent and wary dark grey eyes. Tousled short charcoal hair, short stubble along his jaw. A heavy reindeer-hide robe #7a6a58 with a turned-out white fur collar, a copper sheep bell at his neck, a coil of herding rope slung across his shoulder.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 灰皮肤与额前小角是灰魔的辨识点；与矿工 art_por_tam_hornless 区分，他的角完好，穿驯鹿皮。

subject.zh: 三十六岁的狐族兽人女驯兽师，中相：脸上覆着红褐短毛，细长的狐鼻吻，下巴与两颊是白毛，一对竖起的红褐狐耳，左耳挂一枚鹰羽，琥珀色眼睛沉稳。红褐长发编成一条粗辫。红褐与白的毡袍 #8a4a2a、#f0ece4，右手戴一只布满爪痕的厚皮护手。
subject.en: A thirty-six-year-old fox-folk beastkin woman beast trainer, middle aspect: short red-brown fur on her face, a slender fox muzzle, white fur on chin and cheeks, upright red-brown fox ears with an eagle feather hanging from the left one, steady amber eyes. Red-brown hair in one thick braid. A red-brown and white felt robe #8a4a2a, #f0ece4, a thick leather gauntlet covered in claw scratches on her right hand.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 中相狐族：短毛与细鼻吻，别画成狼或狗；与浅相的 art_por_inka_belltail、art_por_tiss_whitetail 区分。

subject.zh: 外表近七十的夜魔老妇，瘦小，背微驼，灰蓝苍白的皮肤满是细纹，黑眼白配银色虹膜，额上一对后掠细角已经发白，神情温和。雪白长发像烟一样微微漂浮，松松挽在脑后。手织的深灰厚披肩 #4a4a52 打着补丁，双手捧着一只小小的木雕雀鸟。
subject.en: A night demon old woman who looks nearly seventy, small and slightly stooped, pale grey-blue skin full of fine wrinkles, black sclera with silver irises, a pair of swept-back thin horns gone pale with age, a gentle expression. Snow-white hair drifting faintly like smoke, loosely knotted at the back. A patched, hand-knitted thick dark grey shawl #4a4a52, a tiny carved wooden bird cupped in both hands.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的正面放大图）作参照；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 木雀是素木色的普通木雕，不发光、不画纹路；她是独居老妇，衣着朴素，不戴夜境贵族的饰物。

subject.zh: 公会总部的登记官：四十来岁的男子，脸窄，头发向后梳得一丝不苟，鼻梁上压着一副厚镜片的圆眼镜，神情一板一眼。深蓝色公会制服外套 #2c3a5c 扣到领口，银色纽扣，臂弯里抱着一枚拳头大的透明鉴定水晶 #cfe8f0。
subject.en: A registrar from the guild headquarters: a man in his forties with a narrow face, hair combed straight back without a strand out of place, thick round glasses pressing on the bridge of his nose, a by-the-book expression. A dark blue guild uniform coat #2c3a5c buttoned to the collar with silver buttons, a fist-sized clear appraisal crystal #cfe8f0 cradled in his arm.

extra.zh: 第 2 格不画高兴，画成惊讶：眉毛高挑，嘴微张；第 4 格的担忧画成吃痛的苦相。
extra.en: Panel 2 shows surprise instead of happiness: brows raised high, mouth slightly open; the worried panel 4 is drawn as a pained grimace.

items.notes: 无名职名的通用头像：没有三视图与纸娃娃预览，按固定描述块画；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 用于 cut_a4_founding。 导入键：第 1 格 neutral、第 2 格 surprised、第 3 格 angry、第 4 格 pained。 不画任何组织的文字与可读标记。

subject.zh: 海港同盟的书记：瘦削的年轻男子，颧骨高，深色短发贴着头皮，眼睛细长，神情谨慎。墨绿色同盟书记袍 #2e4a40，袖口套着防墨的黑色袖套，怀里抱一本包着铜角的厚账册。
subject.en: A clerk of the harbor league: a thin young man with high cheekbones, dark hair cropped close to the scalp, narrow eyes and a cautious look. A dark green league clerk's robe #2e4a40, black ink sleeves over his cuffs, a thick ledger with brass corners held to his chest.

extra.zh: 第 3 格的生气画成冷淡：嘴角下压，眼神不带温度。
extra.en: The angry panel 3 is drawn as cold aloofness: the corners of the mouth pressed down, eyes without warmth.

items.notes: 无名职名的通用头像：没有三视图与纸娃娃预览，按固定描述块画；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 用于 cut_a4_founding 与 cut_a4_conclave。 导入键：第 1 格 neutral、第 2 格 smile、第 3 格 cold、第 4 格 sad。 不画任何组织的文字与可读标记。

subject.zh: 垂死的帝国士兵：十八九岁的少年兵，满脸灰土与干涸的血迹，嘴唇干裂，眼神涣散。赭红色帝国军服 #8a3a22 外罩凹陷的铁胸甲，头盔不见了，短发被汗黏在额上。
subject.en: A dying imperial soldier: a boy soldier of eighteen or nineteen, his face covered in dust and dried blood, cracked lips, unfocused eyes. An ochre-red imperial uniform #8a3a22 under a dented iron breastplate, his helmet gone, short hair plastered to his forehead with sweat.

extra.zh: 第 2 格不画高兴，画成被别人借口说话的样子：眼里亮着不属于他的暗红色光，咧嘴露出牙齿；第 4 格的担忧画成痛苦。
extra.en: Panel 2 is not happiness but the look of someone else speaking through him: a dark red light that is not his own burns in his eyes, a grin baring his teeth; the worried panel 4 is drawn as pain.

items.notes: 无名职名的通用头像：没有三视图与纸娃娃预览，按固定描述块画；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 用于 cut_a4_valda_offer。 导入键：第 1 格 neutral、第 2 格 special、第 3 格 angry、第 4 格 pained。 不画任何组织的文字与可读标记。

subject.zh: 难民礼拜堂的新执事：三十来岁的男子，面容清瘦，胡子刮得干干净净，神情拘谨。洗得发白的灰白执事袍 #d8d4c8，胸前一枚小小的铜光环徽，双手捧着一卷诏书抄本，纸上不写字。
subject.en: The new deacon of the refugee chapel: a man in his thirties with a lean face, clean-shaven, a stiff, careful manner. A washed-out grey-white deacon's robe #d8d4c8, a small copper halo badge on his chest, a copied edict scroll held in both hands with no writing on the paper.

extra.zh: 第 3 格的生气画成冷淡：嘴角下压，照本宣科的神情。
extra.en: The angry panel 3 is drawn as coldness: the corners of the mouth pressed down, the look of someone reading out a text.

items.notes: 无名职名的通用头像：没有三视图与纸娃娃预览，按固定描述块画；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 用于 cut_a4_edict。 导入键：第 1 格 neutral、第 2 格 smile、第 3 格 cold、第 4 格 sad。 不画任何组织的文字与可读标记。

subject.zh: 澱哨台的哨长：四十来岁的女学者，脸瘦，眼角有细纹，神情疲惫而专注。头与颈裹着防灰的米灰布巾 #c8c0b0，额上推着一副黄铜框护目镜，身穿多口袋的旧皮外套 #6a5038，胸前挂一支铅笔。
subject.en: The chief of the sediment watch post: a woman scholar in her forties with a thin face, fine lines at her eyes, tired but focused. A beige-grey dust cloth #c8c0b0 wrapped around her head and neck, brass-rimmed goggles pushed up on her forehead, an old many-pocketed leather coat #6a5038, a pencil hanging at her chest.

items.notes: 无名职名的通用头像：没有三视图与纸娃娃预览，按固定描述块画；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 用于 cut_a5_eska。 不画任何组织的文字与可读标记。

subject.zh: 洛萨的贵族：五十来岁的胖男人，圆脸红润，八字胡上过油向两边翘起，眼神得意。深红天鹅绒礼服 #7a1e2e 镶金边，胸前别着一枚金色光轮徽，一手高举盛着红酒的高脚杯。
subject.en: A Lothar noble: a stout man in his fifties with a round ruddy face, an oiled moustache curling up at both ends, a pleased look. A deep red velvet formal coat #7a1e2e trimmed with gold, a gold halo-wheel badge pinned to his chest, one hand raising a stemmed glass of red wine.

items.notes: 无名职名的通用头像：没有三视图与纸娃娃预览，按固定描述块画；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 用于 cut_a5_eska。 不画任何组织的文字与可读标记。

subject.zh: 执钥人：二十岁上下的遗民青年，晒黑的脸，短发被风吹乱，眼神坚定。打满补丁的灰褐粗布衣 #6a6050 外披一件旧斗篷，颈上用皮绳挂一枚门形的青铜小牌 #b08a4a，右手背上一道发着微光的门纹。
subject.en: A keybearer: a young man of the remnant folk around twenty, a sun-darkened face, short hair tousled by the wind, resolute eyes. Patched grey-brown rough cloth #6a6050 under an old cloak, a small door-shaped bronze plaque #b08a4a on a leather cord at his neck, a faintly glowing door mark on the back of his right hand.

items.notes: 无名职名的通用头像：没有三视图与纸娃娃预览，按固定描述块画；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 用于 cut_a5_mirror_a、cut_a5_eska、cut_a5_luchen、cut_a5_mirror_c、cut_a5_final_war。手背入画时门纹只画一道细细的微光。 不画任何组织的文字与可读标记。

subject.zh: 联军的普通士兵：二十多岁的男子，铁盔的盔沿压得很低，只露出一双疲惫的眼睛，脸上沾满灰。灰褐色棉甲 #6a6458 外套着磨旧的锁子甲，肩上斜挎一条深蓝布带 #2c3a5a 作为联军标识。
subject.en: An ordinary soldier of the allied army: a man in his twenties, the brim of his iron helmet pulled low so only his tired eyes show, his face smeared with ash. A grey-brown padded jacket #6a6458 under worn mail, a dark blue sash #2c3a5a across his shoulder as the allied army's mark.

items.notes: 无名职名的通用头像：没有三视图与纸娃娃预览，按固定描述块画；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 用于 cut_a5_eska、cut_a5_confession、cut_a5_luchen、cut_a5_mirror_b、cut_a5_final_war。 不画任何组织的文字与可读标记。

subject.zh: 醉月亭的常客冒险者：三十来岁的男子，满脸胡茬，脸颊喝得发红，眼神半醉，嘴角挂着笑。磨旧的棕色皮甲 #6a4a30，肩上搭着脱下的斗篷，手里拎着一只木酒杯。
subject.en: A regular adventurer of the Drunken Moon tavern: a man in his thirties, stubble all over his face, cheeks flushed from drink, half-drunk eyes, a grin at the corner of his mouth. Worn brown leather armor #6a4a30, his cloak slung over one shoulder, a wooden tankard in his hand.

items.notes: 无名职名的通用头像：没有三视图与纸娃娃预览，按固定描述块画；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 用于 cut_a5_confession。 不画任何组织的文字与可读标记。

subject.zh: 金湾集市的摊贩：精明的小个子男人，尖下巴，两撇小胡子，眼珠滴溜溜地转。头戴一顶宽檐软帽，帽上插一根长长的绿羽毛 #3a8a5a，身穿亮黄条纹马甲 #d8b040，脖子上挂一串小铜牌。
subject.en: A stall keeper of the Goldbay market: a shrewd little man with a pointed chin, a thin pair of moustaches and darting eyes. A soft wide-brimmed hat with a long green feather #3a8a5a stuck in it, a bright yellow striped waistcoat #d8b040, a string of small brass tags around his neck.

items.notes: 无名职名的通用头像：没有三视图与纸娃娃预览，按固定描述块画；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 用于 cut_a5_confession。 不画任何组织的文字与可读标记。

subject.zh: 使者：风尘仆仆的中年男子，脸被晒黑，胡子修得很短，神情恭谨。披一件没有任何纹章的灰蓝旅行斗篷 #4a5a6a，领口别一枚素面铜扣，腋下夹着一只封了蜡的皮文书筒。
subject.en: An envoy: a travel-worn middle-aged man with a sun-darkened face, a closely trimmed beard and a respectful bearing. A grey-blue traveling cloak #4a5a6a without any emblem, a plain copper clasp at the collar, a wax-sealed leather document case tucked under his arm.

items.notes: 无名职名的通用头像：没有三视图与纸娃娃预览，按固定描述块画；四格只有表情变化，头像按正常比例画。 用于 cut_a2_barony（王都使者）与第四幕起各国来使、使团的合称（cut_a4_founding、cut_a5_confession）；斗篷无纹，所以哪一国的使者都能用。 不画任何组织的文字与可读标记。

subject.zh: 学院请来的年轻史官：二十出头的瘦削男子，戴一副细框圆眼镜，栗色头发乱翘，神情紧张，手足无措。墨蓝色学院长袍 #2a3450，袖口沾着几点墨，怀里紧紧抱着一大卷纸。
subject.en: A young historian brought from the academy: a thin man in his early twenties with thin round glasses and unruly chestnut hair, nervous and unsure what to do with his hands. A dark ink-blue academy robe #2a3450 with a few ink spots on the cuffs, a large roll of paper clutched to his chest.

subject.zh: 修长消瘦的人形，裹在层层黑灰旧斗篷里 #2a2a2e，斗篷下摆像墨一样往下滴着暗紫的澱 #4a3a62。脸是一片光滑空白的平面，像没写字的纸，正中一道细细的门形裂缝，透出暗紫微光。双手缠着灰白绷带，腰间挂一串拓着门形纹的纸片。Q 版约 1.7 头身。
subject.en: A tall, gaunt human figure wrapped in layers of old charcoal cloaks #2a2a2e, the hem dripping dark purple sediment like ink #4a3a62. The face is a smooth blank plane like an unwritten page, with a thin door-shaped crack down the middle leaking a dim purple glow. Hands wrapped in grey-white bandages, a string of paper rubbings of door shapes at the waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall.

extra.zh: 他没有五官：八格的脸都是同一片空白平面加正中的门形裂缝，表情只靠头的角度、裂缝光的明暗与澱的滴落来表现。中性是头正对、裂缝透出微光；微笑是头微微歪向一侧，裂缝光变柔；得意是下巴微抬，裂缝光稳定地变亮；生气是裂缝光骤亮，斗篷边缘的澱滴加快；悲伤是头低垂，裂缝光几乎熄灭；惊讶是头微微后仰，裂缝略微张开；思索是头偏向一侧停住；第 8 格的角色专属表情：抬起缠绷带的右手停在脸侧，手背朝向画面，绷带缝里露出反相的门纹：一扇被锁链缠住的门，澱黑紫色。
extra.en: He has no features: in all eight panels the face is the same blank plane with the door-shaped crack down the middle, and expression comes only from the angle of the head, the brightness of the crack and the dripping sediment. Neutral: head straight, a faint glow in the crack; smile: head tilted slightly aside, the glow softer; smug: chin slightly raised, the glow steadily brighter; angry: the crack flares, the sediment drips faster from the cloak edges; sad: head bowed, the glow nearly out; surprised: head drawn slightly back, the crack opening a little; thinking: head tilted to one side and held; panel 8 is the character's signature expression: the bandaged right hand raised beside the face with its back to the viewer, a gap in the bandage showing the inverted door mark, a door wrapped in chains in sediment black-purple.

items.notes: 附本人三视图（重点看第 4 格胸像）作参照；八格只有表情变化。 对话框不显示本头像，只显示空的头像框（角色设定集第 4.8 节）；本头像用于角色卡、图鉴与传闻来源链。立牌里手背的门纹由渲染层画，头像尺寸够大，第 8 格的门纹画进素材，形状与主角的门纹相同、明暗相反。 脸上绝对不画五官；纸片上没有字。
